TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶数据集存在的感知与规划数据分离、行为多样性不足、缺乏闭环评估等问题，在CARLA Leaderboard 2.0平台上收集了超过285万帧的多模态数据集，支持目标检测、车道线检测、规划、预测及视觉语言动作模型等多种任务，并提供了数值化稀有度评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶数据集存在感知与规划数据分离、行为多样性有限、缺乏闭环评估能力等问题，限制了端到端自动驾驶模型的发展。

Method: 在CARLA模拟环境的Leaderboard 2.0挑战场景中，收集了超过285万帧的数据集，支持动态目标检测、车道分割线检测、中心线检测、交通灯识别、预测、规划以及视觉语言动作模型等多种任务，并提供数值化稀有度评分。

Result: 构建了一个包含285万帧的大规模多任务数据集，并验证了其在多种自动驾驶模型上的适用性。

Conclusion: 该数据集弥补了现有数据集在感知-规划联合建模、行为多样性和闭环评估方面的不足，为端到端自动驾驶研究提供了更全面的数据基础。

Abstract: Collecting a high-quality dataset is a critical task that demands meticulous attention to detail, as overlooking certain aspects can render the entire dataset unusable. Autonomous driving challenges remain a prominent area of research, requiring further exploration to enhance the perception and planning performance of vehicles. However, existing datasets are often incomplete. For instance, datasets that include perception information generally lack planning data, while planning datasets typically consist of extensive driving sequences where the ego vehicle predominantly drives forward, offering limited behavioral diversity. In addition, many real datasets struggle to evaluate their models, especially for planning tasks, since they lack a proper closed-loop evaluation setup. The CARLA Leaderboard 2.0 challenge, which provides a diverse set of scenarios to address the long-tail problem in autonomous driving, has emerged as a valuable alternative platform for developing perception and planning models in both open-loop and closed-loop evaluation setups. Nevertheless, existing datasets collected on this platform present certain limitations. Some datasets appear to be tailored primarily for limited sensor configuration, with particular sensor configurations. To support end-to-end autonomous driving research, we have collected a new dataset comprising over 2.85 million frames using the CARLA simulation environment for the diverse Leaderboard 2.0 challenge scenarios. Our dataset is designed not only for planning tasks but also supports dynamic object detection, lane divider detection, centerline detection, traffic light recognition, prediction tasks and visual language action models . Furthermore, we demonstrate its versatility by training various models using our dataset. Moreover, we also provide numerical rarity scores to understand how rarely the current state occurs in the dataset.

</details>


### [206] [Online Self-Training for Co-Adaptation in Hierarchical Diffusion Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05291)
*Clemence Grislain,Mathilde Kappel,Olivier Sigaud,Mohamed Chetouani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ORCHID提出了一种自训练框架，通过环境反馈过滤策略样本并蒸馏回规划器和控制器，实现分层扩散策略的稳定在线对齐与改进，在CALVIN基准上使轻量模型超越了两倍规模的VLA模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层策略中高层规划器与低层控制器需要兼容的子目标分布，但两者之间存在协调困难，且在线分层梯度强化学习训练扩散模型存在不稳定性。

Method: 通过环境反馈过滤联合成功的轨迹样本，将其蒸馏回规划器和控制器进行监督学习，实现双向协同适应：规划器将子目标锚定在控制器的实际可达能力上，控制器则专精于规划器产生的轨迹结构。

Result: 在CALVIN基准上，轻量级弱模型超越了纯离线方法，包括两倍规模的大视觉-语言-动作模型。

Conclusion: 基于监督蒸馏的过滤在线样本方法避免了扩散模型在线分层梯度强化学习的不稳定性，实现了分层策略的稳定在线改进。

Abstract: Hierarchical policies decompose language-conditioned long-horizon robotic manipulation into a high-level planner and a low-level controller. However, effective coordination between HL and LL requires that both components operate on compatible subgoal distributions. We propose ORCHID, a self-training framework that enables stable online improvement of hierarchical diffusion policies by aligning planning and control through iterative refinement. By filtering policy samples via environment feedback, ORCHID identifies trajectories where the planner and controller are jointly successful and distills them back into both modules via supervised learning. This process induces a bidirectional co-adaptation: the planner grounds its subgoals in the actual reaching capabilities of the controller, while the controller specializes in the trajectory structures the planner produces. By relying on supervised distillation of filtered on-policy samples, ORCHID avoids the instability typical of online hierarchical gradient-based RL training with diffusion models. On the CALVIN benchmark, ORCHID allows a lightweight, initially weak model to outperform pure offline methods, including a Vision-Language-Action model twice its size.

</details>


### [207] [RobotEQ: Transitioning from Passive Intelligence to Active Intelligence in Embodied AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06234)
*Kuofei Fang,Xinyi Che,Haomin Ouyang,Shufan Zhang,Xuehao Wang,Qi Liu,Liyi Liu,Chenqi Zhang,Wenxi Cai,Wenyu Dai,Jinyang Wu,Fan Zhang,Haoyu Chen,Bin He,Zheng Lian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了RobotEQ，首个面向主动智能（即无需用户明确指令，机器人自主理解并遵守社会规范）的基准测试，包含1,894张自我中心图像、4,944个动作判断问题和1,157个空间定位问题。实验表明现有模型在主动智能方面表现不足，尤其在空间定位上，而引入RAG技术可提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身AI研究聚焦于根据用户明确指令完成任务（被动智能），但机器人要融入人类社会，必须理解哪些行为是允许或禁止的（主动智能），目前缺乏评估模型能否理解并遵守社会规范的基准。

Method: 构建RobotEQ-Data数据集（1,894张自我中心图像，10个具身类别56个子类），通过人工标注提供4,944个动作判断问题和1,157个空间定位问题；建立RobotEQ-Bench评估现有模型；利用RAG技术引入外部社会规范知识库提升性能。

Result: 现有模型在主动智能任务上表现不足，尤其在空间定位方面；引入RAG技术可总体提升模型性能。

Conclusion: 本工作可推动机器人从用户引导的被动操控向主动社会合规转变，为具身AI的主动智能研究提供了首个标准化评估基准。

Abstract: Embodied AI is a prominent research topic in both academia and industry. Current research centers on completing tasks based on explicit user instructions. However, for robots to integrate into human society, they must understand which actions are permissible and which are prohibited, even without explicit commands. We refer to the user-guided AI as passive intelligence and the unguided AI as active intelligence. This paper introduces RobotEQ, the first benchmark for active intelligence, aiming to assess whether existing models can comprehend and adhere to social norms in embodied scenarios. First, we construct RobotEQ-Data, a dataset consisting of 1,894 egocentric images, spanning 10 representative embodied categories and 56 subcategories. Through extensive manual annotation, we provide 4,944 action judgment questions and 1,157 spatial grounding questions, specifying appropriate robot actions across diverse scenarios. Furthermore, we establish RobotEQ-Bench to evaluate the performance of state-of-the-art models on this task. Experimental results demonstrate that current models still fall short in achieving reliable active intelligence, particularly in spatial grounding. Meanwhile, leveraging RAG techniques to incorporate external social norm knowledge bases can generally enhance performance. This work can facilitate the transition of robotics from user-guided passive manipulation to active social compliance.

</details>


### [208] [BiPneu: Design and Control of a Bipolar-Pressure Pneumatic System for Soft Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12804)
*Yu Mei,Xinyu Zhou,Vedant Naik,Alan Gao,Xiaobo Tan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出BiPneu——一种可扩展、低成本的多通道双极压力气动系统，专为软体机器人设计。该系统基于混合机电模型，采用带迟滞监督模式选择的双模滑模控制器(DM-SMC)，实现了宽范围、高精度、快速响应的正负压调控。实验证明DM-SMC在阶跃和正弦压力跟踪方面优于先进模型预测控制器和精心调参的PID控制器，平均绝对误差分别降低11.9%和35.6%。通过软体并联机器人的快速控球和基于实时有限元法的软体波纹管遥操作两个案例验证了系统能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人执行器需要正负压调控以实现大运动范围和多种驱动模式，但现有系统因充气-放气动力学不对称、阀门非线性和切换扰动等问题，难以在正负压双极性下实现高性能压力调节。

Method: 提出了BiPneu多通道双极压力气动系统；基于混合机电模型设计了带迟滞监督模式选择的双模滑模控制器(DM-SMC)。

Result: 多步测试平均绝对误差1.44 kPa，正弦跟踪4.23 kPa，较PID分别降低11.9%和35.6%；控制代价、阀门切换率和瞬态响应均有改善；在压力相关体积波纹管执行器上验证了鲁棒性。

Conclusion: BiPneu系统结合DM-SMC控制器在软体机器人气动控制中实现了高精度、高响应速度，并通过软体并联机械手快速控球和实时有限元法遥操作两个应用展示了其实际能力。

Abstract: Positive-negative pressure regulation is critical to soft robotic actuators, enabling large motion ranges and versatile actuation modes. However, achieving high-performance regulation across both pressure polarities remains challenging due to asymmetric inflation-deflation dynamics, valve nonlinearities, and switching-induced flow disturbances. This paper presents BiPneu, a scalable and cost-efficient multi-channel bipolar-pressure pneumatic system for soft robots that enables wide-range, accurate, and responsive pressure regulation while providing seamless compatibility with high-level software ecosystems. A dual-mode sliding-mode controller (DM-SMC) with hysteresis-supervised mode selection is proposed based on a hybrid electro-pneumatic model. Extensive simulation and experiments demonstrate the superior performance of DM-SMC in tracking step and sinusoidal pressure references compared with both advanced model predictive controllers and well-tuned PID controllers. Experimental results show average absolute errors of 1.44 kPa in multi-step tests and 4.23 kPa in sinusoidal tracking, corresponding to reductions of 11.9% and 35.6% relative to PID control, along with improved control effort, valve switching rate, and transient response. Robustness of DM-SMC is further verified on a bellow actuator with pressure-dependent volume. Finally, BiPneu's capability is demonstrated via two soft robotic examples, quick ball-maneuvering with a soft parallel manipulator and real-time finite element method (FEM)-based teleoperation of a soft bellows actuator.

</details>


### [209] [FOUND-IT: Foundation-model-first Task-driven 3D Scene Graphs with Granularity on Demand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25371)
*Dominic Maggio,Nicolas Gorlo,Kris Hauser,Luca Carlone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了FOUND-IT，首个利用未标定单目相机实时构建层次化任务驱动3D场景图的方法。该方法通过几何基础模型估计场景图属性，并创新性地在模型中添加额外头来直接重建可遍历性信息。与传统方法不同，FOUND-IT支持任务列表动态演化而不预定义固定，可根据操作或导航等任务自动调整物体的粒度。在ASHiTA SG3D任务接地基准上准确率提升79%，并在Jetson Thor地面机器人上实现实时运行，同时在YouTube公寓游览视频上展示了鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D场景图构建方法通常假设预定义且固定的任务列表，无法适应机器人运行过程中任务动态变化的真实场景。本文旨在解决这一局限性，使机器人能够在复杂操作-导航混合任务中根据任务展开动态调整场景表示。

Method: 利用几何基础模型（如VGGT）估计场景图的几何属性，并通过添加额外头来直接重建可遍历性信息（场景图的"places"层）。采用任务驱动方式，根据具体任务（如操作任务关注小物体、导航任务关注大物体）自动调整物体和区域的粒度。包含一个智能体查询机制来检索场景图中的信息。

Result: 在ASHiTA SG3D任务接地基准上达到79%的准确率提升；在Jetson Thor地面机器人上实现实时运行；在YouTube随意拍摄的公寓游览视频上成功构建3D场景图，展示了方法的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: FOUND-IT首次实现了任务动态演化场景下的实时层次化3D场景图构建，突破了传统方法任务列表固定的限制，为复杂操作-导航任务提供了灵活的感知表示框架。

Abstract: We present the first approach to build hierarchical task-driven 3D scene graphs of arbitrary indoor or outdoor environments using an uncalibrated monocular camera in real-time. We leverage geometric foundation models to estimate geometric attributes of the scene graph (e.g., object bounding boxes), but we also observe that traversability information (the "places" layer of a scene graph) can be directly reconstructed by adding an extra head to existing geometric foundation models, like VGGT. Our approach is task-driven in the sense that we adjust the granularity of the objects and regions in the map depending on the task; for instance, during a manipulation task, our approach is able to resolve small knobs on a stove, while during a navigation task it can focus on large objects (e.g., the entire stove). However, in a major departure from related work, we consider the realistic case where the list of tasks is not predefined and fixed, but evolves as the robot operates. This naturally allows dealing with complex loco-manipulation tasks, where the robot can dynamically adjust its representation as the task unfolds. We dub the resulting approach FOUND-IT. FOUND-IT also includes an agentic approach to query information in the scene graph. In addition to achieving 79% higher accuracy on the ASHiTA SG3D task grounding benchmark, we demonstrate FOUND-IT runs in real-time on a ground robot using a Jetson Thor. Furthermore, to highlight the robustness of our method, we demonstrate constructing 3D scene graphs on casually captured realtor apartment tours from YouTube. Code will be made available upon publication.

</details>


### [210] [Adaptive Artificial Time-Delay Control with Barrier Lyapunov Constraints for Euler-Lagrange Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31405)
*Saksham Gupta,Rishabh Dev Yadav,Sarthak Mishra,Amitabh Sharma,Sourish Ganguly,Wei Pan,Spandan Roy,Simone Baldi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对欧拉-拉格朗日系统中与状态相关的不确定性和时变状态约束问题，提出一种结合时延估计与障碍李雅普诺夫函数的自适应控制框架，在五自由度机械臂上实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有控制设计难以同时解决欧拉-拉格朗日系统中与状态相关的不确定性补偿和时变状态约束施加问题，这在机器人领域是常见需求但尚未被充分满足。

Method: 提出自适应控制框架，结合人工时延估计策略与障碍李雅普诺夫函数；解析推导时延估计近似误差的状态相关上界，并构建自适应律在线估计其参数；利用障碍李雅普诺夫函数控制器强制满足位置和速度的时变约束。

Result: 通过李雅普诺夫分析证明系统稳定性，并在五自由度机械臂上实验验证，与现有方法相比，能够在动态不确定性下严格遵守安全关键约束。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效同时处理状态相关不确定性与时变约束，无需先验模型知识，适用于安全关键的机器人应用场景。

Abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of simultaneously compensating for state-dependent uncertainties and enforcing time-varying state constraints in Euler-Lagrange systems, a common requirement in robotics that remains underserved by existing control designs. A novel adaptive control framework is developed that combines an artificial time-delay-based uncertainty estimation strategy, also known as time-delay estimation, with a barrier Lyapunov function to enforce constraint-aware control design. Specifically, a state-dependent upper bound on the time-delay estimation approximation error is analytically formulated, and an adaptive law is constructed to estimate its parameters online, enabling real-time state-dependent uncertainty compensation without relying on prior model knowledge. To ensure constraint compliance, the barrier Lyapunov function-based controller enforces time-varying bounds on both position and velocity. The resulting architecture is provably stable via Lyapunov analysis. Experimental results on a five-degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator validate the framework's capability, compared with the state of the art, in maintaining strict adherence to safety-critical constraints under dynamic uncertainties.

</details>


### [211] [AgenticRL: Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03963)
*Roohan Ahmed Khan,Yasheerah Yaqoot,Amir Atef Habel,Muhammad Ahsan Mustafa,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AgenticRL框架，利用多模态GPT智能体自动生成奖励函数、训练策略并闭环优化，在UAV导航任务中实现比初始奖励提升71%的性能，真实世界成功率达91%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习在自主导航中依赖人工设计的奖励函数和反复手动调参，耗时且无法保证任务成功率，亟需提升奖励设计与策略优化的自动化程度。

Method: AgenticRL使用多模态GPT智能体：1) 解读任务信息和视觉场景生成奖励函数；2) 用PPO训练策略；3) 作为评论家通过诊断包评估策略并生成反馈；4) 闭环识别失败模式并优化奖励函数；5) 推理时根据真实图像和语言任务信息自动选择策略执行。

Result: 闭环精炼策略相比初始奖励性能提升71%；真实世界成功率达91%，sim-to-real准确率达94%。

Conclusion: AgenticRL通过GPT驱动的自主奖励设计和闭环策略优化，显著提升了UAV导航任务的自动化程度与部署效果，验证了sim-to-real迁移的有效性。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained transformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.

</details>


### [212] [CoRe-MoE: Contrastive Reweighted Mixture of Experts for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Locomotion with Gait Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04718)
*Kailun Huang,Zikang Xie,Yanzhe Xie,Panpan Liao,Fanghai Zhang,Yanheng Mai,Wenhao Xu,Yunheng Wang,Renjing Xu,Haohui Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CoRe-MoE框架，通过两阶段强化学习解耦步态生成与地形适应，先学习稳定的行走/跑步步态策略，再引入地形感知的MoE分支并用对比学习促进专家专业化，最终通过加权融合实现平滑步态转换与多地形适应，在仿真和Unitree G1人形机器人上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人需要在复杂地形上实现行走与跑步的平滑过渡，但单策略中步态转换与多地形适应存在任务间梯度干扰和地形分布偏移问题；虽然MoE架构可缓解多技能干扰，但直接联合训练难以实现清晰的专家专业化。

Method: 提出CoRe-MoE两阶段强化学习框架：第一阶段学习稳定的基础步态策略（行走、跑步及平滑过渡）；第二阶段引入地形感知的MoE分支，通过对比学习目标训练门控网络以学习结构化地形表示并促进专家专业化，最终通过加权融合基础步态策略与地形感知分支得到动作输出。

Result: 仿真实验在成功率、运动稳定性和多地形适应性上优于基线方法；零样本部署到Unitree G1人形机器人，在楼梯、斜坡、台阶、障碍物及非结构化户外地形上实现了稳健的行走和跑步，并保持了精确的足部落脚点控制与动态稳定性。

Conclusion: CoRe-MoE通过两阶段解耦训练有效解决了步态生成与地形适应之间的干扰问题，MoE+对比学习实现了专家专业化，该方法在人形机器人多地形鲁棒 locomotion 上表现出显著优势。

Abstract: Humans primarily rely on walking and running to traverse complex terrains. Similarly, humanoid robots should be able to smoothly transition between walking and running while maintaining natural and stable locomotion. However, unifying gait transition and multi-terrain adaptation within a single policy remains challenging due to gradient interference between tasks and the distribution shift caused by terrain variations. Although Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can mitigate multi-skill interference, direct joint training often fails to achieve clear expert specialization. To address these challenges, we propose CoRe-MoE, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that decouples gait generation from terrain adaptation. In the first stage, a stable locomotion policy is learned to produce natural walking and running behaviors with smooth transitions. In the second stage, a terrain-aware MoE branch is introduced, and the gating network is trained with a contrastive objective to learn structured terrain representations and promote expert specialization. The final action is obtained through weighted fusion of the base gait policy and the terrain-aware branch, enabling the policy to preserve stable locomotion while adapting to complex terrains. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms baseline approaches in terms of success rate, locomotion stability, and multi-terrain adaptability. Furthermore, zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot validates the effectiveness of our framework, achieving robust walking and running across stairs, slopes, steps, obstacles, and unstructured outdoor terrains while maintaining accurate foothold control and dynamic stability.

</details>


### [213] [CADENCE: Predicting Realized MAPF Execution Time Beyond Sum of Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04746)
*Abhishek S,Badrikanath Praharaj,Sreeram MV*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过480次硬件实验，系统评估了不同计划特征（SoC、原始运动负担、交互协调结构）对MAPF实际执行完成时间的预测能力，发现原始运动负担是SoC之外最可靠的补充信号，可将MAE降低48.6%-59.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MAPF评估指标（如SoC、makespan、运行时间）不能准确反映实际机器人执行性能，存在评估差距，亟需研究哪些执行前可获得的特征最能预测真实的执行完成时间。

Method: 在7×7工作单元中使用7台差分驱动机器人，生成120个计划（15个场景，每个执行4次，共480次试验），采用场景留出岭回归模型和试验级混合效应模型，比较SoC、总计划行进成本、原始运动负担（makespan、转弯数、连续移动、启停转换）和交互感知协调结构（依赖链接、交互机器人对、依赖深度、拥挤暴露）的预测能力。

Result: SoC单独具有信息性但不完整；原始运动负担提供最强改进，相对仅SoC模型MAE降低48.6%-59.8%，RMSE降低44.2%-61.4%；交互感知协调特征增益较小且不一致；原始运动负担是SoC之外最可靠的补充信号。

Conclusion: 大部分执行时间差距在机器人开始运动前已可从离线计划中观测到，原始运动负担是最稳定的预测增强特征。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) algorithms are increasingly used to plan motion for robot teams in industrial warehouses and robotic shared workspaces, but standard MAPF algorithm evaluation metrics, such as Sum of Costs (SoC), makespan, and planner runtime, can obscure how planner choices translate into realistic execution performance. We present CADENCE (Coordination and Action-Driven Estimation for Networked Continuous Execution), a hardware study of this evaluation gap on a fixed 7 by 7 workcell with seven differential drive robots, asking which features available before execution can best predict final wall-clock completion time. We compare SoC, total planned travel cost, primitive motion burden (how much basic motion the plan requires, such as makespan, turns, consecutive moves, and start-stop transitions), and interaction aware coordination structure (how much inter-robot coordination the plan induces, such as dependency links, interacting robot pairs, dependency depth, and crowding exposure). To test this, we generate 120 plans across 15 scenarios -- 5 Empty, 5 Medium Random, and 5 Bottleneck and execute each plan four times, yielding a 480 trial hardware corpus. Using both a scenario-held -- out ridge model and a trial-level mixed-effects model, we find that SoC alone is informative but incomplete, while primitive motion burden gives the strongest improvement, reducing held out error by about 48.6%-59.8% in MAE and 44.2%-61.4% in RMSE relative to SoC-only models. Interaction-aware coordination features add smaller, less uniform gains, most clearly in the mixed-effects analysis. Across both models and uncertainty checks, primitive motion burden is the most reliable additional signal beyond SoC, suggesting that much of the execution time gap is already visible in the offline plan before any robot starts moving.

</details>


### [214] [Discrete-WAM: Unified Discrete Vision-Action Token Editing for World-Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05645)
*Ziyang Yao,Haochen Liu,Yuncheng Jiang,Zeyu Zhu,Zibin Guo,Jingru Wang,Tianle Liu,Jianwei Cui,Kuiyuan Yang,Hongwei Xie,Jingwei Zhao,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Discrete-WAM是一个统一的离散视觉-动作世界-策略框架，通过在共享token空间中联合训练世界模型、世界策略模型和策略模型，并采用分层决策预测与并行动作token编辑，实现自动驾驶中的可控未来生成、反事实评估和高效并行策略解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的端到端自动驾驶方法大多依赖直接的观测到动作的模仿学习，缺乏对自我行为如何影响未来世界演化的推理能力；同时，现有的世界模型与下游策略生成之间的对齐较弱，导致世界模型的预测结果难以直接支持策略决策。

Method: 1) 构建统一的离散token空间，将视觉观测、未来状态、高层决策和自车动作统一表示为离散token；2) 通过多任务和多阶段预训练，联合训练世界建模、世界策略建模和策略建模；3) 下游规划中，将策略生成分解为分层决策预测和并行动作token编辑，决策token提供高层规划骨架，置信度调度机制高效细化密集的未来动作。

Result: 在大规模自动驾驶基准上，Discrete-WAM实现了强大的规划性能，并支持可控未来生成、反事实评估、基于惊奇的世界模型分析以及高效的并行策略解码。

Conclusion: 离散表征对齐、统一的世界-策略训练以及分层token编辑为物理AI提供了一种有前景的设计范式。

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires reasoning about how ego actions shape future world evolution, rather than merely mapping observations to actions. However, most end-to-end methods rely on direct state-to-action imitation, while existing world models often remain weakly aligned with downstream policy generation. We introduce Discrete-WAM, a unified discrete vision-action world-policy framework that represents visual observations, future states, high-level decisions, and ego actions within a shared token space. Built on this discrete alignment, Discrete-WAM jointly trains world modeling, world-policy modeling, and policy modeling through multi-task and multi-stage pretraining, allowing action-conditioned future prediction to directly support policy generation. For downstream planning, Discrete-WAM further decomposes policy generation into hierarchical decision prediction and parallel action-token editing, where the decision token provides a high-level planning skeleton and confidence-based scheduling refines dense future actions efficiently. Experiments on large-scale autonomous-driving benchmarks show that Discrete-WAM achieves strong planning performance while supporting controllable future generation, counterfactual evaluation, surprise-based world-model analysis, and efficient parallel policy decoding. These results suggest that discrete representation alignment, unified world-policy training, and hierarchical token editing provide a promising design paradigm for physical AI.

</details>


### [215] [VOLT: Vision and Language Trajectory Segmentation for Faster-than-Demonstration Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06323)
*Robert Ramirez Sanchez,Daniel J. Evans,Dylan P. Losey,Siddarth Jain*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出VOLT方法，通过视觉-语言轨迹分割，选择性下采样演示数据中的可加速部分，使机器人能够学习比演示更快的执行策略，在提升速度的同时保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示任务所需时间通常长于机器人执行所需时间，而许多实际应用要求机器人尽可能快地完成任务，而非简单复现演示的速度。因此需要学习比演示更快的操作策略。

Method: 提出VOLT，一种基于视觉和语言的轨迹分割方法。它先对视频演示进行推理，利用上下文线索判断哪些片段可以加速（如无约束运动）、哪些需要缓慢精确操作（如物体交互），然后选择性下采样可加速片段，生成加速后的轨迹，再结合扩散策略等模仿学习方法进行策略学习。

Result: 实验表明，均匀下采样整个轨迹存在问题，而VOLT的分割质量至关重要。与基线方法相比，VOLT使机器人能够更快地执行任务，同时保持较强的任务性能，优于其他替代方法。

Conclusion: 分段质量是加速学习的关键；选择性下采样（而非均匀下采样）结合高质量分割，可以显著提升机器人执行速度而不牺牲性能。

Abstract: Humans often take longer to demonstrate a task than a robot would need to execute it. Rather than learning to replicate the demonstration at the same pace, many industrial and practical applications require robots to perform tasks as quickly as possible. In this paper, we investigate several hypotheses for learning policies that operate faster-than-demonstrations. Our experiments show that the most effective strategy is to downsample recorded demonstrations and train the robot's policy on this accelerated data. However, uniformly downsampling an entire trajectory can be problematic. Some parts of a task can be safely sped up (e.g., unconstrained motion), while others demand slower, more precise motion (e.g., object interactions or fine manipulation). To address this challenge, we introduce VOLT, a vision-and-language trajectory segmentation method that reasons over video demonstrations, and leverages contextual cues to determine when acceleration is appropriate and when careful precision is required. VOLT identifies segments where slow, deliberate motion is necessary, then selectively downsamples the remaining segments. The resulting reformatted trajectories can be used with standard imitation learning approaches, such as diffusion policies. Our results highlight that segmentation quality is critical -- baseline methods often misidentify when acceleration is possible, leading to overly cautious or unreliable policies. Compared to state-of-the-art alternatives, VOLT allows robots to execute tasks faster while maintaining strong performance.

</details>


### [216] [HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06493)
*Lizhi Yang,Junheng Li,Nehar Poddar,Yiling Hou,Gio Huh,Robert Griffin,Georgia Gkioxari,Aaron Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出HANDOFF，一种基于紧凑显式接口的人形机器人全身控制器，通过多教师KL蒸馏和专家混合策略整合运动跟踪、行走和跌倒恢复三个专家，在Unitree G1上实现了与SOTA匹配的速度跟踪和最大的鲁棒操作工作空间之一，并支持VLM驱动的自然语言任务规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全身控制器通常需要密集的运动学或空间参考信息，而任务规划器难以从任务语义中合成这些信息。需要一种紧凑、直观、通用且表达力强的接口来弥合任务规划与全身控制之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出HANDOFF框架：(1) 设计紧凑显式的命令空间接口；(2) 通过上下文条件门控机制的多教师KL蒸馏，将三个互补专家（全身运动跟踪（安全滤波数据）、行走、跌倒恢复）蒸馏为混合专家学生模型。

Result: 在Unitree G1上达到与SOTA匹配的速度跟踪性能，提供最大的鲁棒操作工作空间之一；通过VLM驱动的智能体规划器实现了多种自然语言驱动的任务执行，无需任务特定数据或控制器微调。

Conclusion: HANDOFF证明了紧凑显式接口结合多教师蒸馏在人形机器人全身控制中的有效性，实现了从任务语义到关节层控制的高效映射，且具备良好的泛化性和硬件可行性。

Abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse loco-manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.

</details>


### [217] [Deterministic Execution of ROS 2 Applications via Lingua Franca](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09203)
*Harun Teper,Shaokai Lin,Shulu Li,Edward A. Lee,Jian-Jia Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，能将未经修改的ROS 2应用自动转换为Lingua Franca (LF)程序，利用LF的逻辑时间机制实现确定性执行，解决了ROS 2中回调执行顺序非确定性和分布式部署非确定性问题，并在Autoware系统上验证了其能够产生确定的执行顺序和一致的端到端延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ROS 2的发布-订阅通信模式存在固有的非确定性：单个执行器内回调执行顺序非确定，分布式部署中消息交错和网络延迟进一步引入非确定性，导致并发问题且难以进行安全性分析和提供保证。

Method: 首先识别ROS 2中可在逻辑时间下确定性执行的特征，然后构建自动转换框架，从ROS 2应用中提取信息并直接转换为LF程序，利用LF的逻辑时间延迟、联邦执行和故障处理等特性实现确定性执行，且无需修改ROS 2代码。

Result: 在合成示例和Autoware基准系统上评估表明：默认ROS 2中回调执行顺序存在差异且端到端延迟变化，而LF控制的ROS 2系统产生确定的执行顺序和一致的端到端延迟。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效消除ROS 2系统的非确定性，实现时序可预测的确定性执行，为ROS 2应用的安全性分析和保证提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) is a widely used middleware for robotic systems, characterized by a publish-subscribe (pub-sub) communication mechanism in which computation is structured as callbacks dispatched by ROS 2 executors. Despite its popularity, the pub-sub pattern in ROS 2 is inherently nondeterministic: the order in which these callbacks run is nondeterministic even within a single executor, and distributed deployments add further nondeterminism from the interleaving of messages across nodes and from network latency. Such nondeterminism often leads to concurrency issues and makes it virtually impossible to analyze for safeness and provide guarantees.
  We present a framework that is able to convert an unmodified ROS 2 application and run it under Lingua Franca (LF), a coordination language for deterministic execution using logical time, so that the same input always produces the same deterministic execution order. We first describe which ROS 2 features can be executed deterministically under logical time. Such features enable the possibility to establish an automatic conversion framework to extract information from a ROS 2 application and directly convert it into an LF program. The rich features of LF, such as logical-time delays, federated execution across processes, and fault handling, can then be applied to make the ROS 2 application be executed in a deterministic and timing-predictable manner without changing the ROS 2 code. We evaluate the framework on a synthetic example and on the Autoware reference system. We show that the order in which callbacks are executed differs in default ROS 2, while also having end-to-end latencies that vary across executions. In contrast, our LF-controlled ROS 2 system produces a deterministic execution order and consistent end-to-end latencies.

</details>

### [218] [Leveraging Social Media Data for COVID-19 Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10459)
*Nur Hafieza Ismail,Nur Shazwani Kamarudin,Nurol Husna Che Rose*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 该章节综述了COVID-19疫情期间社交媒体平台的使用情况，分析了用户披露内容中的语言、视觉和情感指标，分类介绍了使用的社交媒体数据类型，并系统阐述了所采用的机器学习、特征工程、自然语言处理和调查研究方法，最后指出了未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体已成为信息传播的主要渠道，尤其疫情期间用户大量依赖其获取COVID-19相关资讯。鉴于全球约46亿用户产生的海量信息对公众认知和应对疫情产生显著影响，有必要系统梳理社交媒体在疫情中的使用模式、用户表达特征及分析方法。

Method: 采用综述方法，系统分类社交媒体数据类型，引入多种机器学习算法、特征工程技术、自然语言处理方法及调查研究方法，对用户披露内容中的语言、视觉和情感指标进行分析。

Result: 系统梳理了COVID-19疫情期间社交媒体数据的使用分类，总结了语言、视觉和情感三类用户表达指标，归纳了主流分析技术方法体系。

Conclusion: 社交媒体在适当使用下可成为传播可靠信息和提升公众意识的数字工具，未来研究可进一步优化多模态分析方法以更深入理解用户行为与疫情认知之间的关系。

Abstract: Nowadays, social media networks have become widely preferred sources of information. Especially during the time of the Coronavirus disease 2019 COVID 19 pandemic, social media has been one of the most used platforms to get the latest news and information related to COVID 19. Social media are popular because they offer free access to their registered users and allow them to do posting, disseminate information, and respond to others postings. With almost 4.6 billion social media users worldwide, it is not surprising the significant amount of information shared through these platforms could affect how people perceive and cope with the pandemic that we are facing right now. With decent use, social media can be a beneficial digital tool to spread reliable news and public awareness for patients, clinicians, and society. Specifically, this chapter describes linguistic, visual, and emotional indicators expressed in user disclosures. Thus, in this chapter, the related studies of social media platforms usage during the COVID 19 pandemic are explored and discussed in detail. This chapter also categorizes social media data used, introduces different deployed machine learning, feature engineering, natural language processing, and survey methods, and outlines directions for future research.

</details>


### [219] [From Stacks to Circuits: A Regenerative Socio-Technical Roadmap for AI Infrastructure within Planetary Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10544)
*Han-Teng Liao,Karen Ang*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 当前以线性供应堆栈为特征的生成式AI扩展轨迹，在追求性能密度的同时将大量热力学和材料成本外部化。本研究提出一个再生式社会技术路线图，将AI基础设施重新定义为受行星边界约束的系统之系统，通过代谢回路框架将"价值与需求"置于生产-消费关系循环的中心，并构建了替代Nvidia中心化路线的竞争性参考架构，为数字循环经济中的资源节约和行星问责提供了可行路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着绿色与数字化转型的"双转型"加速，AI行业的线性扩展模式面临范围三排放、电子垃圾回收等技术缺口，导致社会紧张局势。现有Nvidia中心化的路线图存在关键缺陷，无法解决可持续扩展问题，亟需一个新的参考架构来弥合这些差距。

Method: 将可持续生产和消费系统地图重新用于AI基础设施，将其重构为受行星边界治理的系统之系统；整合IEEE IRDS的半导体设施可持续性考量；提出以"价值与需求"为核心的代谢回路框架，构建生产与消费关系循环。

Result: 识别了当前Nvidia中心化路线图的关键差距，提出了一个竞争性参考架构，展示了资源节约和行星问责的自发秩序如何为数字循环经济中的监管合规和产业韧性提供可行路径。

Conclusion: 再生式社会技术路线图能够为AI行业的可持续扩展提供实践路径，通过将行星边界作为治理约束、将价值观嵌入代谢回路，实现绿色与数字双转型的协调推进。

Abstract: Current scaling trajectories for Generative AI, typified by linear supply-side "stacks," prioritize performance density while externalizing significant thermodynamic and material costs. As the "Twin Transition" of green and digital transformation accelerates, the industry faces technology gaps - including Scope 3 emissions and e-waste recycling - that impede sustainable scaling and lead to social tensions. This study proposes a Regenerative Socio-Technical roadmap that repurposes the Sustainable Production and Consumption system map to reframe artificial intelligence infrastructure as a system-of-systems governed ultimately by planetary limits. By integrating the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers International Roadmap for Devices and Systems (IEEE IRDS) sustainability considerations for semiconductor facilities, the study proposes a metabolic circuit framework that centers "Values and Needs" within production and consumption relationship loops. This study identifies critical gaps in current Nvidia-centric roadmaps and proposes a competing reference architecture. It demonstrates how a spontaneous order of resource parsimony and planetary accountability can provide an actionable pathway for regulatory compliance and industrial resilience in the digital circular economy.

</details>


### [220] [Platform Sorting Drives Ideological Fragmentation in the Social Media Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10575)
*Edoardo Di Martino,Alessandro Galeazzi,Matteo Cinelli,Michele Starnini,Walter Quattrociocchi*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本研究通过分析2020和2024年美国大选期间六大社交媒体平台（Bluesky、Facebook、Reddit、Truth Social、Twitter/X、YouTube）上的政治信息动态，发现意识形态碎片化并非局部现象，而是发生在整个平台层面。用户倾向于与意识形态一致的环境对齐，形成从极左到极右的稳定平台意识形态谱系，且这种平台分选是社交媒体生态系统的持久结构性特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究通常将在线政治传播中的意识形态不对称视为社区内部的局部现象，本文旨在证明碎片化实际上发生在整个平台层面，并揭示用户与意识形态一致环境对齐的平台分选过程。

Method: 结合内容分享、参与度分配和用户层面意识形态取向等测量指标，分析了2020年和2024年美国总统大选期间Bluesky、Facebook、Reddit、Truth Social、Twitter/X和YouTube六大平台的政治信息动态，并进行了跨平台比较和纵向分析。

Result: 意识形态碎片化在所有平台上一致出现并持续存在；各平台展现出从极左到极右的稳定意识形态特征，且在两届选举周期中保持；持久用户群体的意识形态变异性有限，表明单一平台内的表观变化实际反映了生态系统层面的分选而非趋向中立。

Conclusion: 平台分选不是对政治事件或审核干预的短暂反应，而是社交媒体生态系统的持久结构性特征。

Abstract: Ideological asymmetries in online political communication are often studied as localized phenomena emerging within communities. Here, we show that fragmentation instead operates at the level of entire platforms, consistent with a process of platform sorting in which users increasingly align with ideologically congruent environments. We analyze political information dynamics across Bluesky, Facebook, Reddit, Truth Social, Twitter/X, and YouTube during the 2020 and 2024 US presidential elections, combining measures of content sharing, engagement allocation, and user-level ideological orientation. Across platforms, ideological fragmentation emerges consistently and persists over time. Platforms exhibit distinct ideological profiles that persist across the two election cycles, ranging from strongly left-leaning to strongly right-leaning environments. Longitudinal analyses further reveal limited ideological variability among persistent user cohorts, indicating that apparent changes within single platforms reflect ecosystem-level sorting rather than convergence toward neutrality. Taken together, our results show that the dynamics of platform sorting is not a transient reaction to political events or moderation interventions, but a persistent structural feature of the social media ecosystem.

</details>

### [221] [The Empirically Grounded Adaptive Virtual Patient for Psychotherapy Training: Disclosure That Responds to Therapist Micro-Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10051)
*Angela Chen,Siwei Jin,Catherine Bao,Canwen Wang,Robert E. Kraut,Tongshuang Wu,Haiyi Zhu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 提出自适应虚拟患者（AVP），通过结构方程模型（基于近2000小时真实心理治疗转录数据）驱动披露行为动态调整，使LLM生成的患者话语能随治疗师共情和探索技能变化，在20名临床医生的80次会话评估中验证了其自适应有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模拟患者系统要么遵循固定脚本，要么依赖LLM在长会话中漂移不稳定，缺乏根据受训者技能水平自适应调整披露行为的机制。

Method: 构建结构方程模型（基于近2000小时真实心理治疗转录），量化治疗师共情和探索行为对患者开放度的影响；动态模块每轮更新披露水平，LLM据此生成患者话语；与纯提示基线及消融实验对比验证。

Result: AVP的披露水平随治疗师共情和探索行为上升，而纯提示基线保持平坦；消融实验确认经验性参数化优于替代方案，其中探索行为携带大部分自适应信号。

Conclusion: 基于真实数据驱动的动态披露模型能有效实现模拟患者对治疗师技能的自适应响应，为心理治疗微技能培训提供可扩展方案。

Abstract: Simulated patients offer a scalable way to train psychotherapy micro-skills such as empathic responding and exploratory probing, but current systems either follow fixed scripts or rely on LLMs that drift unpredictably over long sessions. We present the Adaptive Virtual Patient (AVP), which adapts its disclosure behavior -- from guarded, through moderate openness, to full disclosure -- in response to trainee skill. The AVP is grounded in a structural equation model fit to nearly 2{,}000 hours of real-world psychotherapy transcripts, which quantifies how therapist empathy and exploration shift a patient's openness over time. An LLM generates the AVP's utterances conditioned on a disclosure level that the dynamics module updates each turn. In an evaluation with 20 clinicians and trainees over 80 sessions (1{,}033 turns), the AVP's disclosure rises in response to therapist empathy and exploration, while a prompt-only baseline stays flat; ablations confirm that the empirically motivated parameterization outperforms alternatives, with exploration carrying most of the adaptive signal.

</details>


### [222] ["Where is this coming from?" Uncovering Trustworthiness Ideals in AI-powered Peripartum Information Seeking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10158)
*Vaibhav Balloli,Julia Erickson,Xinyi Li,Erin MacMurray van Liemt,Alex Peahl,Elizabeth Bondi-Kelly*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过24名围产期利益相关者（分娩者、临床医生、健康工作者）的焦点小组，发现高风险的孕产妇健康AI系统需具备可检查的信任机制，而非仅宣称可信。研究提出四点治理要求：支持社会身份感知、多元验证实践、可检查的治理与申诉机制、生态整合避免负担转移，并设计"不信任感知"的人机交互方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 美国在可预防孕产妇死亡方面领先发达国家且存在严重种族差异，现有AI健康信息系统虽能提供事实性回答，但忽视了影响信任、使用与实际伤害的社会技术治理结构。

Method: 开展4次同步焦点小组（24名参与者），涵盖分娩者、临床医生、健康工作者三类利益相关者，围绕信息寻求、临床基础设施体验、错误信息及AI事实回答工具设计探针进行讨论，采用归纳分析法。

Result: 在高风险健康场景中，可信赖性必须可检查而非仅被宣称；利益相关者对信息可信度的认知存在分歧，但在透明度、申诉机制和生态系统互补性上达成共识；识别出四项主题和治理要求。

Conclusion: 提出"不信任感知"的设计方案和原则性治理机制，以构建透明、多元的AI系统，并讨论了研究对扩展人机评估和改进部署AI系统透明度的意义。

Abstract: AI-powered tools increasingly promise to fill information gaps in health, especially in domains like maternal and reproductive health that demand timely, accurate, and actionable information. This is extremely important, as the United States leads peer nations in preventable deaths, with stark racial disparities. However, current AI and NLP-powered systems aim to improve access to vetted maternal health information by routing user queries to a factual response while under-specifying the socio-technical governance structures that shape trust, use, and harm in practice. We report findings from four synchronous focus groups ($n=24$) with three stakeholder groups central to peripartum information support: birthing people, clinicians, and health workers (e.g., doulas, social workers, community health workers) exploring topics around information seeking, experience with current clinical infrastructure, misinformation, and an AI-enabled factual answering tool design probe. Our inductive analysis surfaces a central finding: in high-stakes health contexts shaped by historical inequities, trustworthiness must be inspectable and not asserted. While stakeholders diverge on what makes information credible, they converge on the need for transparency, recourse, and ecosystem complementarity. Based on the discussions, we identify four themes and governance requirements: (1) support for social and identity-based sensemaking, (2) pluralistic verification practices, (3) inspectable governance with recourse mechanisms, and (4) ecosystem-aware integration that avoids shifting burden. Building on these findings, we propose design artifacts that are mistrust-aware and promote principled governance mechanisms for transparent, pluralistic AI systems. Finally, we discuss the implications of our findings for expanding human-AI evaluations and improving the transparency of deployed AI systems.

</details>


### [223] [AnnotateThis: Analyzing a human-LLM system for annotating social media data with the concept of climate change mitigation pessimism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10210)
*Zexuan Li,Derek Van Berkel,Ariel Hasell,Grant Schoenebeck,John Barry Ryan,Sabina Tomkins*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出 AnnotateThis，一个以人为中心的系统，帮助研究人员检查和改进 LLM 的标注质量（称为 LLM grounding）。系统在两种场景下评估：无 ground truth（同时进行概念规范和 LLM grounding）和有 ground truth（概念已明确）。结果显示，使用该系统后标注质量显著提升，F1 和准确率分别比全自动 prompt 优化方法高出 0.15 和 0.23。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 难以处理计算社会科学（CSS）中复杂细微的概念，CSS 社区呼吁开发以人为中心的系统，将人类纳入 LLM 支持的科研流程中，以提升标注质量。

Method: 开发 AnnotateThis 系统，为计算科学家和社会科学家提供多种信息特征以检查 LLM 标注的质量和可靠性。在两种设定下评估：（1）无 ground truth，用户同时进行概念规范和 LLM grounding；（2）有 ground truth，概念已明确，LLM grounding 任务更直接。

Result: 在两种设定下，用户均能提升 LLM 标注质量。有 ground truth 时，相比全自动 prompt 优化方法，F1 提升 0.15，准确率提升 0.23。

Conclusion: 以人为中心的 LLM grounding 方法能有效提升 LLM 在复杂概念上的标注质量，优于完全自动化的方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into research workflows. However, LLMs have been shown to struggle with difficult and nuanced concepts such as those found in computational social science (CSS) research. Within the CSS community, there has been a call for new systems to be developed which center humans in LLM-supported scientific workflows. We develop AnnotateThis, a human-centered system for inspecting and improving LLM annotations, a process we refer to as LLM grounding for a target concept. AnnotateThis is developed with both computational and social scientists to reflect existing workflows for data annotation. It includes a range of information features for users to interrogate the quality and reliability of LLM annotations. We evaluate our system in two settings. In the first, we assume a researcher may not have access to ground truth data and that users of AnnotateThis have limited prior knowledge of the concept they would like an LLM to annotate. That is, they may be conducting concept specification and LLM grounding simultaneously. In the second setting, we assume access to ground truth labels and that the concept is specified for a given annotation task; here, the task of LLM grounding is more straightforward. We find that in both settings users can improve the quality of LLM annotations with AnnotateThis and that their final annotations far surpass those created without human intervention. For example, when we evaluate with ground truth labels, we see an absolute improvement of 0.15 in F-Measure and 0.23 in accuracy over a fully automated state-of-the-art method for prompt refinement.

</details>


### [224] [Accounting for AI Inference in Corporate GHG Inventories: A Four-Tier Methodology for Scope 3 Category 1 Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10660)
*Guillermo Llopis*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个四层框架，用于核算AI推理服务的Scope 3 Category 1碳排放，解决现有EEIO方法高估10-40倍的问题。应用于200人欧洲企业，总排放量低于1 tCO2e，并揭示了水电主导电网的碳-水权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI推理服务（API订阅、企业聊天工具、SaaS产品）明确属于CSRD Scope 3 Category 1范围，但缺乏标准化核算方法。现有做法要么忽略该类别，要么使用针对整个ICT行业的通用EEIO因子，导致高估AI推理排放10-40倍。

Method: 提出四层框架：(1) 基于token的物理估算（GPU能耗基准+区域电网碳强度）；(2) 基于token的EEIO；(3) 基于支出的物理估算；(4) 基于支出的EEIO（兜底方案）。排放因子来自ML.ENERGY Leaderboard v3、EPA eGRID 2023、Ember 2023及Li et al. (2025)的WUE数据。

Result: 应用于200人欧洲企业，总排放量低于1 tCO2e，表明合规挑战在于方法论而非排放量级。发现碳-水权衡：瑞典水电主导电网碳排放最低但水足迹最高。

Conclusion: 需要标准化的AI推理排放核算方法论；当前ESG工具未能揭示的碳-水权衡对数据中心选址策略有直接影响。

Abstract: AI inference services -- API subscriptions, enterprise chat tools, and SaaS products with embedded AI features -- fall unambiguously within Scope 3 Category 1 under the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), which requires disclosure for fiscal years starting January 2024. Yet no standardised methodology exists for including them in corporate GHG inventories. Current practice either omits the category entirely or applies a generic economic input-output (EEIO) factor calibrated to the ICT sector as a whole, overestimating AI inference emissions by 10-40x relative to physically derived alternatives.
  We propose a four-tier framework that matches estimation precision to the data organisations can realistically obtain, progressing from direct token-based physical estimation -- using GPU energy benchmarks and regional grid carbon intensities -- down to a spend-based EEIO fallback for services where no usage data exists. Emission factors are derived from peer-reviewed GPU energy benchmarks (ML.ENERGY Leaderboard v3), confirmed grid carbon intensities (EPA eGRID 2023; Ember 2023), and published water use effectiveness data (Li et al., 2025). Applied to a 200-person European firm, the framework yields a total below 1 tCO2e, illustrating that the compliance challenge is methodological rather than magnitude-driven. We further document a water-carbon trade-off that current ESG tools do not surface: Sweden's hydro-dominated grid delivers the lowest carbon intensity in our dataset but the highest water footprint, with direct implications for data centre location strategy.

</details>


### [225] [The Agentic Web Requires New Normative Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10711)
*Cameron Pattison,Matthew Boulos,Noam Kolt,Changbai Li,Tiziano Piccardi,Seth Lazar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了代理网络（Agentic Web）的技术可行性及其面临的规范障碍。用户委托的AI代理在网络上代表用户行动时，常被过时的法律、服务条款和隐性做法所阻碍，且目前没有区分"恶意机器人"与经用户授权的AI代理。文章呼吁建立广泛接受的法律、规范和惯例体系，以推动代理网络的发展，并倡导制定政策允许用户授权的代理在合理范围内自由行动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理网络在技术层面已具备可行性，但现有的法律框架、服务条款和非正式惯例限制了用户委托的AI代理在线行动，且未区分恶意机器人与经授权的代理。为了释放代理网络的消费和社会效益，需要建立一套被广泛接受的规范基础设施。

Method: 本文采用规范性分析和政策倡导的方法，旨在引发社会层面的讨论，识别指导原则，并倡导有利于用户授权代理行动的政策。

Result: 本文识别了阻碍代理网络发展的核心问题：过时的法律、服务条款和隐性做法；缺乏对恶意机器人与合法授权代理的区分。提出了需要建立法律、规范和惯例的规范基础设施。

Conclusion: 代理网络的实现不仅需要技术基础设施，更需要规范基础设施。文章呼吁开展全社会范围的对话，确立规范性原则，并倡导制定允许用户授权代理合理行动的政策，以平衡各方合法利益。

Abstract: The agentic web, in which users interact with the internet largely through agents acting on their behalf, is now technically feasible. However, many of the consumer and social benefits that could be realized by online AI agents acting scrupulously in their principals' interest are currently obstructed by outdated laws, terms of service, and other less formal practices which allow online platforms to block and degrade agent access, often in secret. No distinction is currently drawn between "malicious bots" and AI agents acting with the express delegated authority of a user. For the agentic web to realize its promise, it needs not only the technical infrastructure of protocols and interfaces, but the normative infrastructure of a broadly-accepted and socially-beneficial set of laws, norms and practices governing agentic access to online properties. Building that normative infrastructure requires a society-wide conversation. This paper aims to help precipitate that conversation, to identify normative principles that can guide it, and to advocate for policies that enable users' appropriately delegated agents to act online on their behalf, with as few curbs on their doing so as is reasonable given the other legitimate interests at stake.

</details>


### [226] [Gender-based discrepancies in the algorithmic delivery of political ads on social media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10834)
*Dominik Bär,Francesco Corso,Gianmarco De Francisci Morales,Stefan Feuerriegel,Francesco Pierri*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究2024年欧洲议会选举期间政治广告投放的性别偏见。基于25个欧盟国家45万条广告、7亿次曝光的数据集，发现民粹主义和极右翼政党的广告显著更倾向于推送给男性（平均高出6个百分点），即使控制了广告内容、平台竞争和定向策略。这种算法偏见扭曲了政治信息传播的公平性，加剧了两极分化和性别政治参与差距，呼吁平台和政策制定者审计并保障算法投放的公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体已成为竞选政治广告的关键渠道，但算法投放中的偏见可能扭曲公众对政治信息的接触，损害公民做出知情选择的能力，破坏政治话语的平等获取，对选举程序的完整性构成威胁。

Method: 使用2024年欧洲议会选举期间大规模数据集（超过110,000条广告，来自453个政党和968名候选人，在25个欧盟国家产生超过70亿次曝光），通过统计分析检验政治广告投放中的性别歧视，控制广告内容、平台竞争和定向策略等因素。

Result: 男性显著更有可能看到民粹主义和极右翼政党的广告。在控制其他因素后，民粹主义政党的广告平均到达的男性比例高出6个百分点。

Conclusion: 算法投放中的性别不平衡限制了政党接触多元化受众的能力，阻碍选民平等参与政治讨论。极右翼和民粹主义广告可能加剧政治极化并扩大性别政治参与差距。需要平台和政策制定者对社交媒体政治广告的算法投放进行审计，并实施保障公平和保护民主进程的防护措施。

Abstract: Social media has become a key channel for political advertising during election campaigns. However, algorithmic biases in the delivery of these ads may distort the public's exposure to political messaging. This can hinder citizens' ability to make informed choices and undermine equal access to political discourse, raising concerns about the integrity of electoral processes. In this study, we examine gender-based discrimination in the delivery of political ads during the 2024 European Parliament elections. Using a large-scale dataset of over 110000 ads from 453 political parties and 968 candidates that generated over 7 billion impressions across 25 EU countries, we find that men were significantly more likely to be shown ads from populist and far-right parties than women -- even after accounting for ad content, platform-level competition, and targeting strategies. All else equal, ads by populist parties reach, on average, a 6 percentage point higher male share. Such imbalances restrict the ability of parties to reach diverse audiences and prevent voters from engaging equally with the full range of political viewpoints. This pattern is particularly concerning given that far-right and populist ads may reinforce political polarization and widen existing gender gaps in political engagement. Our findings underscore the need for platforms and policymakers to audit algorithmic ad delivery in political campaigns on social media and to implement safeguards that ensure fairness and protect democratic processes.

</details>


### [227] [From Prompt to Purchase: How AI Brand Recommendations Move Consumers on the Open Web](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10907)
*Michael Iannelli,Alan Ai*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 对话助手的品牌提及使未参与用户对该品牌的Google搜索增加4.3个百分点、官网访问增加2.4个百分点、零售商页面访问增加1.0个百分点。通过事件研究、立场分类器等克服混杂偏差后，偶然提及的影响大幅降低，而目标品牌的影响显著大于同响应中的其他同类品牌。这一上游曝光路径被传统归因方法遗漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话助手推荐品牌时，用户会产生后续搜索和访问行为，但传统网页日志无法归因于助手，且简单统计所有提及会因"偶然提及已有品牌"而产生混淆偏差。需要准确测量助手品牌提及的因果效应。

Method: 基于用户自愿加入的面板数据，将点击流与ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini对话记录关联。采用前瞻性事件研究、立场分类器（区分推荐性提及与偶然提及）、非用户条件限制、以及同响应内同类品牌对照。

Result: 推荐性品牌提及使Google搜索+4.3pp、官网访问+2.4pp、零售商页面+1.0pp。偶然提及效果大幅降低（+1.8/+1.1/+0.3）。目标品牌效果显著优于同响应中未提及的同类品牌。下游路径主要通过搜索中介，访问目的地分布与基线品牌行为一致。

Conclusion: 对话助手的品牌曝光推动未参与用户进入开放式品牌搜索和访问，该路径被传统引荐来源和最后点击归因完全遗漏，现有归因框架需要将上游曝光纳入测量。

Abstract: When a conversational assistant recommends a brand to a user with no recent observed engagement, that user's same-name Google search rises +4.3 percentage points (pp) [3.1, 5.5], visits to the brand's own site +2.4 pp [1.4, 3.5], and brand-specific retailer-page visits +1.0 pp [0.3, 1.7] over matched backward placebos. Recovering that estimate is the work. The mention creates a brand exposure no web log attributes to the assistant, and the naive all-mention funnel that seems to measure it is confounded: many mentions are incidental references to brands the user already uses ("your Netflix download"), whose downstream visits are that existing customer's own behavior and surface as a brand-specific pre-trend. We measure off-platform response on a panel that joins opt-in clickstream to the same users' ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini conversations, and isolate the effect with a pre-trend event study, a stance classifier, non-customer conditioning, and a within-response same-category control: incidental name-drops then move behavior far less (+1.8/+1.1/+0.3), and the named brand moves far more than unnamed same-category brands in the same response. The downstream path is mostly search-mediated and reaches both own sites and retailer pages, with a destination mix that tracks baseline brand-directed behavior rather than redirecting toward either. The design is observational and we do not observe transactions, so retail is purchase-adjacent. Standard referrer-based and last-click measurement miss this upstream exposure: assistants move observably-unengaged users into open-web brand navigation along a path attributed elsewhere.

</details>


### [228] [Dismantle and Dissolve, (Re)build, Remix: A Research-creation Inquiry into the Political Economy of Graphics Cards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10958)
*Cyrus Khalatbari*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于2022-2026年间的调查，运用研究-创作方法论（拆解、重建、混音），通过对台湾液氮超频者和加纳城市矿工的田野调查及对约50张显卡的实验，揭示GPU小型化背后的政治经济学、物质性和环境基础设施，旨在打开AI的黑箱并阐明其对可持续发展的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重新思考人工智能及其社会技术纠缠需要揭开显卡（GPU）这一技术黑箱，因为GPU小型化既是物联网的关键驱动力，也加剧了若干重大问题。作者希望将AI还原到其有形的物质性中，并厘清计算系统所依赖但又被遮蔽的物质和环境基础设施。

Method: 结合社会科学与批判性、反思性、思辨性和虚构性的研究-创作方法论，在台湾（液氮超频）和加纳（城市采矿）开展田野调查，并对约50张显卡进行情境化实验。论文围绕三个主题组织：拆解与溶解、重建、混音。

Result: 研究-创作方法构成完整的认识论，可用于理解看似外部、不透明或不可及的事物，并将人工智能还原到其有形的物质性上。该方法有助于揭示计算机系统依赖但又遮蔽的物质与环境基础设施。

Conclusion: 研究-创作是严谨的方法，能够厘清计算系统所依赖但又被遮蔽的物质和环境基础设施，为ICT促进可持续发展领域做出贡献。

Abstract: This contribution follows a four-year investigation (2022--2026) into the political economy of graphics card miniaturization. It begins from the premise that rethinking our relationship to artificial intelligence and its sociotechnical entanglements requires demystifying and opening the black box of this technical object. Within our algorithmic culture, the graphics card (GPU) enables the massive, parallel processing of large datasets, making possible the training of the models that underpin our intelligent systems. GPU miniaturization is equally crucial: as a key driver of the Internet of Things, this sociotechnical phenomenon enables the inclusion of these cards in increasingly compact and powerful systems while also enabling better management of energy resources. The development of these everyday objects and technologies nevertheless reinforces several major problems. Drawing on both the social sciences and the critical, reflexive, speculative, and fictional methodologies of research-creation, the author developed several investigative fieldwork sites -- among liquid nitrogen overclockers in Taiwan and urban miners in Ghana -- and conducted situated experimentations on some fifty acquired graphics cards. Structured around three themes (dismantle and dissolve, rebuild, remix), this paper demonstrates how research-creation methods constitute full epistemologies for apprehending what seems a priori external, opaque, or inaccessible, and for restoring artificial intelligence to its tangible materialities. In doing so, it contributes to the field of ICT for sustainability by affirming research-creation as a rigorous means of disentangling the material and environmental infrastructures that computational systems both depend on and obscure.

</details>


### [229] [Designed by Journalists, but Is It for Readers? Rethinking AI Disclosures and Transparency in News](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11116)
*Pooja Prajod*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 新闻编辑室在整合生成式AI时面临披露困境：简单标签或详细披露都无法有效建立读者信任。详细披露会引发"透明度悖论"降低信任，简单标签则造成信息缺口。读者实际需要的是以用户自主权为中心的设计方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前新闻编辑室在披露AI参与度时，既有的两种方式（一行式标签与详细披露）均无法实现通过透明度建立读者信任的目标，需要探索更有效的披露设计方案。

Method: 基于一项对34名新闻读者的受控实验，对比分析了一行式标签与详细披露两种方式对读者信任的影响，并收集了读者对于披露设计的偏好和建议。

Result: 详细披露会引发"透明度悖论"，降低而非提高读者信任，并可能引入黑暗模式；一行式标签虽避免了这一问题，但造成信息缺口，迫使读者主动寻找AI参与的迹象。读者提出了以用户自主权为中心的设计方案，如按需提供详细信息、AI比例可视化、发布机构级信号和"无AI"标签。

Conclusion: 从业者认为负责任的披露方式与用户实际需求之间存在脱节，这为人机交互社区提出了设计问题，需要在透明度和用户自主权之间找到更好的平衡。

Abstract: As newsrooms integrate generative AI, journalists face a disclosure challenge: how to communicate AI involvement in ways that maintain reader trust. Current practice offers two approaches: brief one-line labels or detailed disclosures specifying human oversight, editorial accountability, and error reporting mechanisms. Neither achieves journalists' goal of building trust through transparency. An existing controlled experiment with 34 news readers show that detailed disclosures trigger a \textit{transparency dilemma}, reducing trust rather than increasing it, and risk introducing dark patterns that readers scroll past with the illusion of transparency. One-line disclosures avoid this effect but can create an information gap, prompting readers to expend cognitive effort searching for signs of AI involvement that the disclosure indicates but does not explain. Yet readers are not rejecting transparency, they proposed disclosure designs centered on user agency: detail-on-demand interactions, proportional AI-ratio visualizations, outlet-level signals, and explicit "no AI" labels. I argue that this disconnect between what practitioners believe is responsible disclosure and what users actually need is a design problem for the HCI community.

</details>


### [230] [BadRobot: Jailbreaking Embodied LLM Agents in the Physical World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.20242)
*Hangtao Zhang,Chenyu Zhu,Xianlong Wang,Ziqi Zhou,Changgan Yin,Minghui Li,Lulu Xue,Yichen Wang,Shengshan Hu,Aishan Liu,Peijin Guo,Leo Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出BadRobot攻击范式，利用三个漏洞（LLM操纵、语言输出与物理动作错配、世界知识缺陷）使具身AI系统违反安全伦理约束，并通过语音交互实现有害行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身AI系统广泛应用LLM进行任务规划，但其安全风险被忽视——具身LLM可能实施有害行为，需对此进行系统性的攻击分析与评估。

Method: BadRobot利用三个漏洞：(i) 操纵机器人系统中的LLM；(ii) 语言输出与物理动作之间的错配；(iii) 世界知识缺陷导致的无意危险行为。构建恶意物理动作查询基准，并在Voxposer、Code as Policies、ProgPrompt等框架上进行评估。

Result: 在多个主流具身LLM框架上的实验证明了BadRobot攻击的有效性。

Conclusion: 具身LLM存在严重安全漏洞，可通过语音交互被利用执行违反安全伦理约束的物理行为，亟需关注和防御。

Abstract: Embodied AI represents systems where AI is integrated into physical entities. Large Language Model (LLM), which exhibits powerful language understanding abilities, has been extensively employed in embodied AI by facilitating sophisticated task planning. However, a critical safety issue remains overlooked: could these embodied LLMs perpetrate harmful behaviors? In response, we introduce BadRobot, a novel attack paradigm aiming to make embodied LLMs violate safety and ethical constraints through typical voice-based user-system interactions. Specifically, three vulnerabilities are exploited to achieve this type of attack: (i) manipulation of LLMs within robotic systems, (ii) misalignment between linguistic outputs and physical actions, and (iii) unintentional hazardous behaviors caused by world knowledge's flaws. Furthermore, we construct a benchmark of various malicious physical action queries to evaluate BadRobot's attack performance. Based on this benchmark, extensive experiments against existing prominent embodied LLM frameworks (e.g., Voxposer, Code as Policies, and ProgPrompt) demonstrate the effectiveness of our BadRobot. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rookie143/BadRobot.

</details>


### [231] [Support for AI Development -- Automated Daily Measurement with Open Data and Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.05163)
*Jason Jeffrey Jones*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出并倡导一种新的科学交流形式：通过网页仪表板实现公众意见的免费、开放即时预测（nowcasting）。作者构建了一个开源自动化系统，每日收集新的调查响应数据，对微数据进行匿名化并公开发布，并通过公开可见的网页仪表板呈现分析结果。一个示范性实施追踪了美国成年人对人工智能进一步发展的支持度。截至2026年5月31日，该系统已自主生成了来自8551名受访者的766个日度支持率估计。研究结果强调了持续、高频调查对于准确追踪公众对AI等变革性技术态度转变的必要性。作者认为，更多科学家应采用开放即时预测方法，因为它能促进研究设计的透明度和可复制性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统调查方式在频率和透明度上存在局限，无法有效追踪公众对快速变化议题（如AI）的态度波动，且研究可复制性不足。

Method: 构建开源自动化系统，每日收集调查响应数据，对微数据进行匿名化并公开发布，通过网页仪表板进行公开分析展示。

Result: 截至2026年5月31日，系统自主生成了766个日度支持率估计，样本量为8551名受访者，成功追踪了美国成年人AI态度的时序变化。

Conclusion: 持续高频调查能更精准捕捉公众对变革性技术的态度变化；开放即时预测方法能提升研究透明度和可复制性，值得更多科学家采纳。

Abstract: This manuscript presents and advocates for a new form of scientific communication: free and open nowcasting of public opinion via web dashboard. I present an open-source automated system that gathers new human responses to survey items daily, anonymizes and publicly distributes microdata, and presents analyses through a publicly viewable Web dashboard. A demonstration implementation tracked support for further development of artificial intelligence among American adults. As of 2026-05-31, the system had autonomously produced 766 daily estimates of support from N=8551 respondents. The findings underscore the need for continuous, high-frequency surveys to accurately track shifts in public opinion on transformative technologies like AI. I argue that more scientists should adopt the method of open nowcasting, because it encourages transparency in research design and eases replication.

</details>


### [232] [Large Language Model Chatbot Conversations vs Public Health Materials and Parental HPV Vaccination Intentions: A Randomized Clinical Trial](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.20519)
*Neil K. R. Sehgal,Sunny Rai,Manuel Tonneau,Anish K. Agarwal,Joseph Cappella,Melanie Kornides,Lyle Ungar,Alison Buttenheim,Sharath Chandra Guntuku*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 这项随机临床试验发现，尽管基于GPT-4o的简短多轮聊天机器人对话在即时HPV疫苗接种意向上优于无干预对照组，但效果不及政府公共卫生材料，且45天后聊天机器人的效果消失，而公共卫生材料仍保持适度效果。没有任何干预措施能提高实际疫苗接种率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗系统越来越多地考虑使用基于大语言模型的聊天机器人进行疫苗沟通，但缺乏证据表明它们能够在现有健康材料基础上改善持久的、行为相关的结果。

Method: 在美国、加拿大和英国在线招募1297名家长，随机分配到无信息对照组、政府公共卫生材料组（至少3分钟暴露）、默认说服风格GPT-4o聊天机器人组或简短对话风格聊天机器人组。主要结局为干预后立即测量的12个月内HPV疫苗接种意愿（0-100分），并在15天和45天进行随访。

Result: 公共卫生材料（d=0.53）、默认聊天机器人（d=0.48）和对话式聊天机器人（d=0.33）均能即时提高接种意愿。但45天后，聊天机器人组的意愿不再高于对照组，而公共卫生材料仍保持适度效果。所有干预均未提高实际疫苗接种率。

Conclusion: 精心设计的公共卫生材料在HPV疫苗推广方面的效果可能达到甚至超过简短的LLM聊天机器人对话，提示当前LLM聊天机器人在此类应用中的增量价值有限。

Abstract: Health care systems are increasingly considering large language model (LLM)-based chatbots for vaccine communication, but evidence that they improve durable, behaviorally relevant outcomes beyond existing health materials is limited. This randomized clinical trial tested whether brief, multiturn LLM chatbot interactions increased parental intention to vaccinate children against human papillomavirus (HPV) compared with no intervention and government public health materials, and whether effects persisted. Parents in the US, Canada, and UK were recruited online from March 3 to May 25, 2025, with follow-up at 15 and 45 days. Eligible participants were adults with at least one HPV vaccine-eligible child who was unvaccinated or whose vaccination status was unknown. Participants were randomized to no-message control, country-matched government materials with at least 3 minutes of exposure, or a 3-minute GPT-4o chatbot interaction using either a default persuasive style or a shorter conversational style. The primary outcome was self-reported likelihood of vaccinating the child against HPV within 12 months, measured immediately after intervention on a 0-100 scale. Follow-up outcomes included vaccination intent and self-reported vaccination at 15 and 45 days. In total, 1297 participants were randomized (mean age 42.84 years; 72.1% female). Compared with no intervention, public health materials increased immediate vaccination intent (Cohen d = 0.53; 95% CI, 0.36-0.70), as did the default chatbot (d = 0.48; 95% CI, 0.30-0.65) and conversational chatbot (d = 0.33; 95% CI, 0.17-0.49). At 45 days, neither chatbot increased intent relative to controls, whereas public health materials maintained modest effects. No intervention increased self-reported vaccination uptake. Findings suggest well-designed public health materials may match or exceed short LLM chatbot conversations for HPV vaccine promotion.

</details>


### [233] [Quantifying Perception-Based Student Success with Generative AI: An Exploratory Monte Carlo Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.01062)
*Seyma Yaman Kayadibi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于PRISMA系统文献综述，选取一项10条目5点李克特量表，采用逆方差加权蒙特卡洛模拟生成10,000条合成观测数据，量化学生对生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT）的感知可用性及其对学生成功的影响。结果表明，系统效率和学业负担两个维度对综合得分影响最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高等教育中生成式AI工具的使用日益普及，但学生对这类工具的感知有用性、可用性和教育价值如何影响其学业成功，尚缺乏量化框架。现有研究多为描述性统计，缺少可重复的概率建模方法。

Method: 采用PRISMA框架在Scopus进行结构化文献检索，筛选出2019篇文献中的19项实证研究（2023-2025年），其中6篇报告了适合概率建模的条目级均值和标准差；选择一套10条目5点李克特量表作为概念验证数据集，采用逆方差加权蒙特卡洛模拟生成10,000条合成观测数据。

Result: 加权结构显著影响模拟结果；系统效率（System Efficiency）和学业负担（Learning Burden）两个维度获得最大的逆方差权重，对综合得分影响最强。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了一个透明、可重复且保护隐私的概念验证框架，将结构化文献检索、条目级汇总统计与概率建模相结合，为后续GenAI感知研究提供了方法论参考。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools such as ChatGPT have attracted growing attention in higher education, particularly in relation to how students perceive their usefulness, usability, and educational value. This study develops an exploratory Monte Carlo simulation framework for quantifying perception-based student success in the context of GenAI use. A PRISMA-informed structured literature search in Scopus identified nineteen empirical studies published between 2023 and 2025, of which six reported item-level means and standard deviations suitable for probabilistic modelling. One coherent 10-item, 5-point Likert-scale usability-oriented instrument was selected as a canonical proof-of-concept dataset and used to parameterise an inverse-variance-weighted Monte Carlo simulation generating 10,000 synthetic observations. The results show that the weighting structure substantially influences the simulated outcome, with System Efficiency and Learning Burden receiving the largest inverse-variance weight and therefore the strongest influence on the composite score. The study offers a transparent, reproducible, and privacy-preserving proof-of-concept framework linking structured literature search, item-level summary statistics, and probabilistic modelling.

</details>


### [234] [Who Gets Flagged? The Pluralistic Evaluation Gap in AI Content Watermarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13776)
*Alexander Nemecek,Osama Zafar,Yuqiao Xu,Wenbiao Li,Erman Ayday*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文指出水印技术作为AI内容认证的基础设施，其性能（强度、可检测性、鲁棒性）依赖于内容的统计特性，而这些特性在不同语言、文化传统和人口群体间存在系统性差异，从而产生模态特定的偏差路径。研究发现主流水印基准测试几乎未报告跨语言、跨文化或跨群体的性能差异，因此提出三个多元水印基准评估维度：跨语言检测公平性、文化多样性内容覆盖、检测指标的人口统计分解。作者主张水印应作为多元对齐管线的一部分，并接受同等评估标准，强调部署前必须进行公平性审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示水印技术中未被重视的公平性问题：水印性能依赖内容统计特性，而不同语言、文化和群体间存在系统性统计差异，导致潜在偏差。现有基准测试缺乏多元评估，监管框架也忽视公平性要求。

Method: 跨文本、图像、音频模态分析水印性能对内容统计特性的依赖关系；系统审查主流水印基准测试的多元覆盖情况；提出跨语言检测公平性、文化多样性内容覆盖、检测指标人口统计分解三个评估维度。

Result: 发现除一项基准外，所有主流水印基准测试均未报告跨语言、文化内容类型或人口群体的性能表现。确认水印偏差具有模态特异性。

Conclusion: 水印技术应纳入多元对齐管线，部署前须通过公平性审计；对AI模型的偏差审计要求应延伸至验证层（水印系统）。

Abstract: Watermarking is becoming the default mechanism for AI content authentication, with governance policies and frameworks referencing it as infrastructure for content provenance. Yet across text, image, and audio modalities, watermark signal strength, detectability, and robustness depend on statistical properties of the content itself, properties that vary systematically across languages, cultural visual traditions, and demographic groups. We examine how this content dependence creates modality-specific pathways to bias. Reviewing the major watermarking benchmarks across modalities, we find that, with one exception, none report performance across languages, cultural content types, or population groups. To address this, we propose three concrete evaluation dimensions for pluralistic watermark benchmarking: cross-lingual detection parity, culturally diverse content coverage, and demographic disaggregation of detection metrics. We argue that watermarking is part of the pluralistic alignment pipeline and should be held to the same evaluation standards. We connect this to governance frameworks currently mandating watermarking deployment without requiring fairness evaluation. Our position is that evaluation must precede deployment, and that the same bias auditing requirements applied to AI models should extend to the verification layer.

</details>


### [235] [Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00038)
*J. Paul Liu,Rachel Levy*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个五阶段AI素养连续体模型（0-未参与、1-盲目使用、2-知情使用、3-批判评价、4-改进），用于描述高等教育中学习者与AI工具互动的发展轨迹。基于北卡罗来纳州立大学的实践案例（330+参与者），该框架为 educators 提供了诊断和教学路径，将AI素养视为一种发展性能力而非单纯工具采纳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架虽然定义了能力维度，但缺乏对学习者起点和发展路径的诊断指导。学生要么因恐惧/伦理担忧而回避，要么不加批判地依赖AI工具，需要一种能够描述发展阶段的实用框架。

Method: 提出五阶段AI素养连续体模型，并在北卡罗来纳州立大学进行设计型实施，包括学分课程和强化工作坊（2024秋-2026春，330+参与者）。采用观察性和实践导向的分析方法（无验证前后测工具或对照组）。

Result: 参与者表现出从非参与或盲目使用向知情使用转变的行为迹象；持续且融入学科的经验产生了更强的批判评价和改进导向实践的证据。

Conclusion: AI素养应被理解为一种发展性能力，即在学科和社会背景下理解、评估和负责任应用AI系统，而非仅工具采纳。框架与UNESCO和OECD等国际标准对齐，为课程设计、评估策略和机会考虑提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum: 0) Not Yet Engaged, 1) Uncritical Use, 2) Informed Use, 3) Critical Evaluation, and 4) Improvement --that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026. Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, opportunity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.

</details>


### [236] [Contemporary AI lacks the imagination to diverge or negate in science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08251)
*Honglin Bao,Siyang Wu,Xiao Liu,Sida Li,Shiyun Cao,James A. Evans*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过大规模科学家参与测试（121,640篇预印本作者受邀，6,749名科学家提供25,139组评分），评估LLM在科学发现中的能力，发现：非推理模型陷入"蜂巢思维"，推理模型探索更广但不会自发提出零假设；科学家偏爱与自己相似的想法且更重视概率而非新颖性；现有自动评估器与专家判断一致性弱，但基于人类评分微调的Qwen3-14B奖励模型将差距缩小至同行评审者间一致性水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI加速科学发现的激进预测缺乏大规模科学家参与的实际检验，现有评估多脱离科学家的真实工作流程和判断标准，需要系统性地量化AI在科学发现中的实际能力与局限。

Method: 邀请121,640篇近期预印本作者对LLM从其论文背景和困惑中生成的创意进行评分，收集6,749名科学家的25,139组评分，涵盖新颖性、实证可行性、真实性概率和采纳倾向四个维度。同时对比不同LLM类型（非推理型、推理型）、不同学科领域、不同自动化评估器与专家判断的一致性。

Result: 1）非推理LLM创意趋同如"蜂巢思维"，推理模型探索更优但缺乏零假设生成能力；2）科学家偏好与自己相似的想法，重概率轻新颖性，社会科学领域学者对风险容忍度更高，资深社会科学家批评最严厉；3）现有自动化评估器与专家判断一致性弱，微调后的Qwen3-14B奖励模型性能提升27%，接近同行评审者间一致性水平。

Conclusion: 当前科学AI仍需要人类作为协作基础，其想象力、输出和判断均需人类校正；AI在需要上下文感知解释和理论演变的多元领域（如社会科学）表现最差。

Abstract: Bold projections that artificial intelligence will accelerate scientific discovery have raced ahead of evidence from working scientists, and the field still lacks large-scale, scientist-in-the-loop tests of these claims. Here we mount the largest such evaluation to date and map what AI cannot yet do for science. We invited authors of 121,640 recent preprints across biology, medicine, chemistry, and the social sciences to judge ideas that large language models (LLMs) generated from the context and puzzles of their own papers. 6,749 scientists returned 25,139 sets of ratings on novelty, empirical feasibility, probability of being true, and favorability of adoption. Three patterns emerge. First, non-reasoning LLMs collapse into a narrow "hivemind" of similar ideas; reasoning models roam a wider hypothesis space, yet no model class spontaneously proposes null hypotheses -- a move humans make more freely. Second, scientists reward ideas that resemble their own and prize probability over novelty, though social scientists tolerate risk more readily than life scientists. Senior social scientists are the harshest critics, and their skepticism is well-earned: LLMs falter most in pluralistic fields like the social sciences that demand context-aware interpretation and evolving theories. Third, automated evaluators on which the community currently relies -- LLM-as-a-judge, artificial metrics, and even state-of-the-art (SOTA) models -- agree only weakly with expert judgment, and retrieval augmentation and scientist persona prompting yield only marginal gains. A Qwen3-14B reward model we post-trained on human ratings captures field taste nuances, beats SOTA models by up to 27%, and closes the gap to the inter-rater consistency of independent peer reviewers. For all the hype, today's scientific AI still represents a collaborator whose imagination, outputs and judgment benefit from human grounding.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [237] [Multifractal Signatures of Ageing and Dementia Development: A Multifractal Space-Filling Curve Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10222)
*Marta Lotka,Jacek Grela,Zbigniew Drogosz,Jeremi K. Ochab,Paweł Oświęcimka*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为多重分形空间填充曲线分析（MFSCA）的新方法，用于量化多维数据的相关性结构。该方法通过分形空间填充曲线将多维数据投影到一维，再利用多重分形算法进行分析。应用于阿尔茨海默症患者MRI数据后发现，大脑空间组织的多重分形性随年龄增长和痴呆发展而逐渐减弱，出现从多重分形向单分形的转变，表明多重分形特征可作为脑结构变化的标志物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多重分形是量化复杂数据非线性、无标度性质的有效形式体系，但现有方法在处理多维数据的相关性结构时存在局限性，因此需要一种新的高效方法论来量化多维数据的相关性结构。

Method: 提出MFSCA方法：首先利用分形空间填充曲线将原始多维数据投影到一维表示，同时保留局部和长程组织特性；然后采用多重分形算法对得到的一维信号进行分析。

Result: 通过人工生成的多重分形结构和真实数据验证了方法有效性。应用于阿尔茨海默症不同阶段患者的MRI数据，发现大脑空间组织的多重分形性随年龄增长和痴呆发展而逐渐减弱，出现从多重分形到单分形的转变。

Conclusion: 从多尺度特性角度看，大脑空间组织的异质性特征在恶化条件下逐渐退化，导致同质且弱相关的结构。MRI数据的多重分形性可作为脑结构变化的标志物。

Abstract: Multifractality is an effective formalism for quantifying the nonlinear, scale-free properties of complex data. In this study, we propose a novel and efficient methodology, termed Multifractal Space-filling Curve Analysis (MFSCA), for quantifying the correlation structure of multidimensional data. Within this framework, the original multidimensional data - while preserving both local and long-range organisational properties - are projected onto a one-dimensional representation using a fractal space-filling curve. The resulting one-dimensional signal is then analysed using multifractal algorithms. We demonstrate the utility of the method using both artificially generated multifractal structures and real data. In particular, we apply MFSCA to analyse magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) data from Alzheimer patients at different stages of dementia. Based on the results, we estimate the multifractal profiles of the brain for healthy subjects of different ages as well as for dementia patients. The analysis reveals that the spatial organization of brain structures, as measured by the degree of multifractality, progressively weakens with age and the development of dementia. A transition from multifractality to monofractality is observed both in control groups, when comparing the Young Control and Elderly Control groups, and among dementia subjects of similar age but at different stages of the disease, namely early dementia and mild cognitive impairment. Thus, from the perspective of multiscaling properties, the heterogeneous characteristics of spatial brain organization deteriorate under worsening conditions, leading to a homogeneous and weakly correlated structure. These findings not only effectively capture key aspects of brain organisation, but also demonstrate that the multifractality of MRI data can serve as a marker of structural brain changes.

</details>


### [238] [Hyperbolic Neural Population Geometry Benefits Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10238)
*Dennis Wu,Yi-Chun Hung,Braden Yuille,James E. Fitzgerald,Han Liu*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出海马体神经群体活动具有双曲几何结构的理论框架：构建了统计上诱导双曲几何的调谐曲线，证明了现代Hopfield网络更新规则等价于MMSE估计器，并提出了在双曲空间中具有更大记忆容量的新型联想记忆模型，表明动物将空间信息编码为潜在双曲认知地图以提升记忆容量与解码精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经生物学最新实验发现海马体群体活动存在双曲结构，但缺乏理论解释。本文旨在为该现象提供理论框架，并探究双曲几何如何影响下游计算（神经解码和联想记忆）。

Method: 1）提出海马体调谐曲线的可解释性构造，统计上诱导双曲几何；2）建立神经解码与联想记忆之间的联系，证明现代Hopfield网络更新规则计算MMSE估计量；3）引入双曲空间中的新型联想记忆模型。

Result: 双曲联想记忆模型相比现有领先模型具有显著更大的记忆容量，且双曲几何同时提升了记忆容量与解码精度。

Conclusion: 动物可能将空间信息编码为潜在双曲认知地图，双曲几何结构能够同时优化记忆容量和解码性能，为海马体功能性结构提供理论解释。

Abstract: Neural population geometry shapes downstream computation. Recent empirical findings in neurobiology suggest that a hyperbolic structure underlies population activity in the hippocampus. Here we provide a theoretical framework for this phenomenon. First, we propose a plausible construction of hippocampal tuning curves that statistically induces hyperbolic geometry. Next, we establish a connection between neural decoding and associative memory by demonstrating that the Modern Hopfield Network update rule computes the minimum mean-squared-error (MMSE) estimator. Finally, we introduce a novel associative memory model defined in hyperbolic space that yields significantly larger capacity than leading models. Our results suggest that animals encode spatial information as a latent hyperbolic cognitive map, improving both memory capacity and decoding accuracy.

</details>


### [239] [Sleep EEG Signal Criticality as a Non-Invasive Predictor of Cognitive Decline in Dementia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10889)
*Stanisław Narębski,Tomasz Komendziński,Tomasz M. Rutkowski*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究利用多分形去趋势波动分析（MFDFA）量化睡眠EEG信号临界性，发现认知健康女性在非快速眼动睡眠期（N2/N3）的Hurst指数分布更接近最优临界状态，而未来进展为痴呆的女性则表现出DFA指数向1.0偏移，提示睡眠期间无标度神经动力学的重编程先于临床症状出现。MFDFA衍生指标有望作为非侵入性生物标志物整合进自动化睡眠筛查工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经退行性疾病的早期检测仍是临床重大挑战，亟需开发非侵入性、可在症状前窗口期识别认知下降风险的生物标志物。

Method: 基于NSRR-SOF队列的纵向数据，采用MFDFA计算基线睡眠EEG的Hurst指数H(q)，对比认知正常与未来进展为痴呆（3MS<78）两组女性的睡眠EEG动力学特征，并使用监督UMAP进行空间分离验证。
