This formulation combines graph-based spatial representation, history-conditioned latent dynamics, and continuous-time rollout in a unified framework for mesh-based physical simulation emulation. In order to stabilize training with long-horizon supervision, we also propose effective rollout-horizon sampling and a progressive rollout-horizon scheduling strategy. We evaluate COGENT on transient ice-sheet simulations generated by the Ice-sheet and Sea-level System Model, demonstrating improved long-range stability over autoregressive graph baselines. These results suggest that continuous graph Neural ODEs provide a promising methodology for scalable physical forecasting on irregular geospatial meshes, particularly in applications that require stable long-horizon predictions and the ability to query system states at arbitrary times.

</details>


### [421] [Algorithmic and Minimax Complexities in Kernel Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11171)
*Yunbei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过统一的MAIR框架，将GP-UCB和DEC/MAMS方法置于共同的算法信息语言中，揭示了它们在频率派RKHS bandit问题中的内在联系与区别，并提出了结合两者优势的安全主算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GP-UCB和DEC两种方法看似属于不同理论体系，本文旨在将它们统一到共同的算法信息框架下，厘清两者之间的关系与差异。

Method: 通过MAIR框架和异构半正定算法先验，统一了GP-UCB分析和MAMS算法，提出了一个安全主算法以结合两者优势，并通过核bandit构造展示了算法复杂度比类宽极小极大或DEC证书更具信息量。

Result: 算法信息与类宽极小极大系数回答不同问题，可能导致不同gap；核bandit为这种区别提供了数学上可见的清晰场景。

Conclusion: 在过参数化模型中，算法复杂度可能比类宽极小极大或DEC证书更具信息量，两种视角回答不同问题，需根据具体场景选择。

Abstract: Gaussian-process upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) and decision-estimation-coefficient (DEC) methods may appear, at first sight, to belong to different theories. This paper places the two viewpoints in a common algorithmic-information language for frequentist RKHS bandits. GP-UCB fixes an algorithmic, rather than true, Gaussian-process prior and exploits realized-trajectory complexity together with computational tractability, whereas MAMS optimizes a robust class-wide MAIR/DEC envelope. Through the unified MAIR framework and heterogeneous positive-semidefinite algorithmic priors, we generalize both the GP-UCB analysis and the MAMS algorithm, propose a safeguarded master that combines their advantages, and provide a kernel-bandit construction showing that algorithmic complexity can be more informative than class-wide minimax or DEC certificates in overparameterized models. The resulting message is that algorithmic information and class-wide minimax coefficients answer different questions and can lead to different gaps; kernel bandits provide a clean setting in which this distinction becomes mathematically visible.

</details>


### [422] [Predicting Future Behaviors in Reasoning Models Enables Better Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11172)
*Evgenii Kortukov,Piotr Komorowski,Florian Klein,Paula Engl,Gabriele Sarti,Seong Joon Oh,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现先前的大推理模型（LRM）行为控制工作隐式依赖检测已生成文本行为的内部特征，但这些特征对未来行为的预测能力较差。作者训练激活探针从中间推理步骤预测未来行为概率（准确率64%-91%），并基于此提出未来探针可控生成（FPCG）方法，通过采样多个候选句子并选择未来行为概率最高的输出，实现几乎不损失输出质量的文本级行为控制，在多项评估中优于传统激活干预方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时行为控制方法（如激活干预）会降低输出质量，且先前工作隐含依赖的"检测特征"只能识别已生成文本中的行为，无法有效预测未来行为，因此不是理想的干预目标。需要寻找更好的内部表征来预测和控制模型未来行为。

Method: 1) 训练激活探针（activation probes）从LRM中间推理步骤预测未来行为概率；2) 提出FPCG（Future Probe Controlled Generation）方法：采样多个候选句子，用探针选择未来行为概率最高的输出，实现文本级控制。

Result: 探针预测未来行为准确率64%-91%；FPCG方法几乎不降低输出质量，且在多项评估中优于传统激活干预方法。

Conclusion: 区分检测特征（detection features）和预测特征（prediction features）能实现更精细的LRM行为控制，预测特征作为干预目标比检测特征更有效。

Abstract: Deployed large reasoning models (LRMs) often behave unexpectedly. Test-time steering controls LRM outputs by intervening on their hidden representations, but it can degrade output quality. We argue that prior steering work implicitly relies on internal features that detect behavior in already generated text. We show that these detection features are poor predictors of future behavioral outcomes, and thus not the natural intervention target. Instead, we train activation probes to predict future behavior likelihoods from intermediate reasoning steps. These probes predict the most likely behavior with 64%-91% accuracy, revealing a separate type of internal prediction features. Building on these prediction features, we introduce a text-level steering method, Future Probe Controlled Generation. FPCG samples multiple candidate sentences and chooses the best one according to a probe predicting the future behavior likelihood. This enables steering with almost no output quality degradation. FPCG also enables steering in several evaluations where activation steering fails. These results show that distinguishing detection and prediction features enables a more nuanced approach to controlling LRM behaviors.

</details>


### [423] [EEVEE: Towards Test-time Prompt Learning in the Real World for Self-Improving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11182)
*Weixian Xu,Shilong Liu,Mengdi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EEVEE是首个面向LLM智能体的多数据集测试时提示学习框架，通过路由-提示协同进化策略解决跨数据集干扰问题，在异构数据流下显著提升鲁棒性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时提示学习方法主要针对单数据集场景设计，无法应对真实世界中多数据集、多领域、多任务分布的异构输入流，存在严重的跨数据集干扰问题，限制了实际应用能力。

Method: 提出EEVEE框架，引入路由器将输入流分割成任务簇并分配相应提示配置；采用路由-提示协同进化策略，通过交替优化路由器和提示学习阶段来解决两者间的相互依赖关系。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct和DeepSeek-V3.2上分别提升多基准平均分10.38和24.32分，相比GEPA和ACE等SOTA方法分别提升高达37.2%和48.2%。

Conclusion: EEVEE在保持单基准学习能力与效率的同时，显著增强了模型在异构数据流下的鲁棒性，为LLM智能体的实际部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose EEVEE, the first multi-dataset test-time prompt learning framework for LLM agents, enabling test-time prompt learning under real-world task streams. Existing methods are largely designed for single-dataset settings, while real-world applications require models to handle heterogeneous input streams drawn from multiple datasets, domains, and task distributions, limiting their practical applicability. To mitigate cross-dataset interference, EEVEE introduces a router that partitions incoming inputs into task clusters and assigns them to suitable prompt configurations. This design is optimized via a router-prompt co-evolution strategy, which employs interleaved router and prompt learning phases to address their mutual dependency. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that the framework improves robustness under heterogeneous data streams while maintaining single-benchmark learning capability and efficiency. Specifically, EEVEE improves average multi-benchmark scores by 10.38 and 24.32 points over Qwen3-4B-Instruct and DeepSeek-V3.2, surpassing SOTA methods GEPA and ACE by up to 37.2% and 48.2%.

</details>


### [424] [A Unifying Lens on Supervised Fine-Tuning Through Target Distribution Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11189)
*Tong Xie,Yuanhao Ban,Yunqi Hong,Sohyun An,Yihang Chen,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新解读监督微调（SFT）为目标分布设计问题，提出Q-target框架将SFT监督分解为两个显式选择：(1)对观测token的依赖强度，(2)剩余概率质量在替代token上的分配方式。基于该视角提出Target-SFT方法，在10个推理数据集-模型组合上一致优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SFT最大化示范轨迹中每个token的似然，但观测token可能非唯一、带噪声或与模型先验不一致，严格拟合one-hot目标在模型具有丰富先验知识时是次优的。

Method: 提出Q-target框架，将SFT监督分解为两个显式选择；基于该框架提出Target-SFT，直接从期望的目标分布构建训练目标。

Result: 在10个推理数据集-模型组合上一致优于现有SFT变体方法。

Conclusion: 揭示了SFT训练中更基础的设计原则，为SFT目标函数打开了更广阔的搜索空间。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) typically maximizes the likelihood of every token in a demonstrated trajectory. However, an observed token can be non-unique, noisy, or misaligned with the model prior. Strictly fitting toward this one-hot target may be suboptimal, especially when the pretrained model encodes a rich knowledge prior. In this work, we reinterpret SFT as target distribution design: instead of studying only the loss objective, we analyze the token-level target that the loss drives the model to match. We introduce the Q-target framework, which decomposes SFT supervision into two explicit choices: (1) how strongly to rely on the observed token, and (2) how to allocate the remaining probability mass over alternatives. This perspective unifies many existing SFT variants as implicit choices of the target distribution Q. Building on this view, we propose Target-SFT which constructs the training objective directly from the desired target distribution. This method consistently outperforms across the ten reasoning dataset-model settings evaluated, showing the effectiveness of this target-based approach. Overall, our formulation reveals a more fundamental design principle for SFT training and opens a broader search space for SFT objectives.

</details>


### [425] [When to Align, When to Predict: A Phase Diagram for Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11190)
*Ilay Kamai,Hugues Van Assel,Aviv Regev,Hagai B. Perets,Randall Balestriero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统一线性框架，通过推导对齐（CA）和预测（CP）的分离比率，揭示两种范式在跨模态学习中的互补失败模式，并划分出四种模态学习区间（Both、CA only、CP only、Neither），帮助实践者在训练前诊断问题并选择合适目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模态对齐（CA）和跨模态预测（CP）是当前多模态表示学习的两大主导范式，但学界缺乏对两者何时成功、何时失败、以及跨模态训练何时根本无益的系统理解。这一空白使得从业者，尤其在生物医学、天体物理等科学领域，面对异构仪器和多层次测量数据时，无法诊断为何标准方法不如单模态方法表现良好。

Method: 构建统一的线性框架，在带有结构化跨模态干扰相关性的尖峰信号加噪声模型下，为CA和CP两种目标推导出分离比率（separation ratios），揭示其互补的失败模式。基于此提出一个包含四种模态学习区间的相图，并设计数据驱动流程，利用少量标注子样本定位真实数据集在该相图中的位置，从而在训练前确定最优目标和预测方向。

Result: 在合成数据、立体视觉基准、图像-字幕对以及真实天体物理数据上的实验验证了该框架在非线性 regime 下的预测能力，包括识别出跨模态训练会产生负面效果的"Neither"区间。

Conclusion: 该框架允许实践者在投入跨模态训练之前，诊断其多模态问题并选择正确的学习目标，从而避免无效甚至有害的跨模态训练。

Abstract: Cross-modal alignment (CA) and cross-modal prediction (CP) are the dominant paradigms for multimodal representation learning, yet there is no systematic understanding of when each succeeds, when each fails, and when cross-modal training helps at all -- a gap that leaves practitioners, especially in scientific domains like biomedicine or astrophysics, with heterogeneous instruments and multiple levels of organization and measurement, unable to diagnose why standard methods underperform the best single modality. We develop a unified linear framework that addresses both questions. Under a spiked signal-plus-noise model with structured cross-modal nuisance correlation, we derive separation ratios for both objectives that expose complementary failure modes: alignment whitens each modality and fails when nuisance is strongly correlated across views; prediction encodes whatever is cross-predictable through a one-sided whitening, with recovery governed by source-modality quality. The resulting phase diagram partitions multimodal problems into four regimes: Both, CA only, CP only, and Neither. We present a data-driven procedure to locate real-world datasets in this diagram using a small labeled subsample, identifying the preferred objective and prediction direction before any cross-modal training. Experiments on synthetic data, stereo-vision benchmarks, image-caption pairs, and real astrophysical data validate the predictions in the nonlinear regime, including the Neither regime where cross-modal training is actively harmful. Our framework lets practitioners diagnose their multimodal problem and choose the right objective before committing to training. Code to reproduce the results is available at https://github.com/IlayMalinyak/mm_align_vs_pred.

</details>


### [426] [Time series forecasting from partial observations via Non-negative Matrix Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.05314)
*Yohann de Castro,Luca Mencarelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出滑动掩码方法(SMM)，结合掩码原型矩阵分解(mAMF)和掩码归一化非负矩阵分解(mNMF)，用于多非负时间序列的缺失值预测，证明估计误差与噪声成比例，并在真实数据上优于Transformer、LSTM、SARIMAX等现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代时间序列问题中常涉及多个可能含有缺失值和噪声的时间序列预测，现有方法在处理这类问题时存在局限性，需要一种能够同时处理缺失值、噪声和非负约束的预测方法。

Method: 提出滑动掩码方法(SMM)，通过非负矩阵补全将观测噪声值和预测/缺失值收集到矩阵中，将行表示为少量非负向量（原型）的凸组合。引入两种估计器：掩码原型矩阵分解(mAMF)和掩码归一化非负矩阵分解(mNMF)，并使用近端交替线性化方法(PALM)进行求解。

Result: 理论上证明所提估计器能够以与噪声成比例的误差恢复真实原型；实验上在真实数据多时间序列预测任务中，与Transformer、LSTM、SARIMAX等方法相比，所提方法在多数实验中表现更优。

Conclusion: 滑动掩码方法结合非负矩阵补全框架，在处理含缺失值和噪声的多非负时间序列预测问题上具有理论保证和实证优势。

Abstract: In modern time series problems, one aims at forecasting multiple time series with possible missing and noisy values. In this paper, we introduce the Sliding Mask Method (SMM) for forecasting multiple nonnegative time series by means of nonnegative matrix completion: observed noisy values and forecast/missing values are collected into matrix form, and learning is achieved by representing its rows as a convex combination of a small number of nonnegative vectors, referred to as the archetypes. We introduce two estimates, the mask Archetypal Matrix factorization (mAMF) and the mask normalized Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (mNMF) which can be combined with the SMM method. We prove that these estimates recover the true archetypes with an error proportional to the noise. We use a proximal alternating linearized method (PALM) to compute the archetypes and the convex combination weights. We compared our estimators with state-of-the-art methods (Transformers, LSTM, SARIMAX...) in multiple time series forecasting on real data and obtain that our method outperforms them in most of the experiments.

</details>


### [427] [Deeper or Wider: A Perspective from Optimal Generalization Error with Sobolev Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.00152)
*Yahong Yang,Juncai He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较了深层神经网络（DeNNs，层数灵活）与宽层神经网络（WeNNs，隐藏层有限）在Sobolev损失下的最优泛化误差，发现网络架构受样本点数量、参数数量和损失函数正则性影响：参数多倾向于WeNNs，样本点多或损失函数正则性高则倾向于DeNNs。该理论最终应用于指导深度Ritz和PINN方法中的神经网络设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习社区中构建神经网络架构时，关于网络应该更深还是更宽的问题一直存在争议，缺乏系统的理论指导来回答这一困境。

Method: 通过解析分析，比较深层神经网络（DeNNs）和宽层神经网络（WeNNs）在Sobolev损失下的最优泛化误差，考察样本点数量、参数数量和损失函数正则性三个因素对架构选择的影响。

Result: 参数数量越多越倾向于选择WeNNs；样本点数量越多或损失函数正则性越高则越倾向于选择DeNNs。

Conclusion: 该理论可应用于深度Ritz和PINN方法中，为求解偏微分方程时的神经网络架构设计提供指导依据。

Abstract: Constructing the architecture of a neural network is a challenging pursuit for the machine learning community, and the dilemma of whether to go deeper or wider remains a persistent question. This paper explores a comparison between deeper neural networks (DeNNs) with a flexible number of layers and wider neural networks (WeNNs) with limited hidden layers, focusing on their optimal generalization error in Sobolev losses. Analytical investigations reveal that the architecture of a neural network can be significantly influenced by various factors, including the number of sample points, parameters within the neural networks, and the regularity of the loss function. Specifically, a higher number of parameters tends to favor WeNNs, while an increased number of sample points and greater regularity in the loss function lean towards the adoption of DeNNs. We ultimately apply this theory to address partial differential equations using deep Ritz and physics-informed neural network (PINN) methods, guiding the design of neural networks.

</details>


### [428] [Robust Deep Reinforcement Learning Through Adversarial Attacks and Training : A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.00420)
*Lucas Schott,Josephine Delas,Hatem Hajri,Elies Gherbi,Reda Yaich,Nora Boulahia-Cuppens,Frederic Cuppens,Sylvain Lamprier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了深度强化学习中的对抗攻击与对抗训练方法，旨在提升DRL在环境条件变化和扰动下的鲁棒性与可信赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRL在复杂环境中表现优异，但对环境条件的微小变化敏感，可靠性不足，亟需提升其鲁棒性和可信赖性以适用于现实应用。

Method: 通过对抗训练（在观测和动态上施加对抗攻击）来增强DRL对未知环境变化和扰动的鲁棒性；对现有对抗攻击与训练方法进行系统性分类，并比较其目标和运行机制。

Result: 提供了对当前对抗攻击与训练方法的深入分析与系统分类，明确了各类方法的目标与运作机理。

Conclusion: 对抗训练是提升DRL鲁棒性的有效途径，本文的系统性分类与比较为后续研究提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is a subfield of machine learning for training autonomous agents that take sequential actions across complex environments. Despite its significant performance in well-known environments, it remains susceptible to minor condition variations, raising concerns about its reliability in real-world applications. To improve usability, DRL must demonstrate trustworthiness and robustness. A way to improve the robustness of DRL to unknown changes in the environmental conditions and possible perturbations is through Adversarial Training, by training the agent against well-suited adversarial attacks on the observations and the dynamics of the environment. Addressing this critical issue, our work presents an in-depth analysis of contemporary adversarial attack and training methodologies, systematically categorizing them and comparing their objectives and operational mechanisms.

</details>


### [429] [Mixtures of Neural Operators Reduce Active Complexity in Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.09101)
*Anastasis Kratsios,Takashi Furuya,Jose Antonio Lara Benitez,Matti Lassas,Maarten de Hoop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过混合神经算子（MoNOs）与单一神经算子的构造性比较，证明了对于紧致Sobolev子集上的连续算子，MoNO的活跃专家在深度、宽度和秩上具有更优的缩放规模，且在Lipschitz目标下这些量被O(ε^{-1})界约束，同时建立了底层神经算子架构的定量通用逼近定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算子系统并非仅由总参数量决定性能瓶颈，查询时的模型加载与评估开销同样关键。作者旨在通过构造性比较，揭示混合神经算子（MoNO）相较于固定单一神经算子在活跃复杂度上的优势，并严格量化这种差异。

Method: 采用构造性比较方法，将每个输入函数通过树路由到一位专家（MoNO），与单一神经算子架构进行对比。分别考虑活跃专家规模、路由搜索开销和总存储大小。通过主定理证明MoNO的活跃专家在深度、宽度和秩上的缩放优于单一神经算子，并证明底层架构的定量通用逼近定理。

Result: 主定理表明：紧致Sobolev子集上每个标量一致连续非线性算子（输出Sobolev半径有界）都存在一个MoNO逼近，其活跃专家的深度、宽度和秩的缩放规模小于被分析的单一神经算子构造；对于Lipschitz目标，这些量被O(ε^{-1})界约束。同时建立了依赖紧致集直径和连续模的定量通用逼近定理。

Conclusion: MoNO通过路由机制将局部化转换为算子层面的活跃专家规模、路由深度和专家数量的可量化权衡，在活跃复杂度上优于单一神经算子架构。该工作为神经算子系统的实际部署效率提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Operator-learning systems are not governed solely by total parameter count; for one query, the relevant bottleneck can be the model that must be loaded and evaluated. We study this distinction for classical neural operators on compact Sobolev subsets through a constructive comparison between routed mixtures of neural operators (MoNOs) and a fixed single-neural-operator construction. The comparison concerns expert-active complexity relative to that baseline, with total stored size and routing search accounted separately. A MoNO routes each input function through a tree to one expert. Our main theorem shows that every scalar uniformly continuous nonlinear operator with bounded output Sobolev radius on the approximation set admits a MoNO approximation whose active expert has smaller depth, width, and rank scaling than the analyzed single-neural-operator construction; for Lipschitz targets these expert quantities are bounded by $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-1})$. The theorem turns localization into an operator-level accounting of active expert size, routing depth, and number of experts. We also prove a quantitative universal approximation theorem for the underlying neural-operator architecture, with explicit dependence on compact-set diameter and modulus of continuity.

</details>


### [430] [Active-Passive Federated Learning for Vertically Partitioned Multi-view Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.04111)
*Jiyuan Liu,Siqi Wang,Xinhang Wan,Yi Zhang,Junsong Chen,Xin Lu,Xinwang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种灵活的主被动联邦学习框架（APFed），解决垂直联邦学习在推理阶段因客户端协作不稳定导致的服务失效问题。主动客户端独立构建完整模型后即可独立推理，被动客户端仅作为训练辅助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有垂直联邦学习方法在推理阶段仍需所有客户端协作，但实际场景中客户端（尤其是跨组织）可能因合同终止、网络故障等原因无法协作，导致推理服务失效。

Method: 提出APFed框架：主动客户端作为学习任务发起者构建完整模型，被动客户端仅作为训练阶段的辅助。基于该框架实例化了两种分类方法，分别使用重建损失和对比损失训练被动客户端。

Result: 实验验证了两种APFed实例化方法均取得了理想的效果，证明了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: APFed框架在垂直联邦学习中实现了灵活、稳定的推理服务，摆脱了推理阶段对多客户端协作的依赖。

Abstract: Vertical federated learning is a natural and elegant approach to integrate multi-view data vertically partitioned across devices (clients) while preserving their privacies. Apart from the model training, existing methods requires the collaboration of all clients in the model inference. However, the model inference is probably maintained for service in a long time, while the collaboration, especially when the clients belong to different organizations, is unpredictable in real-world scenarios, such as concellation of contract, network unavailablity, etc., resulting in the failure of them. To address this issue, we, at the first attempt, propose a flexible Active-Passive Federated learning (APFed) framework. Specifically, the active client is the initiator of a learning task and responsible to build the complete model, while the passive clients only serve as assistants. Once the model built, the active client can make inference independently. In addition, we instance the APFed framework into two classification methods with employing the reconstruction loss and the contrastive loss on passive clients, respectively. Meanwhile, the two methods are tested in a set of experiments and achieves desired results, validating their effectiveness.

</details>


### [431] [Boosting Graph Robustness Against Backdoor Attacks: An Over-Similarity Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.01272)
*Chang Liu,Hai Huang,Yujie Xing,Xingquan Zuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对图神经网络后门攻击，本文提出SimGuard防御方法，利用触发器在特征和结构上过度相似的观察，通过基于相似度的度量和对比学习检测触发器，有效抵御多种后门攻击同时保持干净节点性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图神经网络后门攻击防御方法面临两大挑战：无法清晰区分触发器和干净节点导致误删大量干净节点，或无法消除触发器影响导致目标节点无法恢复至攻击前状态。因此需要一种更有效的防御方法。

Method: SimGuard首先利用基于相似度的度量检测触发器，然后采用对比学习训练后门检测器，生成能够分离触发器与干净节点的嵌入表示，从而提高检测效率。

Result: 在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，SimGuard能有效防御多种图后门攻击，同时保持对干净节点的性能。

Conclusion: 本文基于对现有后门攻击中触发器在特征和结构上过度相似的观察，提出的SimGuard方法能有效解决现有防御方法的核心问题，为图神经网络后门防御提供了新思路。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved notable success in tasks such as social and transportation networks. However, recent studies have highlighted the vulnerability of GNNs to backdoor attacks, raising significant concerns about their reliability in real-world applications. Despite initial efforts to defend against specific graph backdoor attacks, existing defense methods face two main challenges: either the inability to establish a clear distinction between triggers and clean nodes, resulting in the removal of many clean nodes, or the failure to eliminate the impact of triggers, making it challenging to restore the target nodes to their pre-attack state. Through empirical analysis of various existing graph backdoor attacks, we observe that the triggers generated by these methods exhibit over-similarity in both features and structure. Based on this observation, we propose a novel graph backdoor defense method SimGuard. We first utilizes a similarity-based metric to detect triggers and then employs contrastive learning to train a backdoor detector that generates embeddings capable of separating triggers from clean nodes, thereby improving detection efficiency. Extensive experiments conducted on real-world datasets demonstrate that our proposed method effectively defends against various graph backdoor attacks while preserving performance on clean nodes. The code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [432] [Representational Alignment with Chemical Induced Fit for Molecular Relational Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07027)
*Peiliang Zhang,Jingling Yuan,Qing Xie,Yongjun Zhu,Chao Che,Lin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReAlignFit框架，通过化学诱导契合的归纳偏置对齐分子子结构表示，利用偏差校正函数和子图信息瓶颈提升分子关系学习的稳定性，在9个数据集上超越现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子关系学习中，基于注意力机制的子结构表示对齐缺乏化学知识指导，导致模型在化学空间（如官能团、分子骨架）分布偏移时性能不稳定。

Method: 提出ReAlignFit框架：1）引入化学诱导契合（Induced Fit）作为归纳偏置；2）设计基于子结构边重构的偏差校正函数，模拟化学构象变化来动态对齐子结构表示；3）在拟合过程中集成子图信息瓶颈，筛选高化学功能兼容性的子结构对以生成分子嵌入。

Result: 在9个数据集上的实验表明，ReAlignFit在两个任务上优于现有最先进模型，并在规则偏移和骨架偏移的数据分布下显著提升了模型的稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过引入化学知识引导的归纳偏置，有效提升了分子关系学习在分布偏移下的稳定性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Molecular Relational Learning (MRL) is widely applied in natural sciences to predict relationships between molecular pairs by extracting structural features. The representational similarity between substructure pairs determines the functional compatibility of molecular binding sites. Nevertheless, aligning substructure representations by attention mechanisms lacks guidance from chemical knowledge, resulting in unstable model performance in chemical space (\textit{e.g.}, functional group, scaffold) shifted data. With theoretical justification, we propose the \textbf{Re}presentational \textbf{Align}ment with Chemical Induced \textbf{Fit} (ReAlignFit) to enhance the stability of MRL. ReAlignFit dynamically aligns substructure representation in MRL by introducing chemical Induced Fit-based inductive bias. In the induction process, we design the Bias Correction Function based on substructure edge reconstruction to align representations between substructure pairs by simulating chemical conformational changes (dynamic combination of substructures). ReAlignFit further integrates the Subgraph Information Bottleneck during fit process to refine and optimize substructure pairs exhibiting high chemical functional compatibility, leveraging them to generate molecular embeddings. Experimental results on nine datasets demonstrate that ReAlignFit outperforms state-of-the-art models in two tasks and significantly enhances model's stability in both rule-shifted and scaffold-shifted data distributions.

</details>


### [433] [AdaGC: Enhancing LLM Pretraining Stability via Adaptive Gradient Clipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.11034)
*Guoxia Wang,Shuai Li,Congliang Chen,Jinle Zeng,Jiabin Yang,Dianhai Yu,Yanjun Ma,Li Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaGC，一种自适应逐张量梯度裁剪方法，通过基于张量级历史裁剪值的指数移动平均来约束梯度范数，有效消除大语言模型预训练中的loss spike问题，在Llama-2 7B、Mixtral 8x1B和ERNIE 10B-A1.4B等模型上实现零spike分数，并在下游准确率上超越GlobalGC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Loss spike是大规模语言模型预训练中持续存在的障碍，以往研究尝试通过调查单一因素来识别根源，但实践中这类spike通常由异构因素的共同作用触发，包括数据异常值、硬件或瞬时计算故障、数值精度问题以及超参数设置等。

Method: 提出AdaGC（Adaptive Gradient Clipping），一种自适应逐张量梯度裁剪方案。其核心思想是通过张量级的指数移动平均（EMA）对历史裁剪值进行追踪，以此约束当前梯度范数，从而减轻异常梯度对优化器一阶和二阶动量状态的污染。该方法与优化器无关，内存开销可忽略，且在混合并行分布式训练中比GlobalGC通信成本更低。

Result: 在Llama-2 7B、Mixtral 8x1B和ERNIE 10B-A1.4B上的实验表明：AdaGC稳健地消除了训练不稳定性，将所有模型的spike分数降至零；下游准确率比GlobalGC分别提升1.32%、1.27%和2.48%；与Muon、Lion等优化器无缝集成，均实现零spike分数和更高的平均准确率。

Conclusion: AdaGC是一种原则性的、以梯度为中心的解决方案，能够有效应对loss spike问题，具有优化器无关、内存开销低、通信成本小等优势，实验证明其在多种模型架构和优化器上均能稳定消除训练不稳定性并提升模型性能。

Abstract: Loss spikes remain a persistent obstacle in large-scale language model pretraining. While previous research has attempted to identify the root cause of loss spikes by investigating individual factors, we observe that, in practice, such spikes are typically triggered by the confluence of heterogeneous factors. Empirically, loss spikes may arise from a combination of data outliers, hardware or transient computational faults, numerical precision issues, and hyperparameter settings. Regardless of the underlying cause, these spikes manifest as unstable optimizer updates, as abnormal gradients contaminate both first- and second-moment states. In this paper, we propose a principled gradient-centric remedy: AdaGC, an adaptive per-tensor gradient clipping scheme that mitigates such contamination by bounding gradient norms relative to a tensor-wise exponential moving average of their historical clipped values. AdaGC is optimizer-agnostic, introduces negligible memory overhead, and reduces communication costs compared to GlobalGC, particularly in hybrid-parallel distributed training. Experiments on Llama-2 7B, Mixtral 8x1B, and ERNIE 10B-A1.4B demonstrate that AdaGC robustly eliminates training instabilities, consistently reducing spike scores to zero for all models and improving downstream accuracy over GlobalGC by 1.32%, 1.27%, and 2.48%, respectively. Furthermore, AdaGC seamlessly integrates with optimizers such as Muon and Lion, consistently yielding higher average accuracy and zero spike scores. The code is available at https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleFleet (see Research/AdaGC).

</details>


### [434] [Integrating Biological-Informed Recurrent Neural Networks for Glucose-Insulin Dynamics Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.19158)
*Stefano De Carli,Nicola Licini,Davide Previtali,Fabio Previdi,Antonio Ferramosca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种生物信息循环神经网络(BIRNN)框架，通过将生理约束嵌入GRU网络的物理信息损失函数，提升人工胰腺系统中血糖预测精度与未测量状态重建能力，在UVA/Padova模拟器上验证优于传统线性模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数学模型难以捕捉患者特异性变异，无法适应个体差异，导致人工胰腺系统中血糖-胰岛素动态建模不准确，限制了闭环控制效果。

Method: 采用门控循环单元(GRU)架构，引入物理信息损失函数嵌入生理约束，在保证预测精度的同时确保与生物学原理一致。

Result: 在商用UVA/Padova模拟器上验证，BIRNN在血糖预测精度和未测量状态重建方面优于传统线性模型，即使在胰岛素敏感性昼夜节律变化条件下仍表现良好。

Conclusion: BIRNN框架在个性化血糖调节和未来人工胰腺系统自适应控制策略中具有潜力。

Abstract: Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) management is a complex task due to many variability factors. Artificial Pancreas (AP) systems have alleviated patient burden by automating insulin delivery through advanced control algorithms. However, the effectiveness of these systems depends on accurate modeling of glucose-insulin dynamics, which traditional mathematical models often fail to capture due to their inability to adapt to patient-specific variations. This study introduces a Biological-Informed Recurrent Neural Network (BIRNN) framework to address these limitations. The BIRNN leverages a Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) architecture augmented with physics-informed loss functions that embed physiological constraints, ensuring a balance between predictive accuracy and consistency with biological principles. The framework is validated using the commercial UVA/Padova simulator, outperforming traditional linear models in glucose prediction accuracy and reconstruction of unmeasured states, even under circadian variations in insulin sensitivity. The results demonstrate the potential of BIRNN for personalized glucose regulation and future adaptive control strategies in AP systems.

</details>


### [435] [CITRAS: Covariate-Informed Transformer for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.24007)
*Yosuke Yamaguchi,Issei Suemitsu,Wenpeng Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CITRAS，一种仅解码器Transformer架构，通过KV Shift和注意力分数平滑机制，灵活整合已知协变量和观测协变量进行时间序列预测，在多个真实数据集上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习预测模型难以处理已知协变量未来部分与目标变量之间的长度不匹配问题，且难以同时捕捉局部协变量影响和全局跨变量依赖关系。

Method: 基于仅解码器Transformer架构，提出两种新颖机制：1) KV Shift将已知协变量的未来部分与目标变量对齐；2) 注意力分数平滑将局部精准的逐块跨变量依赖平滑为全局变量级依赖。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上，CITRAS在协变量辅助和多元预测设置下均展现出优异的预测性能。

Conclusion: CITRAS能有效利用跨变量和跨时间依赖关系提升预测精度，具备灵活整合多种协变量的通用能力。

Abstract: In time series forecasting, covariates represent external factors that influence target variables. Some covariates are observable only in the past (observed covariates, such as recorded weather data), while others are known in advance (known covariates, such as calendar events or discount schedules). Although covariates have the potential to enhance forecasting performance, most deep learning-based forecasting models struggle to address the length discrepancy between variables caused by the future portion of known covariates and fail to leverage them flexibly. Moreover, capturing dependencies between target variables and covariates is non-trivial, as models must accurately reflect the local impact of covariates while simultaneously modeling global cross-variate dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose CITRAS, a decoder-only Transformer that flexibly integrates multiple target variables, observed covariates, and known covariates. While preserving strong autoregressive modeling capabilities, CITRAS introduces two novel mechanisms within patch-wise cross-variate attention: Key-Value (KV) Shift and Attention Score Smoothing. KV Shift seamlessly incorporates the future portion of known covariates into the forecasting process by aligning them with target variables based on their concurrent dependencies. Attention Score Smoothing refines locally accurate patch-wise cross-variate dependencies into global variate-level dependencies by smoothing the historical attention scores. Experimentally, CITRAS demonstrates strong performance across a wide range of real-world datasets in both covariate-informed and multivariate settings, showcasing its versatile ability to leverage cross-variate and cross-time dependencies for improved forecasting accuracy.

</details>


### [436] [Post-Training Augmentation Invariance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11702)
*Keenan Eikenberry,Lizuo Liu,Yoonsang Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种后训练增强不变性框架，通过轻量级单隐层MLP适配器网络（附加在预训练模型潜在空间后），在不微调原模型且不破坏原始特征的前提下，实现近似增强不变性。在STL10数据集上，该方法将任意旋转图像的分类准确率从71%提升至94%，噪声不变分类从58%提升至86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在引入增强不变性时通常需要微调整个网络或破坏原始特征空间。本文旨在为预训练网络添加不变性属性，同时保持其在原始（非增强）输入分布上的行为不变，且不进行任何微调。

Method: 定义了后训练增强不变性的严格概念；引入增强编码器（形式化基于增强的编码过程的概率编码器）；提出两种损失函数：Markov-Wasserstein最小化和Wasserstein相关最大化；训练轻量级单隐层MLP适配器网络E_θ，附加在预训练网络F的潜在空间之后，构成复合网络C∘E_θ∘F。

Result: 在STL10上使用DINO特征：任意旋转图像分类准确率从71%（无适配器）提升至94%；噪声不变分类从58%提升至86%。适配器近似等距作用于原始潜在分布，几乎不引入特征损坏。对比实验显示SimCLR和HSIC最大化作为候选损失会导致不合格的分类结果并破坏原始潜在空间。

Conclusion: 所提出的两种损失（Markov-Wasserstein最小化和Wasserstein相关最大化）能有效训练轻量级适配器网络实现后训练增强不变性，无需微调原模型，且保持原始特征完整性，优于SimCLR和HSIC等对比方法。

Abstract: This work develops a framework for post-training augmentation invariance, in which our goal is to add invariance properties to a pretrained network without altering its behavior on the original, non-augmented input distribution. We define this notion precisely and additionally introduce augmented encoders, which are probabilistic encoders that formalize augmentation-based encoding processes and that serve as our fundamental object of study. We introduce two losses for augmented encoders, namely, Markov-Wasserstein minimization and Wasserstein correlation maximization, and we demonstrate empirically that both losses can be used to train lightweight, one-hidden-layer MLP adapter networks $E_θ$ that, when appended to the latent space of a pretrained network $F$, do indeed lead to (approximate) post-training augmentation invariance. For example, on STL10 with $F=\text{DINO}$ features, the composite network $C\circ E_θ\circ F$, where $C$ is a linear classifier and where $E_θ$ is one of our proposed adapter networks, achieves 94% classification accuracy on arbitrarily rotated images, whereas a network of the form $C\circ F$ without the adapter $E_θ$ drops to 71% accuracy. Similarly, we can boost noise-invariant classification results from 58% up to 86%. Significantly, we obtain these results with no fine-tuning (the weights of $F$ remain frozen throughout), and our methods introduce little corruption to the original features, since $E_θ$ acts nearly isometrically on the non-augmented latent distribution. In contrast, we show that adapter networks trained with alternative candidate losses, specifically SimCLR and HSIC maximization, produce uncompetitive classification results and fundamentally corrupt the original latent space. Code available at https://github.com/keenan-eikenberry/augmentation_invariance

</details>


### [437] [FreshRetailNet-LT: A Stockout-Annotated Censored Demand Dataset for Latent Demand Recovery and Forecasting in Fresh Retail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.16319)
*Yangyang Wang,Jiawei Gu,Li Long,Xin Li,Li Shen,Zhouyu Fu,Xiangjun Zhou,Xu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FreshRetailNet-50K是一个包含50,000条小时级销售序列的大规模基准数据集，涵盖18个城市898家门店的863种生鲜SKU，并带有精确的缺货事件标注。基于该数据集的两阶段需求建模方法（先重建缺货期间隐藏需求，再训练预测模型）可将预测准确率提升2.73%，并将系统性需求低估从7.37%降至接近零偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售业务中准确的需求估计对生鲜产品的库存和定价策略至关重要，但缺货期间的销售数据截断（censored sales data）导致未观察到的需求产生系统性政策偏差，现有数据集缺乏解决此问题所需的时间分辨率和标注信息。

Method: 构建FreshRetailNet-50K数据集（50,000条小时级销售时间序列，含缺货事件标注）；提出两阶段需求建模方法：第一阶段利用小时级精确标注重建缺货期间的潜在需求，第二阶段使用恢复后的需求训练鲁棒的需求预测模型。

Result: 两阶段方法实现预测准确率提升2.73%，系统性需求低估从7.37%降至接近零偏差。

Conclusion: FreshRetailNet-50K以空前的时空粒度和真实标注数据，为需求插补、生鲜库存优化和因果零售分析开辟了新方向，解决了零售AI中长期存在的局限性。

Abstract: Accurate demand estimation is critical for the retail business in guiding the inventory and pricing policies of perishable products. However, it faces fundamental challenges from censored sales data during stockouts, where unobserved demand creates systemic policy biases. Existing datasets lack the temporal resolution and annotations needed to address this censoring effect. To fill this gap, we present FreshRetailNet-50K, the first large-scale benchmark for censored demand estimation. It comprises 50,000 store-product time series of detailed hourly sales data from 898 stores in 18 major cities, encompassing 863 perishable SKUs meticulously annotated for stockout events. The hourly stock status records unique to this dataset, combined with rich contextual covariates, including promotional discounts, precipitation, and temporal features, enable innovative research beyond existing solutions. We demonstrate one such use case of two-stage demand modeling: first, we reconstruct the latent demand during stockouts using precise hourly annotations. We then leverage the recovered demand to train robust demand forecasting models in the second stage. Experimental results show that this approach achieves a 2.73% improvement in prediction accuracy while reducing the systematic demand underestimation from 7.37% to near-zero bias. With unprecedented temporal granularity and comprehensive real-world information, FreshRetailNet-50K opens new research directions in demand imputation, perishable inventory optimization, and causal retail analytics. The unique annotation quality and scale of the dataset address long-standing limitations in retail AI, providing immediate solutions and a platform for future methodological innovation. The data (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Dingdong-Inc/FreshRetailNet-50K) and code (https://github.com/Dingdong-Inc/frn-50k-baseline}) are openly released.

</details>


### [438] [A Machine Learning Theory Perspective on Strategic Litigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.03411)
*Melissa Dutz,Han Shao,Avrim Blum,Aloni Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从机器学习理论视角研究战略诉讼：在普通法体系中，战略诉讼人通过向高等法院提交特定案件，影响下级法院适用的决策规则（如最近邻或支持向量机），并刻画了可诱导决策规则集合及最优案件选择算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索战略诉讼人在普通法体系中如何通过策略性选择案件来影响法律先例，从而对后续案件产生广泛影响，并将此问题形式化为机器学习理论可分析的问题。

Method: 构建了一个抽象模型：高等法院过往裁决构成训练数据，下级法院通过学习算法（一维最近邻或多维SVM）从中学得决策规则并应用于新案件。战略诉讼人可以策略性地选择案件提交给高等法院，以影响下级法院未来的决策规则。研究分析了这一优化问题的结构，并开发了最优案件选择算法。

Result: 证明了即使在一维最近邻这类简单设置下，战略案件选择问题也存在反直觉现象；对于一维最近邻和多维SVM，刻画了可诱导决策规则的集合，并开发了根据诉讼人目标选择最优案件集的高效算法。

Conclusion: 战略诉讼的案件选择具有丰富的结构特性，可以通过机器学习理论进行系统分析，为法律实践中的诉讼策略提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Strategic litigation involves bringing a case to court with the goal of having an impact beyond resolving the particular dispute at hand. In a common law system, one way a case may have far-reaching impact is by establishing new legal precedent that later courts must follow. In this paper, we explore strategic litigation from the perspective of machine learning theory. We consider an abstract model of a common law legal system where a lower court decides new cases by applying a decision rule learned from a higher court's past rulings. In this model, we explore the power of a strategic litigator, who strategically brings cases to the higher court to influence the decision rule applied by the lower court in future cases. We explore questions including: What impact can a strategic litigator have? Which cases should a strategic litigator bring to court? Does it ever make sense for a strategic litigator to bring a case when they are sure the court will rule against them? We show that this strategic case selection problem has interesting structure, with even simple settings exhibiting counterintuitive phenomena. When cases are represented by points in one dimension and the lower court's learning algorithm is nearest neighbor, or as points in d dimensions and the lower court's learning algorithm is a support vector machine, we characterize the set of inducible decision rules and develop algorithms for selecting an optimal set of cases to bring to the higher court given the strategic litigator's objectives.

</details>


### [439] [Fact-Augmented Lookahead Planning for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09171)
*Samuel Holt,Max Ruiz Luyten,Thomas Pouplin,Mihaela van der Schaar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LWM-Planner通过从历史轨迹中提取关键原子事实并利用这些事实进行前瞻规划，在无需参数更新的情况下显著提升了LLM Agent在部分可观察、长时域交互环境中的规划能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Agent在交互式、部分可观察、长时域环境中，当搜索缺乏引导或近期历史信息不足时，规划效果不佳。现有方法（如ReAct、Reflexion）未能充分利用经验中提炼的结构化知识来指导搜索。

Method: 提出LWM-Planner框架：(1) 每轮结束后从轨迹中提取任务关键原子事实；(2) 通过预测一致性过滤器验证候选事实，并可选择压缩；(3) 利用事实集来条件化动作提议、单步潜在世界模型模拟和状态值估计；(4) 通过递归、深度受限的前瞻搜索进行规划，无需参数更新。从抽象角度将事实视为降低状态混叠（代理ε_sim），将事实条件化模拟视为降低单步误差（代理δ_model）。

Result: 在文本FrozenLake变体、CrafterMini和ALFWorld上，LWM-Planner的累计回报优于ReAct、Reflexion以及纯搜索基线。表明额外的测试时搜索在由紧凑的、经验衍生的事实支撑时最为有效。

Conclusion: 通过纯上下文学习，从经验中提取事实并利用它们引导前瞻规划，是一种有效的在线改进LLM Agent行为的方法，无需参数更新。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly capable, but LLM agents still struggle to plan effectively in interactive, partially observable, long-horizon environments when search is unguided or recent history is insufficient. We introduce LWM-Planner, a fact-augmented lookahead planning framework that improves agent behavior purely through in-context learning. After each episode, the agent extracts task-critical atomic facts from its trajectories, validates candidates with a lightweight predictive-consistency filter (and optionally compresses them), and uses the resulting fact set to condition action proposal, single-step latent world-model simulation, and state-value estimation. Planning then proceeds via recursive, depth-limited lookahead over candidate trajectories conditioned on the accumulated facts and recent history, enabling online improvement without parameter updates. We provide abstraction-style motivation: treating facts as reducing state aliasing (proxy $ε_{\mathrm{sim}}$) and fact-conditioned simulation as lowering one-step error (proxy $δ_{\mathrm{model}}$), without claiming formal guarantees. Empirically, on text FrozenLake variants, CrafterMini, and ALFWorld, the approach improves cumulative return over ReAct/Reflexion and search-only baselines, suggesting that additional test-time search is most useful when grounded by compact, experience-derived facts.

</details>


### [440] [GRID: Scaling Task-Agnostic Inference in Continual Prompt Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.14725)
*Anushka Tiwari,Sayantan Pal,Rohini K. Srihari,Kaiyi Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GRID是一个统一的持续学习框架，通过输出空间感知解码和梯度引导提示选择，解决了基于提示的持续学习中任务感知推理依赖和提示可扩展性问题，在长序列和负迁移基准上提升了后向迁移并减少了内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于提示的持续学习方法依赖任务感知推理并维护不断扩展的任务特定提示集，导致：(1) 推理时任务标识符不可用时，早期任务性能严重下降；(2) 随任务序列增长，可扩展性受限。

Method: (1) 输出空间感知解码机制：利用代表性输入和自动标签语义归一化增强后向迁移；(2) 梯度引导提示选择策略：将信息量较少的提示压缩为单个聚合表示，实现可扩展、内存高效的持续学习。

Result: 在长序列和负迁移基准上，GRID提升了后向迁移，实现了有竞争力的前向迁移，并在T5、Qwen、LLaMA等编码器-解码器和解码器-only架构上显著减少了提示内存。

Conclusion: GRID通过统一框架有效解决了任务感知推理依赖和可扩展性两大挑战，是一种参数高效、内存友好的持续学习方法。

Abstract: Prompt-based continual learning (CL) offers a parameter-efficient way to adapt large language models (LLMs) across task sequences. However, existing methods often rely on task-aware inference and maintain an expanding set of task-specific prompts, leading to (1) severe performance degradation on earlier tasks when task identifiers are unavailable for prompt selection at inference time, and (2) limited scalability as task sequence grows. We propose GRID, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. GRID incorporates an output-space-aware decoding mechanism that enhances backward transfer by leveraging representative inputs and automatic label semantic normalization, alongside a gradient-guided prompt selection strategy that compresses less informative prompts into a single aggregated representation for scalable, memory-efficient continual learning. Extensive experiments on long-sequence and negative-transfer benchmarks show that GRID improves backward transfer, achieves competitive forward transfer, and substantially reduces prompt memory across encoder-decoder and decoder-only architectures, including T5, Qwen, and LLaMA. Source code is available at https://github.com/AnushkaTi/GRID.

</details>


### [441] [Optimization-based Online Conformal Prediction for Multi-step Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.13362)
*Ruipu Li,Daniel Menacho,Alexander Rodríguez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出O2CP框架，通过双层优化架构（外层保证有效性的参数可行域+内层联合误差分布约束优化）与轻量采样策略，在在线时间序列预测中实现兼顾覆盖有效性与效率的共形预测，实验证明在自动驾驶、气候预测等领域优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线多步共形预测方法存在两难困境：独立校准各时间步忽略时序相关性导致覆盖失效，而强行要求同时覆盖则产生过于保守的预测区间。缺乏既能建模多步误差依赖又不牺牲长期边际覆盖保证的统一框架。

Method: 1. 理论证明当校准参数保持在定义的"安全区域"内时，标准在线共形更新仍保持覆盖有效性；2. 提出双层架构：外层定义可接受参数集保证有效性，内层进行约束优化建模联合误差分布并最小化全水平目标；3. 设计轻量采样策略估计联合分布，避免大规模校准集需求。

Result: 在自动驾驶、气候预测、公共卫生等多个真实世界数据集上，O2CP持续优于SOTA基线，在实现目标覆盖率的同时显著更尖锐的预测区间，并在长时域上降低遗憾值。

Conclusion: O2CP成功解决了在线多步共形预测中覆盖有效性与效率的权衡问题，为时序不确定性量化提供了理论扎实且计算高效的统一框架。

Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) is well-suited for uncertainty quantification in time series forecasting due to its distribution-free coverage guarantees. However, existing multi-step methods often struggle to balance coverage validity with efficiency: they either calibrate horizons independently, ignoring temporal correlations, or enforce strict simultaneous coverage, resulting in overly conservative intervals. In this work, we propose O2CP: Optimization-based Online Conformal Prediction, a unified framework for online conformal prediction that explicitly models multi-step error dependencies without sacrificing long-term marginal coverage guarantees. We first prove that standard online conformal updates maintain validity as long as calibration parameters remain within a defined "safe" region. Leveraging this theoretical insight, we introduce a two-layer architecture: an outer layer that defines admissible parameter sets to ensure validity, and an inner layer that performs constrained optimization to model joint error distributions and minimize horizon-wide objectives. To make this computationally feasible, we develop a lightweight sampling strategy that estimates joint distributions without requiring large calibration sets. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets, including autonomous driving, climate forecasting, and public health, demonstrate that O2CP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving target coverage with significantly sharper prediction intervals and reduced regret over long horizons.

</details>


### [442] [A Sketch-and-Project Analysis of Subsampled Natural Gradient Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.21022)
*Gil Goldshlager,Jiang Hu,Lin Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过将子采样自然梯度下降(SNG)重新分析为草图投影方法，提出基于平方体积采样的新理论代理，证明了单小批量下SNG方向期望等价于预条件梯度下降步，建立了全局收敛保证，并揭示了SNG相比SGD能更有效利用模型雅可比矩阵的谱衰减。同时，将结构化动量方案SPRING解释为加速草图投影方法的自然产物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准分析基于随机预条件方法无法为实际小样本设置提供洞见，需要克服这一局限性。

Method: 将SNG重新分析为草图投影方法，提出基于平方体积采样的新理论代理替代传统解耦代理，证明耦合条件下SNG方向期望仍等于预条件梯度下降步。

Result: (i)任意大小单小批量的全局收敛保证；(ii)用草图投影结构相关量显式刻画收敛速率；揭示SNG相比SGD的优势在于更能有效利用模型雅可比矩阵的谱衰减。

Conclusion: 新理论框架为小样本设置提供了新见解，并将SPRING动量方案解释为加速草图投影方法的自然产物。

Abstract: Subsampled natural gradient descent (SNG) has been used to enable high-precision scientific machine learning, but standard analyses based on stochastic preconditioning fail to provide insight into realistic small-sample settings. We overcome this limitation by instead analyzing SNG as a sketch-and-project method. Motivated by this lens, we discard the usual theoretical proxy which decouples gradients and preconditioners using two independent mini-batches, and we replace it with a new proxy based on squared volume sampling. Under this new proxy we show that the expectation of the SNG direction becomes equal to a preconditioned gradient descent step even in the presence of coupling, leading to (i) global convergence guarantees when using a single mini-batch of any size, and (ii) an explicit characterization of the convergence rate in terms of quantities related to the sketch-and-project structure. These findings in turn yield new insights into small-sample settings, for example by suggesting that the advantage of SNG over SGD is that it can more effectively exploit spectral decay in the model Jacobian. We also extend these ideas to explain a popular structured momentum scheme for SNG, known as SPRING, by showing that it arises naturally from accelerated sketch-and-project methods.

</details>


### [443] [Generation Properties of Stochastic Interpolation under Finite Training Set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21925)
*Yunchen Li,Shaohui Lin,Zhou Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了生成模型在有限训练样本下的理论行为，推导了随机插值生成框架中最优速度场和得分函数的闭式解，证明了确定性过程精确恢复训练样本，随机过程则表现为带高斯噪声的样本。进一步定义了生成模型的欠拟合与过拟合，揭示了估计误差下随机生成过程会产生训练样本的凸组合，并受到均匀和高斯混合噪声的污染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索生成模型在有限训练样本（非无限样本）条件下的理论行为，揭示有限样本对生成模型性能的根本影响，并建立与经典统计学习概念（欠拟合、过拟合）的联系。

Method: 在随机插值生成框架下，推导了有限训练样本下最优速度场和得分函数的闭式解；引入生成模型特有的欠拟合和过拟合形式化定义；理论分析了估计误差下随机生成过程的样本构成。

Result: 确定性生成过程精确恢复训练样本；随机生成过程表现为带高斯噪声的训练样本；存在估计误差时，生成过程产生训练样本的凸组合并受均匀和高斯混合噪声污染。

Conclusion: 有限样本下生成模型的行为可以被精确刻画，理论与实验一致支持所提出的分析框架，为理解生成模型的泛化行为提供了理论依据。

Abstract: This paper investigates the theoretical behavior of generative models under finite training populations. Within the stochastic interpolation generative framework, we derive closed-form expressions for the optimal velocity field and score function when only a finite number of training samples are available. We demonstrate that, under some regularity conditions, the deterministic generative process exactly recovers the training samples, while the stochastic generative process manifests as training samples with added Gaussian noise. Beyond the idealized setting, we consider model estimation errors and introduce formal definitions of underfitting and overfitting specific to generative models. Our theoretical analysis reveals that, in the presence of estimation errors, the stochastic generation process effectively produces convex combinations of training samples corrupted by a mixture of uniform and Gaussian noise. Experiments on generation tasks and downstream tasks such as classification support our theory.

</details>


### [444] [Informed Asymmetric Actor-Critic: Leveraging Privileged Signals Beyond Full-State Access](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26000)
*Daniel Ebi,Damien Ernst,Klemens Böhm,Gaspard Lambrechts*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种非对称强化学习框架，允许评论家基于任意状态相关的特权信号进行条件化，并证明由此获得的策略梯度估计是无偏的。同时提出两种信息量筛选准则，实验表明精心选择的特权信号可用更少状态信息匹敌或超越全状态基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非对称演员-评论家方法通常假设训练期间评论家可访问完整环境状态，这在实践中往往不现实。作者希望放宽这一假设，允许评论家基于任意状态相关的特权信号进行学习，同时保证策略梯度无偏性。

Method: 1) 提出信息非对称演员-评论家框架，允许评论家以任意状态相关特权信号为条件。2) 证明任意此类信号均能产生无偏策略梯度估计。3) 提出两种信息量筛选准则：基于依赖性的预训练测试和基于价值预测改进的后验测试。

Result: 在部分可观测基准和合成环境上的实验表明，精心选择的特权信号可以用更少的状态信息匹配或超越全状态非对称基线的性能。

Conclusion: 本文显著扩展了非对称强化学习中可用的特权信息范围，并提供了有效的信号选择方法，在保持性能的同时降低了对完整状态信息的依赖。

Abstract: Asymmetric reinforcement learning leverages privileged information available during training to improve learning under partial observability. Existing asymmetric actor-critic methods typically assume access to the full environment state to condition the critic during training, which is often unrealistic in practice. We introduce the informed asymmetric actor-critic framework that allows the critic to be conditioned on arbitrary state-dependent privileged signals, and show that any such signal yields unbiased policy gradient estimates. This substantially expands the set of admissible privileged information and raises the problem of selecting the most informative signals for learning. To this end, we propose two novel informativeness criteria: a dependence-based test that can be applied prior to training, and a test based on improvements in value prediction that can be applied post hoc. Experiments on partially observable benchmarks and synthetic environments demonstrate that carefully selected privileged signals can match or outperform full-state asymmetric baselines while relying on strictly less state information.

</details>


### [445] [Influence Dynamics and Stagewise Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.12071)
*Jin Hwa Lee,Matthew Smith,Maxwell Adam,Jesse Hoogland*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于奇异学习理论的分阶段数据归因框架，揭示了神经网络训练过程中样本影响会动态变化（包括符号翻转和峰值），并在玩具模型和语言模型中验证了这些现象与学习阶段和语义层次发展的对应关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练数据归因方法将样本间的影响视为静态的，但神经网络的学习过程具有阶段性，不同阶段的影响模式会发生变化。作者希望捕捉这种动态变化的归因模式。

Method: 基于奇异学习理论（Singular Learning Theory）构建分阶段数据归因框架，在玩具模型中通过分析和实验验证影响非单调变化的预测，并在大规模语言模型中验证token级影响变化与已知发展阶段的对应关系。

Result: 验证了样本影响会非单调变化，包括符号翻转和在学习转折点出现尖锐峰值；玩具模型中这些动态变化直接映射到模型逐步学习的语义层次结构；语言模型中token级影响变化与已知的发展阶段一致。

Conclusion: 数据归因应当考虑模型训练的阶段性和动态性，而非静态归因；奇异学习理论为理解这种动态变化提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Current training data attribution (TDA) methods treat the influence one sample has on another as static, but neural networks learn in distinct stages that exhibit changing patterns of influence. In this work, we introduce a framework for stagewise data attribution grounded in singular learning theory. We predict that influence can change non-monotonically, including sign flips and sharp peaks at developmental transitions. We first validate these predictions analytically and empirically in a toy model, showing that dynamic shifts in influence directly map to the model's progressive learning of a semantic hierarchy. Finally, we demonstrate these phenomena at scale in language models, where token-level influence changes align with known developmental stages.

</details>


### [446] [Learning-Guided Integration Contours Construction for Fast Large-Scale Generalized Eigensolvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.01927)
*Yeqiu Chen,Ziyan Liu,Hong Wang,Lei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Deepcontour混合框架，结合深度学习预测器（ENO）与核密度估计（KDE）自动优化轮廓积分法的积分路径，在保持数值精度的前提下实现高达5.63倍加速，用于高效求解大规模广义特征值问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模广义特征值问题的计算成本极高，现有轮廓积分法性能严重依赖积分轮廓的选择，而缺乏先验知识时不当选择会导致显著计算开销和数值精度损失。

Method: 提出Deepcontour框架：1）设计专用Eigen-Neural-Operator（ENO）深度学习网络快速预测谱分布先验；2）基于预测结果驱动KDE模块自动构建优化积分轮廓；3）将优化轮廓输入CI求解器高效计算目标特征值。

Result: 在多种科学数据集上实现高达5.63倍加速，同时保持严格的数值精度。

Conclusion: 通过融合深度学习预测能力与经典数值方法的严格性，建立了一种高效且鲁棒的大规模广义特征值问题求解范式。

Abstract: Solving large-scale Generalized Eigenvalue Problems (GEPs) is a fundamental yet computationally prohibitive task in science and engineering. As a promising direction, contour integral (CI) methods offer an efficient and parallelizable framework. However, their performance is critically dependent on the selection of integration contours -- improper selection without reliable prior knowledge of eigenvalue distribution can incur significant computational overhead and compromise numerical accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose Deepcontour, a novel hybrid framework that integrates a deep learning-based spectral predictor with Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) for principled contour design. Specifically, Deepcontour utilizes its specialized Eigen-Neural-Operator (ENO) to provide rapid spectral distribution priors, driving a KDE module to automatically construct the optimized integration contours, which guide the CI solver to efficiently find the desired eigenvalues. Deepcontour achieves up to a 5.63x speedup across diverse scientific datasets while maintaining strict numerical rigor. By merging the predictive power of deep learning with the numerical rigor of classical solvers, this work establishes an efficient and robust paradigm for solving large-scale GEPs.

</details>


### [447] [Lost in Serialization: Invariance and Generalization of LLM Graph Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.10234)
*Daniel Herbst,Lea Karbevska,Divyanshu Kumar,Akanksha Ahuja,Fatemeh Gholamzadeh Nasrabadi,Fabrizio Frasca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了基于LLM的图推理器对图表示中对称性的鲁棒性问题，提出图序列化的原则性分解方法（节点标记、边编码、语法），并通过全面基准测试评估了微调对编码敏感性和未见任务泛化的影响。结果表明：更大模型更鲁棒，微调降低了对节点重标记的敏感性但增加了对结构和格式变化的敏感性，且未能一致提升未见任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的图推理器缺乏对图表示中对称性的内置不变性，在节点重新索引、边重排序或格式变化下会产生不同输出，引发鲁棒性担忧。

Method: 提出将图序列化解构为节点标记、边编码和语法三个因素，设计全面的基准测试套件评估LLM对这些因素变化的鲁棒性，并提出一组新的谱任务以评估微调后推理器的泛化能力。

Result: 更大的未微调模型更鲁棒；微调降低了节点重标记敏感性但增加了结构和格式变化敏感性；微调在未见任务上未能一致提升性能。

Conclusion: 现有基于LLM的图推理器在对称性不变性和泛化方面存在显著局限，微调带来的鲁棒性提升有限且存在权衡。

Abstract: While promising, graph reasoners based on Large Language Models (LLMs) lack built-in invariance to symmetries in graph representations. Operating on sequential graph serializations, LLMs can produce different outputs under node reindexing, edge reordering, or formatting changes, raising robustness concerns. We systematically analyze these effects, studying how fine-tuning impacts encoding sensitivity as well generalization on unseen tasks. We propose a principled decomposition of graph serializations into node labeling, edge encoding, and syntax, and evaluate LLM robustness to variations of each of these factors on a comprehensive benchmarking suite. We also contribute a novel set of spectral tasks to further assess generalization abilities of fine-tuned reasoners. Results show that larger (non-fine-tuned) models are more robust. Fine-tuning reduces sensitivity to node relabeling but may increase it to variations in structure and format, while it does not consistently improve performance on unseen tasks.

</details>


### [448] [When Distance Distracts: Representation Distance Bias in BT-Loss for Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.06343)
*Tong Xie,Andrew Bai,Yuanhao Ban,Yunqi Hong,Haoyu Li,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文分析了Bradley-Terry (BT)奖励建模损失函数中存在的虚假学习信号问题——梯度范数不仅受预测误差影响，还受表示距离影响，导致更新不均衡。为此提出NormBT，一种自适应成对归一化方法，通过平衡表示距离的影响，使学习信号聚焦于预测误差。NormBT作为轻量级drop-in改进，在多种LLM和数据集中持续提升奖励模型性能，尤其在RewardBench的Reasoning类别上提升超过5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准BT损失在奖励建模中存在梯度范数被表示距离（representation distance）干扰的问题：表示距离小的样本对即使排序错误也获得微弱更新，而表示距离大的样本对获得不成比例的大更新，导致学习信号被扭曲，影响了奖励模型在细粒度区分上的表现。

Method: 提出NormBT（Adaptive Pair-wise Normalization），一种自适应成对归一化方案，通过重新缩放梯度更新来平衡表示距离带来的影响，使学习信号聚焦于预测误差。该方法是对BT损失的轻量级drop-in修改，额外开销可忽略。

Result: 在多种LLM骨干网络和数据集上，NormBT一致地提升了奖励模型性能，特别是在RewardBench的Reasoning类别上取得了超过5%的显著提升，该类别包含大量细粒度样本对。

Conclusion: 标准BT损失中由表示距离引起的梯度偏差是奖励建模的一个重要局限，NormBT通过自适应归一化有效缓解了这一问题，是一种简单高效的改进方案。

Abstract: Reward models are central to Large Language Model (LLM) alignment within the framework of RLHF. The standard objective used in reward modeling is the Bradley-Terry (BT) loss, which learns from pairwise data consisting of chosen and rejected responses. In this work, we analyze the per-sample gradient of BT-loss and show spurious learning signals due to representation distance. In particular, BT gradient norm scales with two distinct components: (1) prediction error, reflected by the difference in predicted rewards between chosen and rejected responses, and critically, (2) representation distance between the pair measured in the output space of the final layer. While the first term captures the intended training signal, the second term can significantly impact the update magnitude and misalign learning. Specifically, pairs with small representation distance often receive vanishingly weak updates, even when misranked, while pairs with large distance receive disproportionately strong updates. This leads to gradients from large-distance pairs to overshadow those from small-distance pairs, where fine-grained distinctions are especially important. To overcome this limitation, we propose NormBT, an adaptive pair-wise normalization scheme that rescales updates to balance representation-driven effects and focuses learning signals on prediction error. NormBT is a lightweight, drop-in modification to BT loss with negligible overhead. Across various LLM backbones and datasets, NormBT improves reward model performance consistently, with notable gains of over 5% on the Reasoning category of RewardBench, which contains numerous fine-grained pairs.

</details>


### [449] [Model-Based Reinforcement Learning in Discrete-Action Non-Markovian Reward Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.14617)
*Alessandro Trapasso,Luca Iocchi,Fabio Patrizi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QR-MAX和Bucket-QR-MAX算法，通过将马尔可夫转移学习与非马尔可夫奖励处理分解，首次在离散NMRDP中获得PAC收敛到ε-最优策略的多项式样本复杂度，实验表明在样本效率和鲁棒性上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多实际决策问题依赖于系统历史而非当前状态，但马尔可夫强化学习方法不适用于此类非马尔可夫任务，且现有非马尔可夫奖励决策过程缺乏最优性和样本效率的形式化保证。

Method: 提出QR-MAX（基于模型），将马尔可夫转移学习与非马尔可夫奖励处理通过奖励机分解；扩展为Bucket-QR-MAX，使用SimHash离散化处理连续状态空间，保持分解结构。

Result: 首次为离散动作NMRDP提供PAC收敛到ε-最优策略且多项式样本复杂度的形式化保证；实验表明在样本效率和鲁棒性上显著优于现有SOTA模型基RL方法。

Conclusion: 通过马尔可夫转移与非马尔可夫奖励的分解，成功解决了NMRDP中最优性保证和样本效率的双重难题，并有效扩展到连续状态空间。

Abstract: Many practical decision-making problems involve tasks whose success depends on the entire system history, rather than on achieving a state with desired properties. Markovian Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches are not suitable for such tasks, while RL with non-Markovian reward decision processes (NMRDPs) enables agents to tackle temporal-dependency tasks. This approach has long been known to lack formal guarantees on both (near-)optimality and sample efficiency. We contribute to solving both issues with QR-MAX, a novel model-based algorithm for discrete NMRDPs that factorizes Markovian transition learning from non-Markovian reward handling via reward machines. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first model-based RL algorithm for discrete-action NMRDPs that exploits this factorization to obtain PAC convergence to $\varepsilon$-optimal policies with polynomial sample complexity. We then extend QR-MAX to continuous state spaces with Bucket-QR-MAX, a SimHash-based discretiser that preserves the same factorized structure and achieves fast and stable learning without manual gridding or function approximation. We experimentally compare our method with modern state-of-the-art model-based RL approaches on environments of increasing complexity, showing a significant improvement in sample efficiency and increased robustness in finding optimal policies.

</details>


### [450] [SCOPE: Sequential Causal Optimization of Process Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17629)
*Jakob De Moor,Hans Weytjens,Johannes De Smedt,Jochen De Weerdt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE方法，利用反向归纳和因果学习器，在无需模拟或数据增强的情况下，学习过程监控中的序列干预推荐，以优化关键绩效指标，实验表明其优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有规定性过程监控方法在处理多步骤干预时存在局限：要么只关注单次干预决策，要么将多次干预独立处理而忽略其时间上的交互依赖关系；依赖模拟或数据增强的强化学习方法则会引入现实差距和偏差。

Method: SCOPE采用反向归纳法从最终决策点向前传播干预效果，结合因果学习器直接利用观测数据，无需构建过程近似来训练强化学习智能体。

Result: 在合成数据集和基于真实事件日志的新半合成数据集上，SCOPE在优化关键绩效指标方面一致优于现有最先进的规定性过程监控技术。

Conclusion: SCOPE有效解决了序列干预依赖问题，并提供了可复用的半合成基准数据集，为未来序列规定性过程监控研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Prescriptive Process Monitoring (PresPM) recommends interventions during running business processes to optimize key performance indicators (KPIs). In realistic settings, interventions are rarely isolated: organizations need to align sequences of interventions to jointly steer the outcome of a case. Existing PresPM approaches only partially address this challenge. Many focus on a single intervention decision, while others treat multiple interventions independently, ignoring how they interact over time. Methods that do address these dependencies depend either on simulation or data augmentation to approximate the process to train a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent, which may create a reality gap and introduce bias. We introduce SCOPE (Sequential Causal Optimization of Process Interventions), a PresPM approach that learns aligned sequential intervention recommendations. SCOPE employs backward induction to estimate the effect of each candidate intervention action, propagating its impact from the final decision point back to the first. By leveraging causal learners, our method can utilize observational data directly, unlike methods that require constructing process approximations for RL. Experiments on both an existing synthetic dataset and a new semi-synthetic dataset show that SCOPE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PresPM techniques in optimizing the KPI. The novel semi-synthetic setup, based on a real-life event log, is provided as a reusable benchmark for future work on sequential PresPM.

</details>


### [451] [ATLAS: Verifier-Guided Adaptive Latent Activation Steering for Efficient LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03093)
*Tuc Nguyen,Thai Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ATLAS是一个轻量级框架，通过训练好的验证器在推理时动态控制潜在空间激活，实现自适应推理调整，在不增加模型参数的情况下提升推理效率和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活和潜在空间引导方法依赖固定策略和静态干预强度，跨问题实例的鲁棒性有限，容易出现过度引导或引导不足的问题。

Method: ATLAS框架在推理阶段使用轻量级验证器对中间隐藏状态进行质量评估，动态选择最优的引导动作，实现逐样本、逐步的自适应调整，无需额外LLM解码或过程奖励模型调用。

Result: 在多个数学和代码推理基准上，ATLAS相比朴素解码和固定引导基线，一致地取得了更高的准确率并显著减少了测试时的token使用量。

Conclusion: 验证器引导的潜在自适应机制为控制推理效率提供了一种有效且可扩展的方案，在不牺牲解质量的前提下实现了效率提升。

Abstract: Recent work on activation and latent steering has demonstrated that modifying internal representations can effectively guide large language models (LLMs) toward improved reasoning and efficiency without updating model parameters. However, most existing approaches rely on fixed steering policies and static intervention strengths, which limit their robustness across problem instances and often result in over- or under-steering. We propose Adaptive Test-time Latent Steering (ATLAS), a lightweight framework that dynamically controls steering decisions at inference time using a trained, lightweight verifier over the latent states. Given intermediate hidden states, the verifier predicts the quality of ongoing reasoning and adaptively selects which steering action to apply, enabling per-example and per-step adjustment with minimal overhead. ATLAS provides a unified framework for combining learned latent verification with test-time activation steering, enabling adaptive reasoning control without additional LLM decoding or inference-time process reward model calls. Experiments on multiple mathematical and coding reasoning benchmarks show that ATLAS consistently outperforms both vanilla decoding and fixed steering baselines, achieving higher accuracy while substantially reducing test-time token usage. These results demonstrate that verifier-guided latent adaptation provides an effective and scalable mechanism for controlling reasoning efficiency without sacrificing solution quality. All source code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [452] [Efficient Imputation for Patch-based Missing Single-cell Data via Cluster-regularized Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14653)
*Yuyu Liu,Jiannan Yang,Ziyang Yu,Weishen Pan,Fei Wang,Tengfei Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CROT算法，基于最优传输理论处理单细胞测序数据中大片缺失值的插补问题，在保证高精度的同时显著降低运行时间，适用于大规模高维数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单细胞测序数据中的缺失值严重影响生物学信息提取，现有插补方法假设数据均匀且完整，难以处理大块缺失数据，亟需鲁棒高效的解决方案。

Method: 提出Cluster-Regularized Optimal Transport (CROT)算法，利用最优传输框架结合聚类正则化，针对表格形式的大块缺失数据进行插补，捕捉底层数据结构。

Result: CROT在插补精度上优于现有方法，同时显著减少运行时间，展现出大规模数据集上的可扩展性和高效性。

Conclusion: CROT为异质性高维数据中的结构化缺失问题提供了鲁棒解决方案，对生物学和临床数据分析具有重要意义。

Abstract: Missing data in single-cell sequencing datasets poses significant challenges for extracting meaningful biological insights. However, existing imputation approaches, which often assume uniformity and data completeness, struggle to address cases with large patches of missing data. In this paper, we present CROT (Cluster-Regularized Optimal Transport), an optimal transport-based imputation algorithm designed to handle patch-based missing data in tabular formats. Our approach effectively captures the underlying data structure in the presence of significant missingness. Notably, it achieves superior imputation accuracy while significantly reducing runtime, demonstrating its scalability and efficiency for large-scale datasets. This work introduces a robust solution for imputation in heterogeneous, high-dimensional datasets with structured data absence, addressing critical challenges in both biological and clinical data analysis. Our code is available on GitHub, https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/CROT.

</details>


### [453] [Your Autoregressive Model Already Reveals the Causal Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01135)
*Hugo Math,Rainer Lienhart*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE框架，利用预训练自回归模型估计条件互信息，实现从单条离散事件序列中高效进行因果发现，在词汇量高达29100的车辆诊断日志上取得了超越基线20+F1点的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以处理单流序列数据（如车辆诊断、患者轨迹）中缺乏重复样本、词汇量大、长程依赖等问题，导致因果发现不准确或计算不可行。

Method: 将预训练自回归模型重用作条件互信息的密度估计器，通过GPU并行化条件独立性检验恢复样本级时间因果图及其摘要投影，理论上证明了交叉熵预训练损失直接最小化因果识别误差的上界。

Result: 在8000节点的非线性SCM和29100词汇量的车辆诊断日志上，TRACE是首个可规模化的方法，F1分数超过最强基线20+点。

Conclusion: 序列预测与因果发现之间存在对偶关系，预训练自回归模型可无需任务特定微调直接用于大规模因果结构学习。

Abstract: Autoregressive models trained via next-token prediction implicitly learn the conditional independence structure of their data-generating process. We exploit this observation to perform scalable causal discovery from a single observed sequence of discrete events -- without any task-specific retraining. Such single-stream settings arise naturally in vehicle diagnostics, manufacturing systems, and patient trajectories, yet they remain largely unsolved: the absence of repeated samples, massive event vocabularies, and long-range temporal dependencies render existing methods either inaccurate or computationally intractable. We introduce TRACE, a framework that repurposes any pretrained autoregressive model as a density estimator for conditional mutual information, the fundamental primitive for conditional independence testing. By constructing parallelized CI tests on GPUs, TRACE recovers both the sample-level time causal graph and its summary projection, scaling linearly with the vocabulary size while naturally handling delayed causal effects. Crucially, we prove that minimizing the standard cross-entropy pretraining loss directly minimizes an upper bound on the causal identification error, establishing a duality between sequence prediction and causal discovery. On nonlinear SCMs (|X| = 8000) and real-world vehicle diagnostic logs (|X| = 29100), TRACE is the first applicable method at this scale, outperforming the strongest baseline by over 20 F1 points.

</details>


### [454] [Rethinking the Flow-Based Gradual Domain Adaptation: A Semi-Dual Optimal Transport Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01179)
*Zhichao Chen,Zhan Zhuang,Yunfei Teng,Hao Wang,Fangyikang Wang,Zhengnan Li,Tianqiao Liu,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出熵正则化半对偶不平衡最优传输（E-SUOT）框架，通过直接对样本进行插值来构建中间域，避免了基于似然估计的流模型在渐进域适应中的信息损失问题，并提供了稳定性和泛化性的理论分析，实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 渐进域适应中真实中间域往往不可用或效果不佳，现有流模型通过似然估计合成中间样本会丢失有用信息，限制了GDA性能。

Method: 将基于流的GDA重新表述为拉格朗日对偶问题，推导出避免似然估计的半对偶目标；引入熵正则化将对偶问题转化为稳定的顺序优化过程，构建E-SUOT框架。

Result: 通过理论分析证明了所提框架的稳定性和泛化性，大量实验验证了E-SUOT框架的有效性。

Conclusion: E-SUOT框架通过直接样本插值构建中间域，有效克服了似然估计的信息损失问题，为渐进域适应提供了更稳定且泛化性能更优的方案。

Abstract: Gradual domain adaptation (GDA) aims to mitigate domain shift by progressively adapting models from the source domain to the target domain via intermediate domains. However, real intermediate domains are often unavailable or ineffective, necessitating the synthesis of intermediate samples. Flow-based models have recently been used for this purpose by interpolating between source and target distributions. Notably, their training typically relies on sample-based log-likelihood estimation, which can discard useful information and thus degrade GDA performance. The key to addressing this limitation is constructing the intermediate domains via samples directly. To this end, we propose an Entropy-regularized Semi-dual Unbalanced Optimal Transport (E-SUOT) framework to construct intermediate domains. Specifically, we reformulate flow-based GDA as a Lagrangian dual problem and derive an equivalent semi-dual objective that circumvents the need for likelihood estimation. However, the dual problem leads to an unstable min-max training procedure. To alleviate this issue, we further introduce the entropy regularization to convert it into a more stable sequential optimization procedure. Based on this, we propose a novel GDA training framework and provide theoretical analysis in terms of stability and generalization. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted to demonstrate the efficacy of the E-SUOT framework.

</details>


### [455] [Structure-Preserving Learning Improves Geometry Generalization in Neural PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02788)
*Benjamin D. Shaffer,Shawn Koohy,Brooks Kinch,M. Ani Hsieh,Nathaniel Trask*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出General-Geometry Neural Whitney Forms (Geo-NeW)，一种将数据驱动方法与有限元外微积分相结合的方法，用于在未见几何上实时求解偏微分方程，同时严格保持物理守恒律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理基础模型在对未见几何进行泛化时无法同时保证结构保持和精度，缺乏能够显式连接几何与边界条件的归纳偏置。

Method: 联合学习微分算子和基于底层几何的约化有限元空间，通过有限元外微积分精确保持物理守恒律；几何以离散网格形式通过Transformer编码和有限元空间基函数进入模型；提出了确保解存在唯一性的本构模型参数化方法。

Result: 在多个稳态PDE基准上达到最先进性能，在分布外几何上相比传统基线有显著提升。

Conclusion: 将几何显式连接至解空间提供了强大的归纳偏置，有效提升了对未见几何的泛化能力；所提出的方法在保持物理规律的同时实现了实时求解。

Abstract: We aim to develop physics foundation models for science and engineering that provide real-time solutions to Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) which preserve structure and accuracy under adaptation to unseen geometries. To this end, we introduce General-Geometry Neural Whitney Forms (Geo-NeW): a data-driven finite element method. We jointly learn a differential operator and compatible reduced finite element spaces defined on the underlying geometry. The resulting model is solved to generate predictions, while exactly preserving physical conservation laws through Finite Element Exterior Calculus. Geometry enters the model as a discretized mesh both through a transformer-based encoding and as the basis for the learned finite element spaces. This explicitly connects the underlying geometry and imposed boundary conditions to the solution, providing a powerful inductive bias for learning neural PDEs, which we demonstrate improves generalization to unseen domains. We provide a novel parameterization of the constitutive model ensuring the existence and uniqueness of the solution. Our approach demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on several steady-state PDE benchmarks, and provides a significant improvement over conventional baselines on out-of-distribution geometries.

</details>


### [456] [MemCast: Memory-Driven Time Series Forecasting with Experience-Conditioned Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03164)
*Xiaoyu Tao,Mingyue Cheng,Ze Guo,Shuo Yu,Yaguo Liu,Qi Liu,Shijin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MemCast是一个将时间序列预测重构为经验条件推理任务的学习到记忆框架，通过构建层次化记忆（历史模式、推理智慧、通用定律）并引入动态置信度自适应策略实现持续演化，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的时间序列预测方法缺乏显式的经验积累和持续演化能力，难以在不断变化的数据环境中保持高效性和适应性。

Method: 提出MemCast框架，将TSF重构为经验条件推理任务。具体包括：(1) 从训练集学习经验并组织为层次化记忆，包括历史模式（预测结果总结）、推理智慧（推理轨迹蒸馏）和通用定律（时间特征归纳）；(2) 推理时利用历史模式引导推理、推理智慧选择更优轨迹、通用定律作为反思标准；(3) 设计动态置信度自适应策略实现持续演化，在不泄露测试集分布的情况下更新条目置信度。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，MemCast始终优于之前的方法，验证了该方法的有效性。

Conclusion: MemCast通过显式经验积累与持续演化机制有效提升了时间序列预测性能，为LLM-based预测器的发展提供了新范式。

Abstract: Time series forecasting (TSF) plays a critical role in decision-making for many real-world applications. Recently, large language model (LLM)- based forecasters have made promising advancements. Despite their effectiveness, existing methods often lack explicit experience accumulation and continual evolution. In this work, we propose MemCast, a learning-to-memory framework that reformulates TSF as an experience-conditioned reasoning task. Specifically, we learn experience from the training set and organize it into a hierarchical memory. This is achieved by summarizing prediction results into historical patterns, distilling inference trajectories into reasoning wisdom, and inducing extracted temporal features into general laws. Furthermore, during inference, we leverage historical patterns to guide the reasoning process and utilize reasoning wisdom to select better trajectories, while general laws serve as criteria for reflective iteration. Additionally, to enable continual evolution, we design a dynamic confidence adaptation strategy that updates the confidence of individual entries without leaking the test set distribution. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MemCast consistently outperforms previous methods, validating the effectiveness of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/MemCast-TS.

</details>


### [457] [Synthesizable Molecular Generation via Soft-constrained GFlowNets with Rich Chemical Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04119)
*Hyeonah Kim,Minsu Kim,Celine Roget,Dionessa Biton,Louis Vaillancourt,Yves V. Brun,Yoshua Bengio,Alex Hernandez-Garcia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出S3-GFN，通过软正则化方法将可合成性约束引入序列化GFlowNet，利用对比学习和离策略回放训练生成高奖励、可合成的SMILES分子，在多个任务中达到≥95%的可合成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于反应模板和构建块的GFlowNet方法虽能施加硬性可合成约束，但缺乏灵活性和可扩展性，限制了生成模型在药物发现中的实际应用。

Method: S3-GFN采用软正则化策略，通过离策略回放训练和基于可合成/不可合成样本分离缓冲区的对比学习信号，在序列化GFlowNet中诱导可合成性约束，同时利用大规模SMILES语料预训练的分子先验引导生成。

Result: 在多个任务中，S3-GFN生成的可合成分子比例达到95%以上，且分子具有更高的奖励分数。

Conclusion: 软正则化方法在保持灵活性和扩展性的同时，能有效将可合成性约束引入序列化分子生成模型，为实验药物发现提供更实用的工具。

Abstract: The application of generative models for experimental drug discovery campaigns is severely limited by the difficulty of designing molecules de novo that can be synthesized in practice. Previous works have leveraged Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) to impose hard synthesizability constraints through the design of state and action spaces based on predefined reaction templates and building blocks. Despite the promising prospects of this approach, it currently lacks flexibility and scalability. As an alternative, we propose S3-GFN, which generates synthesizable SMILES molecules via simple soft regularization of a sequence-based GFlowNet. Our approach leverages rich molecular priors learned from large-scale SMILES corpora to steer molecular generation towards high-reward, synthesizable chemical spaces. The model induces constraints through off-policy replay training with a contrastive learning signal based on separate buffers of synthesizable and unsynthesizable samples. Our experiments show that S3-GFN learns to generate synthesizable molecules ($\geq 95\%$) with higher rewards in diverse tasks.

</details>


### [458] [DAH-Net: A Dual-Attention Hybrid Network for Interpretable and Robust EEG-Based Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06411)
*S M Rakib UI Karim,Diponkor Bala,Wenyi Lu,Rownak Ara Rasul,Sean Goggins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DAH-Net，一种结合1D-CNN、BiLSTM和双多头注意力（16+8头）的混合网络，在988维EEG特征的三分类情绪识别中达到99.19%的测试准确率，并系统分析了协方差和特征值等不同特征类型的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG情绪识别面临信号复杂、个体差异大和可解释性有限等挑战，现有方法在准确率和泛化性上仍有不足。

Method: 提出DAH-Net双注意力混合网络，集成1D-CNN、BiLSTM和双多头注意力机制（16+8头），并在2479个样本、988维EEG特征上进行三分类情绪识别实验。

Result: DAH-Net达到99.19%的留出测试准确率，训练-测试差距仅0.81%，优于RF（96.17%）、SVM（96.77%）、MLP（97.18%）和Transformer（98.19%）；Friedman检验（χ²=28.54, p<0.001）和Wilcoxon事后检验确认显著性；协方差特征独立达94.96%准确率，特征值特征仅84.07%但提供互补信息。

Conclusion: DAH-Net在EEG情绪识别上性能优异且紧凑（3.33M参数，约13.3MB），协方差特征贡献最大，但尚需跨被试和外部数据验证。

Abstract: EEG-based emotion recognition supports affective brain-computer interfaces and mental health monitoring yet remains challenged by signal complexity, subject variability, and limited interpretability. We propose DAH-Net, a dual-attention hybrid network integrating 1D-CNN, BiLSTM, and dual multi-head attention (16+8 heads) for three-class EEG emotion classification. Evaluated on 2,479 samples with 988 EEG features, DAH-Net achieves 99.19% held-out test accuracy with a 0.81% train-test gap, outperforming RF (96.17%), SVM (96.77%), MLP (97.18%), and Transformer (98.19%) baselines. Friedman testing (\c{hi}2 = 28.54, p < 0.001) and post-hoc Wilcoxon comparisons confirm statistical significance. Feature-level analysis using Random Forest importance, SHAP attribution, and feature category isolation shows that covariance features achieve near-baseline standalone accuracy (94.96%), while eigenvalue features show limited standalone performance (84.07%) but provide compact complementary information.
