The compact architecture (3.33M parameters, approximately 13.3MB using 32-bit weights) suggests potential for future lightweight EEG-based affective computing, pending subject-independent and external validation.

</details>


### [459] [Blind denoising diffusion models and the blessings of dimensionality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09639)
*Zahra Kadkhodaie,Aram-Alexandre Pooladian,Sinho Chewi,Eero Simoncelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出盲去噪扩散模型（BDDMs），该变体在训练和采样过程中不向神经网络传入噪声幅度，从而消除了噪声嵌入和噪声调度等设计需求。在数据分布相对于环境维度具有低内在维度的假设下，理论证明了BDDMs作为采样算法的正确性，并通过自适应方案展示了优于标准DDMs的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准DDMs在噪声条件化方面存在两个关键缺陷：需要将无原则的噪声嵌入引入神经网络架构，以及使用临时的噪声调度进行采样。这些设计选择缺乏理论指导，本文旨在通过消除这些需求来解决这些问题。

Method: 提出盲去噪扩散模型（BDDMs），即在训练和采样过程中不向神经网络传递噪声幅度。引入贝叶斯问题框架来从单个含噪样本估计噪声水平，并在数据分布具有低内在维度的假设下证明算法的正确性。

Result: 理论证明了BDDMs在低内在维度假设下作为采样算法的正确性；实验上通过与标准DDMs的比较，展示了基于理论分析的自适应方案的性能优势。

Conclusion: BDDMs成功消除了DDMs中噪声嵌入和噪声调度等非原则性设计选择，为扩散模型提供了更简洁、理论更完备的替代方案，且自适应方案在实践中表现出优越性能。

Abstract: Denoising diffusion models (DDMs) are state-of-the-art methods for learning densities from data across numerous domains, yet many aspects of the training and sampling pipeline remain poorly understood. In particular, noise conditioning requires practitioners to incorporate contrived unprincipled noise embeddings into neural network architectures and to use ad hoc noise schedules for sampling. To address these drawbacks, we provide a complete theory for \emph{blind denoising diffusion models} (BDDMs): a variant of DDMs where the noise amplitude is not passed into the neural network during training or sampling, obviating the need for the aforementioned design choices. We justify the correctness of BDDMs as a sampling algorithm under an assumption of low intrinsic dimensionality of the underlying data distribution relative to the ambient dimension. This assumption arises through the introduction of the Bayesian problem of estimating noise levels from a single noisy sample, which might be of independent interest. We empirically compare the performance of BDDMs to standard DDMs, showcasing the benefits of an \emph{adaptive} scheme which is rigorously justified by our analysis.

</details>


### [460] [Capture Timing-Attention of Events in Clinical Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10385)
*Jia Li,Yu Hou,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的个体化时间转换（LITT）范式，通过引入“时序注意力”变量将时间转化为可计算维度，首次在纵向EHR数据上实现了无需领域知识的临床轨迹自动发现和反事实时序推断（What-If Machine），并在时序预测和生存分析任务上取得良好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹学习范式局限于群体动力学层面，系统性降低个体复杂度以适应群体模型，导致难以进行有效的患者亚型划分，个体级建模几乎无法实现。

Method: 引入专门针对个体级别的时间变量——时序注意力（Timing Attention），即事件时间分布在患者队列中的集中程度；将时间转化为可计算维度，实现个体化时间特征；实例化为个体级时间转换（LITT），应用于3,276名乳腺癌患者的纵向EHR数据。

Result: (1) 自动发现具有临床意义的患者轨迹；(2) 实现反事实时序推断（What-If Machine）；(3) 在时序预测和生存分析任务上取得强性能。所有结果纯数据驱动，无需先验领域知识。

Conclusion: 所提出的范式首次证明，通过个体级时间变量设计，可以在无需领域知识的条件下实现有临床意义的患者轨迹发现和反事实推理，为个体化轨迹学习开辟了新路径。

Abstract: The contemporary paradigm of trajectory learning operates fundamentally at the level of group dynamics, systematically reducing individual-level complexity to fit group-level models, thus rendering effective patient subtyping difficult and individual-level modeling largely out of reach. We propose a data-driven paradigm that introduces a dedicated individual-level temporal variable to capture \emph{Timing Attention} (i.e., the degree of concentration of an event's timing distribution across the patient cohort), thereby rendering timing a \emph{computable dimension} that enables individualized temporal features in trajectory learning.
  Instantiated as the Level-of-Individual Time Transformation (LITT) and applied to longitudinal EHR data from 3,276 breast cancer patients, the proposed paradigm demonstrates, for the first time to our knowledge: (1) automatic discovery of clinically significant patient trajectories, and (2) counterfactual timing deduction, that is, a \emph{What-If Machine}. Both results are purely data-driven, requiring no prior domain knowledge. LITT further achieves strong performance on timing prediction and survival analysis tasks.

</details>


### [461] [PRISM: Parallel Residual Iterative Sequence Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10796)
*Jie Jiang,Ke Cheng,Xin Xu,Mengyang Pang,Tianhao Lu,Jiaheng Li,Yue Liu,Yuan Wang,Jun Zhang,Huan Yu,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM通过并行化重构TTT的迭代模式，解决了Transformer表达力与线性模型效率之间的冲突，在保持性能的同时实现了174倍吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式序列建模中，Transformer表达力强但效率低，线性模型效率高但表达力受限（受限于浅层单步线性更新）。已有高效架构受限于单步Rank-1瓶颈，而TTT等迭代方法因token级状态依赖和迭代循环产生二维串行依赖，破坏硬件并行性。

Method: PRISM采用三个关键技术：1) Write-Forget Decoupling策略，将非线性隔离在注入算子内；2) 两阶段代理架构：短卷积利用局部历史能量锚定初始残差，学习型预测器直接从输入估计精炼更新；3) 将迭代校正的结构模式蒸馏为可并行的前馈算子。

Result: 理论上证明PRISM实现了Rank-L累积，突破单步Rank-1瓶颈；实验上达到与显式优化方法相当的性能，同时实现174倍吞吐量提升。

Conclusion: PRISM成功将迭代式序列模型的表达力与线性模型的并行效率统一，为高效生成式序列建模提供了新范式。

Abstract: Generative sequence modeling faces a fundamental tension between the expressivity of Transformers and the efficiency of linear sequence models. Existing efficient architectures are theoretically bounded by shallow, single-step linear updates, while powerful iterative methods like Test-Time Training (TTT) break hardware parallelism due to two dimensions of serial dependency: token-level state reliance and step-level iteration loops. We propose PRISM (Parallel Residual Iterative Sequence Model) to resolve this tension. PRISM explicitly reconstructs the expressive gate x residual x direction iteration pattern of TTT in a parallelizable form. We employ a Write-Forget Decoupling strategy that isolates non-linearity within the injection operator. To bypass the serial dependency of explicit solvers, PRISM utilizes a two-stage proxy architecture: a short-convolution anchors the initial residual using local history energy, while a learned predictor estimates the refinement updates directly from the input. This design distills structural patterns associated with iterative correction into a parallelizable feedforward operator. Theoretically, we prove that this formulation achieves Rank-$L$ accumulation, structurally expanding the update manifold beyond the single-step Rank-$1$ bottleneck. Empirically, it achieves comparable performance to explicit optimization methods while achieving \textbf{174x higher throughput}. Codes are available in https://github.com/gpr-prism/prism/.

</details>


### [462] [Exploring Accurate and Transparent Domain Adaptation in Predictive Healthcare via Concept-Grounded Orthogonal Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12542)
*Pengfei Hu,Chang Lu,Feifan Liu,Yue Ning*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ExtraCare通过将患者表征分解为不变成分和协变成分，并在训练中强制正交性，既提高了域迁移下的预测性能，又通过稀疏潜在维度映射到医学概念提供了可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在电子健康记录（EHR）的临床事件预测中，面临不同数据分布下的性能下降问题。现有域适应方法虽能缓解分布偏移，但其"黑箱"特性阻碍了在临床实践中的广泛应用，因为透明性对于临床信任和安全至关重要。

Method: 提出ExtraCare模型，将患者表征分解为不变成分（保留标签信息）和协变成分（反映域特定变化），通过监督这两个成分并在训练中强制正交性来实现分离。同时通过将稀疏潜在维度映射到医学概念并利用目标消融量化其贡献，提供人类可理解的解释。

Result: 在两个真实世界EHR数据集、多个域划分设置下进行评估，ExtraCare在预测性能上优于大多数特征对齐模型，并通过广泛的案例研究验证了其准确预测和可解释性。

Conclusion: ExtraCare通过解耦表征实现了域适应下的性能提升与可解释性的兼顾，为临床安全可信的部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Deep learning models for clinical event prediction on electronic health records (EHR) often suffer performance degradation when deployed under different data distributions. While domain adaptation (DA) methods can mitigate such shifts, their "black-box" nature prevents widespread adoption in clinical practice where transparency is essential for trust and safety. We propose ExtraCare to decompose patient representations into invariant and covariant components. By supervising these two components and enforcing their orthogonality during training, our model preserves label information while exposing domain-specific variation at the same time for more accurate predictions than most feature alignment models. More importantly, it offers human-understandable explanations by mapping sparse latent dimensions to medical concepts and quantifying their contributions via targeted ablations. ExtraCare is evaluated on two real-world EHR datasets across multiple domain partition settings, demonstrating superior performance along with enhanced transparency, as evidenced by its accurate predictions and explanations from extensive case studies.

</details>


### [463] [AnomaMind: Agentic Time Series Anomaly Detection with Tool-Augmented Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13807)
*Xiaoyu Tao,Yuchong Wu,Mingyue Cheng,Ze Guo,Tian Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AnomaMind是一个将时间序列异常检测重构为顺序决策过程的智能体框架，通过粗到细的工作流（定位可疑区间→构建诊断证据→自我反思优化）和工具增强推理，在域内和跨域场景下均提升了异常检测性能和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将异常检测视为纯判别预测任务，使用固定特征表示，而非证据驱动的诊断过程，导致在异常呈现强上下文依赖、多样模式或跨数据集域偏移时表现不佳。

Method: 提出AnomaMind框架，包含：(1) 粗到细的工作流：先定位可疑区间，再通过工具交互构建诊断证据，最后通过自我反思优化决策；(2) 工具箱：结合知识记忆（视觉异常模式+领域知识）和数值诊断算子（统计、值基、变化基、区域级算子）；(3) 混合推理机制：通用模型处理灵活推理、工具调用和优化，检测专用策略通过规则奖励（可解析输出、F1对齐、假阳性控制）优化。

Result: 在域内和跨域设置下的广泛实验表明，AnomaMind一致提升了异常检测性能，并增强了跨异质异常模式的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 验证了工具增强推理在异常检测中的有效性，将异常检测从判别预测转变为证据驱动的诊断过程是可行且有效的思路。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection is critical in many real-world applications, where effective solutions must localize anomalous regions and support reliable decision-making under complex settings. However, most existing methods frame anomaly detection as a purely discriminative prediction task with fixed feature representations, rather than an evidence-driven diagnostic process. As a result, they often struggle when anomalies exhibit strong context dependence, diverse patterns, or domain shifts across datasets. To address these challenges, we propose AnomaMind, an agentic time series anomaly detection framework that reformulates anomaly detection as a sequential decision-making process. AnomaMind operates through a coarse-to-fine workflow that first localizes suspicious intervals, then constructs diagnostic evidence through tool interaction, and finally refines anomaly decisions through self-reflection. The workflow is supported by a toolkit box that combines knowledge memory and numerical diagnostics: visual anomaly patterns mined from training data and domain knowledge provide contextual guidance, while statistical, value-based, change-based, and region-level operators provide measurable evidence for verification. AnomaMind further adopts a hybrid inference mechanism in which general-purpose models handle flexible reasoning, tool invocation, and refinement, while a detection-specific policy is optimized with rule-based rewards for parsable outputs, F1-score alignment, and false-positive control. Extensive experiments under both in-domain and cross-domain settings demonstrate that AnomaMind consistently improves anomaly detection performance and enhances generalization across heterogeneous anomaly patterns, validating the effectiveness of tool-augmented reasoning for anomaly detection. The code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/AnomaMind-TS.

</details>


### [464] [In Defense of Cosine Similarity: Normalization Eliminates the Gauge Freedom](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19393)
*Taha Bouhsine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文反驳了Steck等人关于余弦相似度在嵌入中不可靠的结论，证明当嵌入被约束在单位球面上时，余弦距离与欧氏距离单调等价，问题源于未归一化而非余弦相似度本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纠正Steck等人[arXiv:2403.05440]中关于余弦相似度普遍不可靠的误导性结论，澄清其病理源于不兼容的训练目标而非余弦相似度的几何有效性。

Method: 通过理论证明，当嵌入被约束在单位球面S^{d-1}上（训练中或训练后使用适当目标函数），D矩阵模糊性消失，余弦距离严格等于欧氏距离平方的一半，从而建立单调等价关系。

Result: 在归一化嵌入上，余弦距离与欧氏距离的邻居排名完全一致；余弦相似度的所谓问题实际是未归一化的问题。

Conclusion: Steck等人的结论对余弦相似度的谨慎态度存在过度推广，正确的做法是使用归一化嵌入而非放弃余弦相似度。

Abstract: Steck, Ekanadham, and Kallus [arXiv:2403.05440] demonstrate that cosine similarity of learned embeddings from matrix factorization models can be rendered arbitrary by a diagonal ``gauge'' matrix $D$. Their result is correct and important for practitioners who compute cosine similarity on embeddings trained with dot-product objectives. However, we argue that their conclusion, cautioning against cosine similarity in general, conflates the pathology of an incompatible training objective with the geometric validity of cosine distance on the unit sphere. We prove that when embeddings are constrained to the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$ (either during or after training with an appropriate objective), the $D$-matrix ambiguity vanishes identically, and cosine distance reduces to exactly half the squared Euclidean distance. This monotonic equivalence implies that cosine-based and Euclidean-based neighbor rankings are identical on normalized embeddings. The ``problem'' with cosine similarity is not cosine similarity, it is the failure to normalize.

</details>


### [465] [MedFeat: Model-Aware and Explainability-Driven Feature Engineering with LLMs for Clinical Tabular Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02221)
*Zizheng Zhang,Yiming Li,Justin Xu,Jinyu Wang,Rui Wang,Lei Song,Jiang Bian,David W Eyre,Jingjing Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MedFeat框架，通过模型感知和特征重要性信号迭代引导特征发现，在临床表格预测任务中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的特征工程方法将特征生成与下游模型解耦，无法根据模型当前预测驱动因素或表征能力短板进行针对性特征提议，这一问题在医疗数据（类别不平衡、异质特征空间、强可解释性要求）中被放大。

Method: 提出MedFeat框架，受机器学习从业者工作流启发，利用模型感知和特征重要性信号，迭代引导LLM进行特征发现，使特征生成与下游模型的归纳偏置对齐。

Result: 在多个真实临床任务上，MedFeat显著优于最强基线，平均提升超过10%，且在具有不同归纳偏置的模型上表现一致。

Conclusion: 模型感知的迭代特征工程框架MedFeat能有效提升临床表格预测性能，弥合了LLM特征生成与下游模型需求之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: In clinical tabular prediction, classical machine learning models with feature engineering often outperform neural methods. LLMs are increasingly used to automate this process, acting as domain experts that propose diverse feature transformations to boost downstream performance. However, existing LLM-based methods decouple feature generation from the downstream model: the LLM receives no signal about which features currently drive predictions or where the model's representational capacity falls short, so proposals are neither targeted to promising regions of the feature space nor tailored to the learner's inductive bias. This shortcoming is amplified in healthcare data, which simultaneously exhibits class imbalance, heterogeneous feature spaces, and strict interpretability requirements. In this paper, we propose MedFeat, the first feature engineering framework inspired by the workflow of machine learning practitioners, leveraging model-awareness and feature importance signals to iteratively guide feature discovery for clinical tabular learning. We evaluate MedFeat on a broad range of challenging real-world clinical tasks and show that it statistically significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with an average improvement of more than 10% over the baseline across models with distinct inductive biases.

</details>


### [466] [Spatio-Temporal Attention Graph Neural Network: Explaining Causalities With Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10676)
*Kosti Koistinen,Kirsi Hellsten,Joni Herttuainen,Kimmo K. Kaski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于时空注意力图神经网络（STA-GNN）的无监督可解释异常检测方法，用于工业控制系统（ICS），能够建模时空动态、融合多模态数据，并通过保形预测策略控制误报率与应对基线漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于机器学习的ICS异常检测方法虽然理论性能强，但存在可解释性差、误报率高以及对系统行为漂移（基线漂移）敏感等问题，限制了实际部署。

Method: 构建时空注意力图神经网络（STA-GNN），将传感器、控制器和网络实体作为动态学习图中的节点，建模物理过程与通信模式间的相互依赖关系；利用注意力机制揭示影响关系以支持因果路径分析；融合SCADA测量值、网络流特征和负载特征等多模态数据；采用保形预测策略控制误报率并监测性能退化。

Result: 研究揭示了ICS异常检测中模型评估的常见陷阱与局限性，强调了可解释性和漂移感知评估对于基于学习的安全监控系统可靠部署的重要性。

Conclusion: 可解释的、对漂移敏感的评估方法对于学习型安全监控系统在ICS中的可靠部署至关重要。

Abstract: Industrial Control Systems (ICS) underpin critical infrastructure and face growing cyber-physical threats due to the convergence of operational technology and networked environments. While machine learning-based anomaly detection approaches in ICS shows strong theoretical performance, deployment is often limited by poor explainability, high false-positive rates, and sensitivity to evolving system behavior, i.e., baseline drifting. We propose a Spatio-Temporal Attention Graph Neural Network (STA-GNN) for unsupervised and explainable anomaly detection in ICS that models both temporal dynamics and relational structure of the system. Sensors, controllers, and network entities are represented as nodes in a dynamically learned graph, enabling the model to capture inter-dependencies across physical processes and communication patterns. Attention mechanisms provide influential relationships, supporting inspection of correlations and potential causal pathways behind detected events. The approach supports multiple data modalities, including SCADA point measurements, network flow features, and payload features, and thus enables unified cyber-physical analysis. To address operational requirements, we incorporate a conformal prediction strategy to control false alarm rates and monitor performance degradation under drifting of the environment. Our findings highlight the possibilities and limitations of model evaluation and common pitfalls in anomaly detection in ICS. Our findings emphasise the importance of explainable, drift-aware evaluation for reliable deployment of learning-based security monitoring systems.

</details>


### [467] [Upper Bounds for Local Learning Coefficients of Three-Layer Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12785)
*Yuki Kurumadani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对三层神经网络中奇异实现参数下的局部学习系数，推导了一个上界公式。该公式可解释为预算、需求和供给约束下的计数规则，适用于swish等非多项式实解析激活函数及特定限制下的多项式激活函数，拓展了先前结果。在一维输入情况下，该上界与已知精确学习系数一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三层神经网络是奇异学习模型，其贝叶斯渐近行为由学习系数（实对数规范阈值）决定。虽然正则模型和一些特殊奇异模型的学习系数已被阐明，但适用于神经网络的通用评估方法仍然有限。现有半正则模型公式仅适用于非奇异点，无法处理奇异点，且在三层神经网络中给出的上界与已知值存在显著差异。

Method: 本文推导了三层神经网络中一类奇异实现参数下的局部学习系数上界公式，该公式可解释为预算、需求和供给约束下的计数规则。对于非多项式实解析激活函数，该公式适用于一般设定；对于多项式激活函数，则需限制真实分布无隐藏单元。

Result: 该上界公式覆盖了swish等激活函数，并在特定限制下包含多项式激活函数，拓展了先前结果。当输入维度为1时，该上界与已知精确学习系数一致，为与已知精确结果提供了有用比较。此外，该结果为理解三层神经网络权重参数如何影响学习系数提供了系统性视角。

Conclusion: 本文为三层神经网络奇异参数下的学习系数提供了新的上界公式，拓展了适用激活函数类型，并在一维输入下与已知精确结果吻合，为理解神经网络奇异学习行为提供了更系统的理论工具。

Abstract: Three-layer neural networks are known to form singular learning models, and their Bayesian asymptotic behavior is governed by the learning coefficient, or real log canonical threshold. Although this quantity has been clarified for regular models and for some special singular models, broadly applicable methods for evaluating it in neural networks remain limited.
  Recently, a formula for the local learning coefficient of semiregular models was proposed, yielding an upper bound on the learning coefficient. However, this formula applies only to nonsingular points in the set of realization parameters and cannot be used at singular points. In particular, for three-layer neural networks, the resulting upper bound has been shown to differ substantially from learning coefficient values already known in some cases.
  In this paper, we derive a formula for an upper bound on local learning coefficients at a class of singular realization parameters in three-layer neural networks. This formula can be interpreted as a counting rule under budget, demand, and supply constraints. In the non-polynomial real-analytic case, the formula applies in general settings, whereas in the polynomial case it applies under the restriction that the true distribution has no hidden units. In particular, our result covers activation functions such as the swish function and also includes polynomial activation functions under the above restriction, thereby extending previous results to a broader class of activation functions.
  We further show that, when the input dimension is one, the numerical value given by the right-hand side of our upper-bound formula agrees with the previously known learning coefficient, thereby providing a useful comparison with known exact results. Our result also provides a systematic perspective on how the weight parameters of three-layer neural networks affect the learning coefficient.

</details>


### [468] [Domain Adapted Large Language Models for Additive Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22017)
*Peter Pak,Amir Barati Farimani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Gemma 3、Qwen 3、Gemma 4等开源权重模型的多模态领域适配大语言模型集合，使用约5000万tokens的小规模增材制造期刊论文数据集进行领域自适应预训练和视觉指令微调，在增材制造领域基准测试中语言和视觉任务准确率均达90%以上，展示了一种经济高效的大模型领域专业化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将通用大语言模型高效适配到增材制造这一特定工程领域，解决通用模型在专业领域知识不足的问题，探索一种数据需求量小、计算资源友好的模型专业化途径。

Method: 基于Gemma 3、Qwen 3、Gemma 4等开源权重模型的指令微调变体，使用约5000万tokens的开源增材制造期刊论文数据，分别进行领域自适应预训练和视觉指令微调，构建多模态领域适配模型。

Result: 在Additive-Manufacturing-Benchmark基准测试中，领域适配和指令微调后的模型在语言和视觉任务上均表现出色，一般增材制造知识准确率超过90%。

Conclusion: 提出的领域自适应预训练和指令微调策略为将大语言模型高效专业化到增材制造等特定领域提供了一种可复现、易访问的方法路径。

Abstract: This work presents a collection of multi-modal domain adapted large language models built upon the instruction tuned variants of open weight models (Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Gemma 4) using a relatively small dataset of around 50 million tokens. The dataset consists of open-access additive manufacturing journal articles with data extracted for the domain adaptive pretraining and visual instruction tuning processes. Various stages of the developed model are evaluated with the Additive-Manufacturing-Benchmark which consists of additive manufacturing domain specific tasks compiled published resources. Domain adapted and instruction tuned models exhibit proficiency in both language and vision based tasks, achieving accuracies upwards of 90% in general additive manufacturing knowledge. This domain adaptive pretraining and instruction tuning strategy outline an accessible specialization method for large language models to a domain such as additive manufacturing.

</details>


### [469] [Uncertainty-Guided Label Rebalancing for CPS Safety Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.25670)
*John Ayotunde,Qinghua Xu,Guancheng Wang,Lionel C. Briand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出U-Balance方法，利用行为不确定性（behavioral uncertainty）来重平衡极端不平衡的CPS时间序列数据。该方法先通过GatedMLP不确定性预测器提取运动学特征并输出不确定性分数，再通过uLNR机制将高不确定性的安全样本重新标记为不安全，从而丰富少数类样本。在46:1安全-不安全比例的无人机基准测试上，U-Balance的F1分数达到0.806，比最强基线高出14.3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPS安全监控中不安全事件极为罕见（极端类别不平衡），导致安全预测器性能退化。标准重平衡技术（如过采样、合成数据）在时间序列遥测数据上表现不佳，生成不真实样本或过拟合少数类。同时，CPS操作中的行为不确定性与安全结果相关但尚未被探索用于安全监控。

Method: 提出U-Balance框架：(1) 训练GatedMLP不确定性预测器，将遥测窗口总结为分布运动学特征，输出不确定性分数；(2) 应用不确定性引导的标签重平衡（uLNR）机制，将具有异常高不确定性的安全标签窗口概率性地重新标记为不安全，在不合成新数据的情况下丰富少数类；(3) 在重平衡后的数据集上训练安全预测器进行安全监控。

Result: 在46:1安全-不安全比例的无人机基准上，行为不确定性与安全之间存在中等但显著的关联。uLNR是利用不确定性信息的最有效策略（优于直接早期融合和晚期融合）。U-Balance的F1分数为0.806，比最强基线高出14.3个百分点，同时保持竞争性的推理效率。消融实验证实GatedMLP不确定性预测器和uLNR机制均贡献显著。

Conclusion: U-Balance通过利用行为不确定性进行标签重平衡，有效解决了CPS时间序列数据中极端类别不平衡下的安全监控问题，在不生成合成数据的情况下显著提升了安全预测性能。

Abstract: Safety monitoring is essential for Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs). However, unsafe events are rare in real-world CPS operations, creating an extreme class imbalance that degrades safety predictors. Standard rebalancing techniques perform poorly on time-series CPS telemetry, either generating unrealistic synthetic samples or overfitting on the minority class. Meanwhile, behavioral uncertainty in CPS operations, defined as the degree of doubt or uncertainty in CPS decisions , is often correlated with safety outcomes but unexplored in safety monitoring. To that end, we propose U-Balance, a supervised approach that leverages behavioral uncertainty to rebalance imbalanced datasets prior to training a safety predictor. U-Balance first trains a GatedMLP-based uncertainty predictor that summarizes each telemetry window into distributional kinematic features and outputs an uncertainty score. It then applies an uncertainty-guided label rebalancing (uLNR) mechanism that probabilistically relabels $\textit{safe}$-labeled windows with unusually high uncertainty as $\textit{unsafe}$, thereby enriching the minority class with informative boundary samples without synthesizing new data. Finally, a safety predictor is trained on the rebalanced dataset for safety monitoring. We evaluate U-Balance on a large-scale UAV benchmark with a 46:1 safe-to-unsafe ratio. Results confirm a moderate but significant correlation between behavioral uncertainty and safety. We then identify uLNR as the most effective strategy to exploit uncertainty information, compared to direct early and late fusion. U-Balance achieves a 0.806 F1 score, outperforming the strongest baseline by 14.3 percentage points, while maintaining competitive inference efficiency. Ablation studies confirm that both the GatedMLP-based uncertainty predictor and the uLNR mechanism contribute significantly to U-Balance's effectiveness.

</details>


### [470] [Entropy, Disagreement, and the Limits of Foundation Models in Genomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04287)
*Maxime Rochkoulets,Lovro Vrček,Mile Šikić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实验证明，基因组序列的高熵特性（从未见令牌预测的角度）导致模型输出分布接近均匀、跨模型预测不一致、静态嵌入不稳定，且Fisher信息集中在嵌入层而非利用令牌间关系，从而限制了基因组基础模型的有效性，质疑了仅通过序列自监督训练适用于基因组数据的假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因组基础模型的效果远不如NLP领域的同类模型，但其有效性受限的原因尚未被充分理解。本文旨在探究熵作为限制基因组模型从训练数据中学习并发展基础能力的关键因素。

Method: 在文本和DNA序列上训练模型集成，分析其预测结果、静态嵌入和经验Fisher信息流，比较不同模态下的模型行为差异。

Result: 基因组序列的高熵导致：（1）模型输出分布接近均匀；（2）不同模型间预测不一致；（3）静态嵌入不稳定。同时，DNA训练的模型将Fisher信息集中在嵌入层，未能有效利用令牌间关系。

Conclusion: 自监督序列训练方法可能不适用于基因组数据，当前基因组基础模型的训练方法论假设需要重新审视。

Abstract: Foundation models in genomics have shown mixed success compared to their counterparts in natural language processing. Yet, the reasons for their limited effectiveness remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the role of entropy as a fundamental factor limiting the capacities of such models to learn from their training data and develop foundational capabilities. We train ensembles of models on text and DNA sequences and analyze their predictions, static embeddings, and empirical Fisher information flow. We show that the high entropy of genomic sequences -- from the point of view of unseen token prediction -- leads to near-uniform output distributions, disagreement across models, and unstable static embeddings, even for models that are matched in architecture, training and data. We then demonstrate that models trained on DNA concentrate Fisher information in embedding layers, seemingly failing to exploit inter-token relationships. Our results suggest that self-supervised training from sequences alone may not be applicable to genomic data, calling into question the assumptions underlying current methodologies for training genomic foundation models.

</details>


### [471] [Mining Electronic Health Records to Investigate Effectiveness of Ensemble Deep Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07085)
*Manar D. Samad,Yina Hou,Shrabani Ghosh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了传统聚类、混合聚类和深度聚类方法在电子健康记录（EHR）数据上的有效性，并提出了一种基于集成的深度聚类方法（集成嵌入深度聚类），通过聚合多个嵌入维度的聚类分配，结合传统聚类方法，在14种聚类方法和多个患者队列中取得了最佳整体性能排名，同时强调了生物性别特异性聚类的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EHR数据中的患者聚类和疾病亚型区分对阐明病理生理机制和辅助临床决策至关重要，但现有方法（如K-means及基于自编码器嵌入的混合方法）在EHR数据上效果有限，而深度学习方法主要为图像聚类设计，与表格型EHR数据差异显著。

Method: 提出了一种基于集成的深度聚类方法（ensemble-based deep clustering），通过聚合多个嵌入维度获得的聚类分配，而非依赖单一固定嵌入空间；并将其与传统聚类方法结合形成新颖的集成框架。

Result: 在All of Us研究项目的真实EHR数据上，对14种不同聚类方法和多个患者队列进行评估，提出的集成嵌入深度聚类方法结合传统聚类取得了最佳整体性能排名。

Conclusion: 论文强调了EHR数据中生物性别特异性聚类的重要性，并指出传统聚类与深度聚类方法结合优于单一方法。

Abstract: In electronic health records (EHRs), clustering patients and distinguishing disease subtypes are key tasks to elucidate pathophysiology and aid clinical decision-making. However, clustering in healthcare informatics is still based on traditional methods, especially K-means, and has achieved limited success when applied to embedding representations learned by autoencoders as hybrid methods. This paper investigates the effectiveness of traditional, hybrid, and deep learning methods in heart failure patient cohorts using real EHR data from the All of Us Research Program. Traditional clustering methods perform robustly because deep learning approaches are specifically designed for image clustering, a task that differs substantially from the tabular EHR data setting. To address the shortcomings of deep clustering, we introduce an ensemble-based deep clustering approach that aggregates cluster assignments obtained from multiple embedding dimensions, rather than relying on a single fixed embedding space. When combined with traditional clustering in a novel ensemble framework, the proposed ensemble embedding for deep clustering delivers the best overall performance ranking across 14 diverse clustering methods and multiple patient cohorts. This paper underscores the importance of biological sex-specific clustering of EHR data and the advantages of combining traditional and deep clustering approaches over a single method.

</details>


### [472] [GCA Framework: A GCC Countries-Grounded Dataset and Agentic Pipeline for Climate Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12306)
*Muhammad Umer Sheikh,Khawar Shehzad,Salman Khan,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Muhammad Haris Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了面向海湾合作委员会(GCC)国家的气候决策框架GCA，包含多模态数据集GCA-DS和工具增强型气候分析智能体Gulf Climate Agent，通过领域微调和工具集成显著提升了LLM在区域特定气候任务上的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCC国家的气候决策需要能够将异构科学和政策证据转化为可操作指导的系统，但通用大语言模型在区域特定气候知识和与地理空间/预测工具的接地交互方面表现薄弱。

Method: 构建了GCA-DS多模态数据集（20万问答对，涵盖政府政策、NGO框架、学术文献、事件驱动报告及遥感影像），并开发了GCA智能体，通过模块化工具流水线整合实时/历史信号与地理空间处理，生成派生指标和可解释可视化。

Result: 在GCC国家气候任务上的基准测试表明，领域微调和工具集成显著提升了可靠性，优于通用基线模型。

Conclusion: 领域特定的数据微调与工具增强相结合，是提升LLM在区域气候决策中实用性的有效路径。

Abstract: Climate decision-making in the GCC states increasingly demands systems that can translate heterogeneous scientific and policy evidence into actionable guidance, yet general-purpose large language models (LLMs) remain weak both in region-specific climate knowledge and grounded interaction with geospatial and forecasting tools. We present the GCA framework, which unifies (i) GCA-DS, a curated multimodal dataset grounded in the GCC states, and (ii) Gulf Climate Agent (GCA), a tool-augmented agent for climate analysis. GCA-DS comprises 200k question--answer pairs spanning governmental policies and adaptation plans, NGO and international frameworks, academic literature, and event-driven reporting on heatwaves, dust storms, and floods, complemented with remote-sensing inputs that couple imagery with textual evidence. Building on this foundation, the GCA agent orchestrates a modular tool pipeline grounded in real-time and historical signals and geospatial processing that produces derived indices and interpretable visualizations. Finally, we benchmark open and proprietary LLMs on climate tasks in the GCC states and show that domain fine-tuning and tool integration substantially improve reliability over general-purpose baselines.

</details>


### [473] [Beyond Single-Model Optimization: Preserving Plasticity in Continual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.15414)
*Lute Lillo,Nick Cheney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TeLAPA框架，通过构建行为多样的策略档案库和共享潜在空间，将持续强化学习从单一模型保留转向技能对齐的策略邻域维护，以解决灾难性干扰后的塑性损失问题，实现更高效的任务适应与复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续强化学习方法多依赖单一模型保留，但干扰后保留的单一策略无法提供可靠的快速适应起点，导致塑性损失。作者认为问题根源在于保留孤立解决方案而非可复用的策略结构，因此需要转向维护行为多样且技能对齐的策略邻域。

Method: 提出TeLAPA框架：(1) 将行为多样的策略邻域组织成每个任务的档案库；(2) 维护共享潜在空间，使存档策略在非平稳漂移下保持可比性和可重用性；(3) 从保留单一解转向维护包含多个能力相近、行为相关的策略邻域，以支持未来再学习。

Result: 在MiniGrid持续学习设定中，TeLAPA成功学习了更多任务，在干扰后恢复任务能力更快，且在整个任务序列中保持更高性能。分析表明源最优策略往往不是迁移最优的，即使在同一局部邻域内；有效复用需要保留和选择多个邻近替代方案而非坍缩为一个代表。

Conclusion: 持续强化学习应围绕可复用且能力充足的策略邻域重新构建，而非依赖单一模型保留。这为超越单模型保留、构建更具塑性的终身智能体提供了新路径。

Abstract: Continual reinforcement learning must balance retention with adaptation, yet many methods still rely on \emph{single-model preservation}, committing to one evolving policy as the main reusable solution across tasks. Even when a previously successful policy is retained, it may no longer provide a reliable starting point for rapid adaptation after interference, reflecting a form of \emph{loss of plasticity} that single-policy preservation cannot address. Inspired by quality-diversity methods, we introduce \textsc{TeLAPA} (Transfer-Enabled Latent-Aligned Policy Archives), a continual RL framework that organizes behaviorally diverse policy neighborhoods into per-task archives and maintains a shared latent space so that archived policies remain comparable and reusable under non-stationary drift. This perspective shifts continual RL from retaining isolated solutions to maintaining \emph{skill-aligned neighborhoods} with competent and behaviorally related policies that support future relearning. In our MiniGrid CL setting, \textsc{TeLAPA} learns more tasks successfully, recovers competence faster on revisited tasks after interference, and retains higher performance across a sequence of tasks. Our analyses show that source-optimal policies are often not transfer-optimal, even within a local competent neighborhood, and that effective reuse depends on retaining and selecting among multiple nearby alternatives rather than collapsing them to one representative. Together, these results reframe continual RL around reusable and competent policy neighborhoods, providing a route beyond single-model preservation toward more plastic lifelong agents.

</details>


### [474] [Replicable Bandits with UCB based Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20024)
*Rohan Deb,Udaya Ghai,Karan Singh,Arindam Banerjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了随机多臂老虎机和线性老虎机中可复现的乐观算法。提出了RepUCB（多臂老虎机）和RepLinUCB（线性老虎机）等算法，通过可复现的置信上界方法，显著改进了现有可复现性代价的依赖关系，在线性老虎机中实现了关于ρ的最优依赖，并首次将框架扩展到广义线性老虎机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可复现老虎机算法基于消除法，在线性老虎机无限动作空间场景下依赖离散化，导致对维度d和可复现参数ρ的依赖非最优。作者希望开发乐观（UCB-based）的可复现算法来降低可复现性代价。

Method: 1) RepUCB：基于分批UCB的可复现多臂老虎机算法；2) RepRidge：可复现的岭回归估计器，同时满足置信度保证和ρ-可复现性保证；3) RepLinUCB：基于RepRidge的可复现乐观线性老虎机算法；4) RepGLM：可复现的惩罚广义线性模型估计器；5) RepGLMUCB：可复现的乐观广义线性老虎机算法。

Result: RepUCB的遗憾界为O(K² log² T / ρ² · Σ(Δ_a + log(KT log T)/Δ_a))；RepLinUCB的遗憾界为Õ((d + d³/ρ)√T)，相比先前最优的Õ(d³/ρ²√T)提升了O(d/ρ)因子，首次在大动作空间下实现关于ρ的最优依赖。

Conclusion: 乐观方法（UCB）相比消除法能显著降低可复现老虎机问题的代价，RepRidge估计器具有独立于老虎机应用的统计学价值，并成功将可复现框架扩展至广义线性模型。

Abstract: We study replicable algorithms for stochastic multi-armed bandits (MAB) and linear bandits with UCB (Upper Confidence Bound) based exploration. A bandit algorithm is $ρ$-replicable if two executions using shared internal randomness but independent reward realizations produce the same action sequence with probability at least $1-ρ$. Prior approaches to this problem are elimination-based and, in linear bandits with infinitely many actions, rely on discretization, leading to suboptimal dependence on the dimension $d$ and $ρ$. We develop optimistic alternatives for both settings. For stochastic multi-armed bandits, we propose RepUCB, a replicable batched UCB algorithm and show that it attains a regret $O\!\left(\frac{K^2\log^2 T}{ρ^2}\sum_{a:Δ_a>0}\left(Δ_a+\frac{\log(KT\log T)}{Δ_a}\right)\right)$. For stochastic linear bandits, we first introduce RepRidge, a replicable ridge regression estimator that satisfies both a confidence guarantee and a $ρ$-replicability guarantee. Beyond its role in our bandit algorithm, this may also be of independent interest in other statistical estimation settings. We then use RepRidge to design RepLinUCB, a replicable optimistic algorithm for stochastic linear bandits, and show that its regret is bounded by $\widetilde{O}\!\big(\big(d+\frac{d^3}ρ\big)\sqrt{T}\big)$. This improves the best prior regret guarantee by a factor of $O(d/ρ)$, showing that our optimistic algorithm can substantially reduce the price of replicability. This is the first linear-bandit algorithm with an optimal dependence on $ρ$ for large number of arms. Finally, we extend our framework to stochastic generalized linear bandits by developing RepGLM, a replicable penalized GLM estimator, and RepGLMUCB, a replicable optimistic algorithm for this setting.

</details>


### [475] [FedSLoP: Memory-Efficient Federated Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24012)
*Yutong He,Zhengyang Huang,Jiahe Geng,Kun Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedSLoP是一种联邦优化算法，通过随机低秩子空间投影梯度来降低通信和内存开销，理论保证$O(1/\sqrt{NT})$收敛速率，实验表明在异构数据环境下能显著减少通信量和客户端内存，同时保持甚至提升模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准联邦学习算法（如FedAvg）在异构、资源受限的环境中收敛缓慢，且通信和内存成本高昂，亟需一种有效的通信和内存高效优化方法。

Method: 将随机低秩子空间投影应用于梯度更新，降低通信和存储更新的维度，同时保持优化进程。

Result: 在非凸平滑和有界方差假设下，FedSLoP以$O(1/\sqrt{NT})$的速率收敛到一阶稳定点；在异构数据划分的联邦MNIST分类任务中，相比FedAvg及稀疏/低秩基线方法，显著减少通信量和客户端内存，同时达到竞争性或更优的准确率。

Conclusion: 随机子空间动量方法（如FedSLoP）为实现通信和内存高效的联邦学习提供了一种有理论依据且有效的途径。

Abstract: Federated learning enables a population of clients to collaboratively train machine learning models without exchanging their raw data, but standard algorithms such as FedAvg suffer from slow convergence and high communication and memory costs in heterogeneous, resource-constrained environments. We introduce FedSLoP, a federated optimization algorithm that combines stochastic low-rank subspace projections of gradients, thereby reducing the dimension of communicated and stored updates while preserving optimization progress. On the theoretical side, we develop a detailed nonconvex convergence analysis under standard smoothness and bounded-variance assumptions, showing that FedSLoP is guaranteed to converge to a first-order stationary point at a rate of $O(1/\sqrt{NT})$. On the empirical side, we conduct extensive experiments on federated MNIST classification with heterogeneous data partitions, showing that FedSLoP substantially reduces communication volume and client-side memory while achieving competitive or better accuracy compared with FedAvg and representative sparse or low-rank baselines. Together, our results demonstrate that random subspace momentum methods such as FedSLoP provide a principled and effective approach to communication- and memory-efficient federated learning. Codes are available at: https://github.com/pkumelon/FedSLoP.git.

</details>


### [476] [People-Centred Medical Image Analysis via Fairness-Aware Human-AI Cooperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26991)
*Zheng Zhang,Milad Masroor,Cuong Nguyen,Tahir Hassan,Yuanhong Chen,David Rosewarne,Kevin Wells,Thanh-Toan Do,Gustavo Carneiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PecMan框架，联合建模子群依赖的可靠性、决策分配和协作预测，实现公平感知的人机协同医学图像分类，在多个数据集上取得更优的准确率-公平性-人机参与权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI公平性研究和人机协作（如L2D、L2C）通常孤立处理子群性能差异和决策分配问题，缺乏统一框架来联合建模子群依赖的可靠性、决策分配和协作预测。

Method: 提出PecMan框架，包含子群特化预测器、门控和合并机制，动态分配病例给自动模型、人类专家或其组合，测试时无需敏感属性；并引入FairHAI基准评估准确率-公平性-人机参与权衡，提供基于选择遗憾的多智能体门控理论分析。

Result: 在多个医学影像数据集上，PecMan相比单独处理公平性或人机协作的方法，在准确率、子群公平性和人类参与度之间的权衡上取得了一致更优的结果。

Conclusion: 联合建模子群依赖的可靠性、决策分配和协作预测能够有效提升医学图像分析中公平感知人机协作的性能，为资源受限下的自动化-人工决策分配提供了理论支撑和实用框架。

Abstract: Machine learning models for medical image analysis often exhibit subgroup-dependent performance, which impacts how decisions should be allocated between automated systems and human experts under limited resources. Prior work on AI fairness and human-AI cooperation, including learning to defer (L2D) and learning to complement (L2C), typically addresses these problems in isolation. We propose People-Centred Medical Image Analysis (PecMan), a framework for fairness-aware human-AI co-operative classification that jointly models subgroup-dependent reliability, decision allocation, and collaborative prediction. PecMan combines subgroup-specialised predictors with a gating and consolidation mechanism that dynamically assigns cases to automated models, human experts, or their combination, without requiring sensitive attributes at test time. We also introduce the FairHAI benchmark for evaluating trade-offs between predictive accuracy, subgroup equity, and human involvement. In addition, we provide a theoretical analysis of multi-agent gating via selection regret and characterise fairness-coverage trade-offs under input-dependent allocation. Experiments across multiple medical imaging datasets demonstrate that PecMan achieves consistently improved trade-offs compared to methods that address fairness or human-AI cooperation separately.

</details>


### [477] [$S^3$-R1: Learning to Retrieve and Answer Step-by-Step with Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01248)
*Harsh Goel,Akhil Udathu,Susmija Jabbireddy,Pradnesh Kalkar,Atharva Parulekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: S^3-R1提出了一种结合合成数据生成与稠密奖励信号的框架，通过程序化生成多跳问题并引入中间搜索质量奖励，解决了强化学习后训练中稀疏结果奖励和训练数据不足的问题，在领域外数据集上实现了最高10%的鲁棒泛化提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习后训练模型存在两个主要局限：1) 稀疏的基于结果的奖励信号导致信用分配困难；2) 缺乏涵盖不同难度层次的训练数据，使得模型无法利用工具进行深度搜索来收集证据。

Method: 1) 合成数据生成与筛选管道：从现有文档程序化派生多样化多跳问题，并通过检索验证步骤专门筛选出中等难度的问题；2) 稠密奖励结构：同时评估中间搜索质量和最终答案正确性，缓解稀疏奖励带来的信用分配问题。

Result: S^3-R1在领域外数据集上实现了最高10%的鲁棒泛化提升，优于现有基线方法，学习到了更有效的搜索与综合策略。

Conclusion: 通过数据中心的合成数据生成与稠密奖励信号相结合的方式，可以有效提升模型在工具辅助搜索与问答任务中的泛化能力，为解决稀疏奖励问题提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has enabled newer capabilities in models, such as agentic tool-use for search. However, these models struggle primarily due to limitations with sparse outcome-based rewards and a lack of training data that encapsulates questions of differing hardness, which results in models not performing deeper searches with tools to collect evidence for question-answering. To address these limitations, we introduce S^3-R1 (Synthetic data and stabilized Search R1), a framework that couples a data-centric approach with denser learning signals. We first develop a synthetic generation and curation pipeline that programmatically derives diverse, multi-hop questions from existing documents. This pipeline incorporates a retrieval-based verification step to specifically isolate questions of intermediate difficulty. We then pair this expanded training set with a reward structure that evaluates both intermediate search quality and the correctness of the final answer. This setup directly mitigates the credit assignment problems inherent to sparse rewards. Our evaluations show that S^3-R1 outperforms existing baselines by learning more effective search and synthesis strategies, yielding up to a 10% improvement in robust generalization on out-of-domain datasets.

</details>


### [478] [Hierarchical Support Vector State Partitioning for Distilling Black Box Reinforcement Learning Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04254)
*Senne Deproost,Mehrdad Asadi,Ann Nowé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SVSP方法，通过线性SVM划分状态空间，用可解释子策略模仿黑盒强化学习策略，在提升性能的同时大幅减少子策略数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于评价器驱动的状态划分方法（如VSP）需要大量子策略且性能有限，亟需一种更高效、更紧凑的策略蒸馏方法，同时保持人类可解释性。

Method: 将蒸馏数据集中的状态-动作对通过线性支持向量机划分，构建状态向量空间分区，每个分区对应一个可解释的子策略，从而结构化地表示原始黑盒策略。

Result: 相比VSP，平均回报提升7.4%，子策略数量减少82.1%；相比原始TD3策略，平均回报提升2.8%。

Conclusion: SVSP提供了一种更灵活的策略蒸馏形式，允许在原始黑盒行为的一定裕度内选择决策边界和替代模型，为构建可解释的强化学习策略开辟了新路径。

Abstract: We introduce State Vector Space Partitioning (SVSP), a novel method to mimic a black box reinforcement learning policy using a set of human-interpretable subpolicies. By partitioning a distillation dataset of state action pairs with linear support vector machine splits, SVSP constructs a compact and structured representation of the original policy. Our method improves mean return by +7.4% over previous critic driven state partitioning attempts such as Voronoi State Partitioning (VSP) and +2.8% over the original TD3 policy, while reducing the number of required subpolicies against VSP by 82.1%. Our results pave the path towards a more flexible form of distillation where both the decision boundary and surrogate models can be chosen within a margin of the original black box behavior.

</details>


### [479] [Offline Reinforcement Learning for Rotation Profile Control in Tokamaks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05857)
*Rohit Sonker,Hiro Josep Farre Kaga,Jiayu Chen,Andrew Rothstein,Ian Char,Ricardo Shousha,Egemen Kolemen,Jeff Schneider*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了使用离线强化学习（offline RL）和离线基于模型的强化学习算法，仅基于DIII-D托卡马克的历史数据，实现对等离子体旋转剖面（rotation profile）的控制，并在真实装置上成功部署，取得了有前景的实验结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 托卡马克中控制等离子体旋转剖面是一个高维度、多输入多输出的复杂控制问题，传统方法难以有效解决，而基于学习的控制方法（如RL）因缺乏精确的仿真器而面临训练困难，亟需一种仅依赖历史数据的解决方案。

Method: 使用离线强化学习和离线基于模型的强化学习算法，仅利用DIII-D托卡马克的历史运行数据训练策略；具体而言，采用等离子体动力学的概率模型生成轨迹（rollouts），用于RL训练。

Result: 该策略成功部署在DIII-D托卡马克上，观察到了有前景的真实世界实验结果。

Conclusion: 本文展示了在仅使用有限历史数据的情况下，在复杂物理装置上训练和部署RL策略的可行性与关键挑战，为托卡马克等离子体旋转剖面控制提供了一种有效的数据驱动方法。

Abstract: Tokamaks remain leading candidates for achieving practical fusion energy, yet many important control problems inside these devices are still difficult or unsolved. One such challenge is controlling the plasma rotation profile, which strongly influences stability, confinement, and transport. While the average rotation can be controlled, controlling the full profile is challenging due to high dimensionality, response to multiple actuators and dependence on plasma condition. Learning-based control methods, such as reinforcement learning (RL), provide a potential solution to this challenging problem with ability to model complex interactions leading to effective multi-input multi-output control. However, learning such policies is challenging due to the lack of accurate simulators that can model the rotation profile dynamics. In this work, we investigate the use of offline RL and offline model-based RL algorithms for rotation profile control, training them solely on historical data from the DIII-D tokamak. Our final method uses probabilistic models of plasma dynamics to generate rollouts for RL training. We deploy this policy on the DIII-D Tokamak and observe promising real-world results. We conclude by highlighting key challenges and insights from training and deploying an RL policy on a complex physical device while using only limited past data.

</details>


### [480] [Communication Dynamics Neural Networks: FFT-Diagonalized Layers for Improved Hessian Conditioning at Reduced Parameter Count](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08171)
*Lurong Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出通信动力学神经网络（CDNNs），核心是CDLinear块循环线性层，使用B=2l+1的块大小，参数量仅为全连接层的1/B。在均方损失下，权重Hessian矩阵被离散傅里叶变换对角化；输入预白化后群体Hessian条件数为1。在8×8 MNIST上，CDLinear MLP（B=4）使用2,380参数达到97.50%准确率，相比稠密基线8,970参数和98.15%准确率，实现3.8倍参数压缩，仅0.65%精度损失，且Hessian条件数缩小约310倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将通信动力学框架的循环谱机制应用于神经网络层设计，以降低参数数量并改善优化条件（Hessian条件数），从而在保持性能的同时实现更高效的神经网络架构。

Method: 提出CDLinear块循环线性层（块大小B=2l+1），参数量为稠密层的1/B；利用离散傅里叶变换对角化均方损失下的权重Hessian矩阵；在输入预白化下证明群体Hessian条件数为1，经验条件数有界为1+O(sqrt(B/N))；在NumPy中实现并验证梯度；在8×8 MNIST上进行实验。

Result: 在8×8 MNIST上，CDLinear MLP（B=4）使用2,380参数达到97.50%±0.23%准确率，稠密基线使用8,970参数达到98.15%±0.47%；参数压缩3.8倍，精度成本0.65%；CD-MLP平均Hessian条件数1.9e4，稠密基线5.9e6，缩小约310倍。

Conclusion: CDLinear作为一种结构化矩阵神经网络层，主要贡献包括：闭式Hessian谱诊断、基于原则的块多重性离散序列、显式条件数分析，以及为未来大规模基准测试提供的PyTorch参考实现。

Abstract: Communication Dynamics Neural Networks (CDNNs) apply the circulant-spectral machinery of the Communication Dynamics framework to neural-network layer design. We introduce CDLinear, a block-circulant linear layer with block size B = 2l + 1 that uses 1/B the parameters of a dense layer with the same input and output dimensions. The construction gives an explicit Fourier-domain diagnostic for optimization: for mean-squared loss, the weight Hessian is diagonalized by the discrete Fourier transform, with eigenvalues determined directly by the Fourier spectrum of the input blocks. Under input pre-whitening, the population Hessian condition number is exactly 1, and the empirical condition number is bounded by 1 + O(sqrt(B/N)) for N samples.
  We implement CDLinear in pure NumPy with hand-derived backward passes and verify gradients by finite differences. On the 8x8 MNIST digits benchmark, across three random seeds, a CDLinear MLP with B = 4 reaches 97.50% +/- 0.23% test accuracy using 2,380 parameters, compared with 98.15% +/- 0.47% for a dense baseline using 8,970 parameters. This gives a 3.8x parameter reduction at a 0.65% accuracy cost. The CD-MLP's mean Hessian condition number is 1.9e4, about 310x smaller than the dense baseline's 5.9e6. We position CDLinear as a special case of structured matrix neural-network layers, with the main contributions being a closed-form Hessian-spectrum diagnostic, a principled discrete sequence of block multiplicities, and an explicit conditioning analysis. We also release a reference PyTorch implementation integrating CDLinear into a DeepSeek-V3-style mixture-of-experts transformer for future large-scale benchmarks.

</details>


### [481] [Finer is Better (with the Right Scaling)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08565)
*Clemens Schaefer,Gil Tabak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM超低精度量化中的块大小悖论（block-size paradox），发现该悖论并非细粒度量化的固有限制，而是由小块内元素统计分布与粗粒度E4M3缩放因子之间的不良交互导致。通过防止缩放因子下溢为零、4-over-6缩放因子选择算法等干预措施可解决该悖论，证明理论MSE随块大小细化严格改善。研究强调硅片格式规范与软件缩放算法应作为紧密耦合的设计选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Fasoli等人（2026）发现标准abs-max缩放下更细的块大小反而会导致模型质量下降，形成"块大小悖论"，这一反直觉现象需要被解释和解决，以推动超低精度量化在LLM中的应用。

Method: 通过分析小块的统计特性（元素更接近局部块最大值），揭示其与E4M3亚正常值作为缩放因子时的不良交互；提出防止缩放因子下溢为零、4-over-6方法（为缩放因子选择提供更大灵活性）、以及暴力搜索最优基线三种手段。

Result: 块大小悖论并非细粒度的固有限制而是缩放因子选择不当的伪像；理论MSE随块大小细化严格改善；4-over-6启发式方法在极小块大小下能进一步提升量化质量。

Conclusion: 最大化下一代ML加速器性能需要将硅片格式规范与软件缩放算法作为紧密耦合的设计选择，协同优化而非独立设计。

Abstract: Microscaling is a critical technique for preserving the quality of Large Language Models (LLMs) quantized to ultra-low precision formats. Intuitively, finer block sizes should yield lower quantization error; however, a paradox recently identified by Fasoli et al. (2026) demonstrates that standard abs-max scaling can actually result in degraded model quality as block sizes shrink. In this work, we investigate the underlying mechanics of this phenomenon. We demonstrate that this degradation is not an inherent limitation of finer granularity, but is primarily driven by how elements in smaller blocks statistically cluster closer to their local block maximum, interacting poorly with the coarse subnormal E4M3 values used as scaling factors. Specifically, we show that i) preventing the scaling factor from underflowing to zero mitigates errors caused by extreme underflow, ii) targeted algorithmic interventions like the 4-over-6 methodology that give more flexibility to the choice of scaling factor resolve the paradox for larger values, and iii) a brute-force search establishes an optimal baseline, confirming that the theoretical Mean Squared Error (MSE) strictly improves with finer block sizes. Ultimately, our findings highlight a critical insight for hardware-software co-design: the block-size paradox is partially an artifact of naive scale selection. While using hierarchical scaling factors or wider formats like UE5M3 interchangeably resolves much of the quality loss, we found the 4-over-6 scale selection heuristic can even further improve quality, especially for very small block sizes. Consequently, maximizing the performance of next-generation ML accelerators will require treating silicon format specifications and software scaling algorithms as tightly coupled design choices.

</details>


### [482] [A Theory of Training Profit-Optimal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16430)
*Sophie Hao,William Merrill*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了结合规模法则与微观经济学的经济模型，分析LLM训练厂商在计算受限和数据受限下的利润最大化问题，发现最优模型规模与硬件效率近线性相关，当前行业趋势在计算受限模式下符合模型预测但并非利润最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然已知扩大LLM规模能可靠提升模型质量，但质量提升如何转化为潜在收入、收入增长能否抵消更大规模训练和推理的成本尚不清楚，因此需要建立经济模型来刻画LLM训练厂商的理性行为。

Method: 将规模法则与微观经济理论结合，构建LLM训练厂商的经济模型：模型质量随参数量和训练token数增加而提升，进而被具有质量阈值的消费者采纳；同时参数量和训练token的增加均带来额外成本。在计算受限和数据受限两种模式下分析利润最大化问题。

Result: 计算受限模式下，最优模型规模和token预算与硬件效率E（FLOPs/$）近线性相关，总训练成本随E次二次方增长；数据效率提升激励更大模型和更多训练支出。数据受限D时，利润最优训练支出与D^2/E成正比。当前行业趋势在计算受限模式下符合模型预测，但在数据受限或假设硬件进步停滞时并非利润最优。

Conclusion: 本文提供了利润最优LLM训练的理论框架，为批判性参与行业声明和长期经济决策提供基础。

Abstract: Scaling LLMs requires tremendous computational resources, and recent advances in AI have gone hand in hand with massive amounts of capital expenditure. While it is established that scaling up LLMs reliably increases model quality (quantified in terms of loss or downstream evaluations), it is unclear how these quality improvements translate to potential revenue, and whether revenue increases would offset costs of larger-scale training and inference. In this work, we develop an economic model for characterizing the rational behavior of an LLM training firm by combining scaling laws with microeconomic theory. Under our model of firm behavior, LLM quality can be increased with more parameters and training tokens, leading to more potential adoption by consumers, who each have a quality threshold for using the LLM. On the other hand, additional parameters and training tokens both incur additional costs. We analyze the profit maximization problem for this model under compute-bound and data-bound regimes. In the compute-bound regime, optimal model size and token budget track hardware efficiency $E$ (FLOPs/\$) at a near-linear rate; total training cost then scales sub-quadratically in $E$. Data efficiency improvements incentivize larger models and training expenditure. When we are limited to $D$ data, profit-optimal training expenditure scales as $D^2/E$, i.e, increase with data and decreases with hardware efficiency (as well as data efficiency). Finally, we analyze practical trends in training expenditure: current trends are consistent with our most permissive model variants in the compute-bound regime, but are not profit-optimal in the data-bound regime or assuming hardware advances will stall. Overall, our results provide a theory of profit-optimal LLM training, providing a foundation for engaging critically with industry statements and supporting long-term economic decision making.

</details>


### [483] [Symmetrization of Loss Functions for Robust Training of Neural Networks in the Presence of Noisy Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20347)
*Alexandre Lemire Paquin,Brahim Chaib-Draa,Philippe Giguère*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于对称性条件的多类损失函数去噪方法，提出了多类无铰链损失（multi-class unhinged loss），并引入SGCE和α-MAE两种插值损失函数，在噪声标签基准上取得竞争力表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练集标注成本高且易出错，需要设计对标签噪声鲁棒的损失函数。对称性条件为此提供了理论保证，但现有研究多集中于二分类，多类情形下的对称损失函数设计尚不充分。

Method: 利用多类损失函数唯一分解为对称分量和类不敏感项的思想，将交叉熵损失对称化得到多类无铰链损失。进一步引入SGCE和α-MAE两种插值损失函数，在保持对称性的同时控制β-光滑性。

Result: 多类无铰链损失是唯一凸的多类对称损失；任何对称损失在等分量分数向量附近的线性近似等价于该损失。SGCE和α-MAE在标准噪声标签基准上取得了与现有鲁棒损失函数竞争力相当的表现。

Conclusion: 多类无铰链损失具有理论上的唯一性和局部基础性作用，SGCE和α-MAE为实际应用提供了灵活的鲁棒损失函数选择。

Abstract: Labeling a training set is often expensive and susceptible to errors, making the design of robust loss functions for label noise an important problem. The symmetry condition provides theoretical guarantees for robustness to such noise. In this work, we study a symmetrization method arising from the unique decomposition of any multi-class loss function into a symmetric component and a class-insensitive term. In particular, symmetrizing the cross-entropy loss leads to a linear multi-class extension of the unhinged loss. Unlike in the binary case, the multi-class version must have specific coefficients in order to satisfy the symmetry condition. Under suitable assumptions, we show that this multi-class unhinged loss is the unique convex multi-class symmetric loss. We also show that it has a fundamental local role: the linear approximation of any symmetric loss around score vectors with equal components is equivalent to the multi-class unhinged loss. We then introduce SGCE and alpha-MAE, two loss functions that interpolate between the multi-class unhinged loss and the Mean Absolute Error while allowing control of the beta-smoothness of the loss. Experiments on standard noisy-label benchmarks show competitive performance compared with existing robust loss functions.

</details>


### [484] [Falcon-X: A Time Series Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Multivariate Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27286)
*Yiding Liu,Yifan Hu,Hongjie Xia,Peiyuan Liu,Hongzhou Chen,Xilin Dai,Zewei Dong,Jiang-Ming Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Falcon-X 提出了一种将时间序列变量从原始空间解耦到统一潜在原型空间的方法，通过统一原型差异注意力机制（支持正负语义亲和度建模）和潜在实体注意力实现高效跨变量交互，并利用变量重组装路由器重建变量特定轨迹，在 GIFT-Eval 和 fev-bench 基准上取得优秀预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型多为单变量，而跨变量建模仍在原始变量空间进行，存在语义对齐不足和关系表达力有限的问题——原始空间混合缺乏对齐异构物理量的机制，标准非负注意力无法捕捉真实系统中常见的协同与拮抗交互。

Method: Falcon-X 通过三个核心组件实现：（1）统一原型差异注意力机制，将变量映射到共享潜在原型空间并显式评估正负语义亲和度；（2）潜在实体注意力，在该共享空间内高效执行跨变量交互并支持零样本结构迁移；（3）变量重组装路由器，通过请求-分发机制稳健重建每个变量的时间序列轨迹。

Result: 在 GIFT-Eval 和 fev-bench 基准上的大量评估表明，Falcon-X 实现了卓越的预测性能。

Conclusion: Falcon-X 为复杂多变量时间序列预测提供了一种有原则且可扩展的范式，并已公开发布以支持未来研究。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are transforming the forecasting paradigm through large-scale cross-domain pretraining. However, most existing TSFMs remain univariate, and recent efforts to enable cross-variate modeling still operate directly within the raw variate space. This design introduces fundamental limitations in semantic alignment and relational expressivity. Specifically, raw-space group mixing lacks a dedicated mechanism to align heterogeneous physical quantities, while standard non-negative attention fails to capture the complex synergistic and antagonistic interactions ubiquitous in real-world systems. To address these challenges, we propose Falcon-X, decouples variates from the raw space and maps them into a unified latent prototype space. Falcon-X employs a Unified Prototype Diff-Attention mechanism that explicitly evaluates both positive and negative semantic affinities to explicitly align heterogeneous variates. Cross-variate interactions are then efficiently performed within this shared space via Latent Entity Attention, naturally facilitating zero-shot structural transfer. Finally, a Variate Reassembly Router robustly reconstructs variate-specific trajectories via a request-and-dispatch mechanism. Extensive evaluations on the GIFT-Eval and fev-bench benchmarks demonstrate that Falcon-X achieves excellent forecasting performance, offering a principled and scalable paradigm for complex multivariate environments. Falcon-X is publicly released to support future research.

</details>


### [485] [On the Learnability of Test-Time Adaptation: A Recovery Complexity Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28057)
*Zhi Zhou,Ming Yang,Shi-Yu Tian,Kun-Yang Yu,Lan-Zhe Guo,Yu-Feng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次提出测试时自适应（TTA）的可学习性理论框架，引入(ε,δ)-恢复复杂度和(ε,ρ)-TTA可学习性两个核心概念，通过构造非平稳测试流的离散替代模型，推导出恢复复杂度的匹配上下界，揭示了TTA中适应性与信息约束之间的内在权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTA方法在经验上取得成功，但缺乏原则性的理论框架来同时对齐TTA目标、捕捉连续演化的分布偏移以及内在信息约束，无法回答TTA在非平稳流上的可学习性问题。

Method: 提出(ε,δ)-恢复复杂度（衡量偏移后恢复至目标超额风险所需时间）和(ε,ρ)-TTA可学习性（衡量长期可靠性）；构造非平稳测试流的离散替代模型，统一分析渐变和突变两种偏移；推导恢复复杂度的阶匹配下界和上界。

Result: 获得了恢复复杂度的匹配上下界，揭示了TTA的基本极限以及适应性与信息之间的内在权衡；提供了统一的可学习性保证，补充了基于遗憾的分析方法。

Conclusion: 该理论框架为理解TTA在非平稳环境下的学习能力和极限提供了第一性原理基础，发现了适应性与信息约束间的根本性权衡。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt models to maintain reliable performance on non-stationary test streams without requiring labeled data. Despite its empirical success, the learnability of TTA under non-stationary streams remains unexplored. A key challenge is the lack of a principled theoretical framework that simultaneously aligns with the TTA objective and captures both continuously evolving distribution shifts and intrinsic information constraints. To address this gap, we propose the first theoretical framework for studying the learnability of TTA and introduce $(ε,δ)$-Recovery Complexity and $(ε,ρ)$-TTA Learnability. Recovery complexity measures the post-shift time needed to maintain excess risk below a target level with high probability, and is further extended to TTA learnability, which measures the long-term reliability of TTA. Within this framework, we introduce a novel discrete surrogate for non-stationary test streams, enabling a unified and tractable analysis of both gradual and abrupt shifts. We derive order-wise matching lower and upper bounds on recovery complexity, revealing fundamental limits of TTA and an intrinsic adaptivity-information trade-off. These results provide unified learnability guarantees for TTA that complement regret-based analyses.

</details>


### [486] [Variational Learning for Insertion-based Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02133)
*Yangtian Zhang,Zhe Wang,Arthur Gretton,Rex Ying,David van Dijk,Michalis K. Titsias,Jiaxin Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出插入过程（Insertion Process, IP），一种基于排列变分推断的概率框架，用于在变长插入模型中学习插入顺序，从而支持非单调序列生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非单调序列生成模型（如掩码扩散模型）与顺序无关且依赖固定长度网格，无法支持变长生成和自适应插入顺序，限制了其灵活性和表达能力。

Method: 形式化了插入轨迹与排列之间的双射对应关系，从而将数据似然重参数化为排列上的求和；基于此提出插入过程（IP），通过排列变分推断联合学习插入位置、插入内容和终止条件。

Result: 在目标条件规划与分子字符串生成任务上，学习插入顺序能够提升建模质量和泛化能力，尤其在缺乏规范从左到右结构的领域中表现更优。

Conclusion: IP原生支持变长生成且能学习数据驱动的插入顺序偏好，优于固定画布方法，为非单调序列生成提供了更灵活的框架。

Abstract: Non-monotonic sequence generation methods, such as masked diffusion models, provide a flexible alternative to left-to-right autoregressive modeling by allowing tokens to be generated in non-fixed and prescribed orders. Despite their practical advantages, most existing non-monotonic models are order-agnostic and rely on a fixed-length grid, limiting their ability to support variable-length generation and adaptive insertion order. In this work, we introduce a probabilistic framework for learning insertion order in variable-length insertion models. We formalize a bijective correspondence between insertion trajectories and permutations, which enables an exact reparameterization of the data likelihood as a sum over permutations. Building on this result, we propose the Insertion Process (IP), a stochastic generative model that jointly learns where to insert, what to insert, and when to terminate, trained via permutation-based variational inference. Unlike prior fixed-canvas approaches, IP natively supports variable-length generation and learns data-driven preferences over insertion orders. Experiments on goal-conditioned planning and molecular string generation demonstrate that learning insertion order improves both modeling quality and generalization in domains without a canonical left-to-right structure.

</details>


### [487] [When Do Attention Circuits Form? Developmental Trajectories of Capability and Attention-Sink Emergence Across Three 1B-ClassArchitectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02378)
*Yongzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对三个1B级语言模型（Pythia 1B、OLMo 1B、OLMoE 1B-7B）的30次机械可解释性分析显示：注意力头电路的形成存在五种规律，包括L0/L1零BOS头是架构固有属性、BOS吸引子头有三种不同的涌现形状、DCLM模型中归纳电路形成比BOS吸引子形成早10-20倍token、能力特异性筛选在训练早期即可收敛、最终检查点的归纳头在首次越过能力阈值时PR值已升高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 追踪不同架构和预训练语料库的1B级语言模型中注意力头电路的发育轨迹，揭示注意力头（归纳头、前token头、BOS吸引子头）的涌现规律。

Method: 对三个模型（Pythia 1B、OLMo 1B-0724-hf、OLMoE 1B-7B-0924），每个模型取10个对数间隔的检查点，共30次机械可解释性分析，应用参与比（PR）谱信号和全头能力特异性选择性筛选来追踪归纳头、前token头和BOS吸引子头的涌现。

Result: (F1) 所有模型中第0层和第1层在任何检查点都没有BOS分类头，是架构属性；(F2) 整体BOS吸引子头比例有三种涌现形状：Pythia 1B逐渐上升、OLMo 1B在相邻检查点间从7%跃升至70%、OLMoE逐渐上升；(F3) DCLM模型中归纳电路形成比BOS吸引子形成早10-20倍token；(F4) 能力特异性筛选在总训练token的0.3-2%内收敛到最终归纳电路；(F5) 每个最终检查点的归纳头在首次越过能力阈值时或之前PR值已升高。

Conclusion: 在1B级模型上，归纳阶段转变和注意力汇转变在token数量上相差一个数量级且形状定性不同，细化了归纳阶段转变的框架。

Abstract: We track the developmental trajectory of attention-head circuit formation across three 1B-class language models spanning two architecture families (dense transformer, mixture-of-experts) and two pretraining corpora (The Pile, DCLM): Pythia 1B, OLMo 1B-0724-hf, and OLMoE 1B-7B-0924. At each of 10 log-spaced revisions per model -- 30 mechanistic-interpretability runs in total -- we apply a participation-ratio (PR) spectral signal and an all-head capability-specific selectivity screen to track induction, previous-token, and BOS-attractor heads as they emerge.
  Five findings. (F1) Layers 0 and 1 produce zero BOS-classified heads at every revision in every model: the L0/L1 zero-BOS floor is an architectural property, not a learned outcome. (F2) The whole-model BOS-attractor fraction follows three distinct emergence shapes -- a gradual ramp in Pythia 1B, a sharp phase transition in OLMo 1B (7% to 70% between adjacent checkpoints), and a gradual ramp in OLMoE 1B-7B. (F3) In DCLM models, induction-circuit formation precedes BOS-attractor formation by 10-20x in tokens; capability-circuit formation and attention-sink formation are two transitions, not one. (F4) The capability-specific screen converges to the final induction circuit within 0.3-2% of total training tokens -- circuit identification does not require the final model. (F5) For every final-checkpoint induction head sampled across all three models, per-head PR is elevated at or before the first revision at which that head crosses its capability-selectivity threshold.
  The results refine the induction-phase-transition framing: in 1B-class models trained on DCLM, the induction transition and the attention-sink transition are separated by an order of magnitude in tokens and have qualitatively different shapes.

</details>


### [488] [Pruning Deep Neural Networks via the Marchenko--Pastur Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02608)
*Leonid Berlyand,Theo Bourdais,Houman Owhadi,Yitzchak Shmalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论的剪枝方法，在极小微调预算下实现深度神经网络的高效剪枝，通过确定性数据路径认证和理论保证，在ImageNet-1k上多种架构（ViT、ConvNeXtV2、ResNet）均达到接近稠密模型精度的结果，并获得显著的加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有剪枝方法通常需要漫长的重优化流程，本文旨在用极小的后剪枝微调预算（短校准和微调计划）保持模型精度，降低剪枝部署成本。

Method: 采用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵方法进行剪枝。理论方面：给出确定性数据路径认证——若移除分量R的传播logit效应足够小，则剪枝降低弹性网目标函数，保留密集边界超过两倍扰动的样本；零预算情形实现完美剪枝；提出prune-restore扩展以固定稀疏执行模式恢复权重；加性L2正则化模型下，可容许的类随机分量在训练极限处消失，持久尖峰随MP体塌缩稳定。在高斯充分条件下，拟合的MP边缘σ⁺提供逐层预算信号。

Result: ImageNet-1k上：ViT-B/16经过仅3轮蒸馏，2:4+ToMe达到83.41% top-1，MAC减少59.81%，A40后端加速1.388×，A100加速2.705×；结构化稀疏ViT-B/16 6:12达83.74%，ViT-L/16 8:16达85.33%（-0.51 pp），ConvNeXtV2-Base 12:16达86.35%（-0.37 pp）；ResNet50 8:16达75.87%（-0.26 pp），ResNet152d CAST-conv+permutation达81.33%（-1.53 pp），MAC减少约50%，A40加速1.62×。

Conclusion: 基于MP随机矩阵理论的剪枝方法在极小微调预算下有效保持模型精度，理论框架提供了剪枝安全的确定性保证，实验结果验证了方法的广泛适用性和实际加速效果。

Abstract: We study a Marchenko--Pastur (MP) random-matrix approach to pruning deep neural networks with very small post-pruning fine-tuning budgets. The main practical contribution is accuracy retention under short calibration and fine-tuning schedules, rather than a long post-pruning reoptimization pipeline. The theory gives deterministic data-path certificates: if the removed component $R$ has small propagated logit effect $L_s \| R ψ_1(s) \|_\infty$, pruning decreases an elastic-net objective and preserves samples whose dense margin exceeds twice the perturbation. The zero-budget case gives perfect pruning; a prune--restore extension models weight restoration inside a fixed sparse-execution pattern; and an additive $L_2$-regularized model shows admissible random-like components vanish at the training limit, with persistent spikes stabilizing as the MP bulk collapses. Under iid-Gaussian sufficient conditions, the fitted MP edge $σ_+$ gives a high-probability layerwise budget signal.
  On ImageNet-1k, after only three distillation epochs, ViT-B/16 $2{:}4{+}$ToMe reaches $83.41\%$ top-1 ($-1.70$ pp from dense) at $59.81\%$ sparse-execution MAC reduction, with $1.388\times$ best-observed A40 native-$2{:}4$ backend speedup for the same checkpoint and ToMe graph; a separate no-ToMe A100 endpoint gives $2.705\times$. At structured sparsity, ViT-B/16 $6{:}12$ reaches $83.74\%$, ViT-L/16 $8{:}16$ dense+permutation reaches $85.33\%$ ($-0.51$ pp), and ConvNeXtV2-Base $12{:}16$ reaches $86.35\%$ ($-0.37$ pp). For CNNs, ResNet50 $8{:}16$ dense+permutation reaches $75.87\%$ ($-0.26$ pp), and ResNet152d CAST-conv+permutation reaches $81.33\%$ ($-1.53$ pp) at ${\sim}50\%$ MAC accounting with a $1.62\times$ A40 im2col$+2{:}4$ sparse-GEMM audit.

</details>


### [489] [Edge of Stability Selectively Shapes Learning Across the Data Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04212)
*Shauna Kwag,Anakha Ganesh,Tomaso Poggio,Pierfrancesco Beneventano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现边缘稳定性（EoS）不仅是全局优化属性，更是选择性机制：它通过稳定性约束重新分配不同数据子集的学习进度，使某些组受益而抑制其他组。受益需满足两个条件：组梯度与Hessian主特征向量对齐，且梯度幅度不消失（交叉熵下未饱和的异常值组获益）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将EoS视为全局优化现象，但忽略了其对数据分布中不同子集的选择性影响。作者希望揭示EoS是否以及如何差异化地影响不同数据组的学习进度。

Method: 采用分支干预方法，从相同训练状态进入或退出EoS regime，因果验证权衡效应。通过可控扰动（保留距离但随机化方向）破坏对齐机制，并分析交叉熵损失下的梯度饱和现象。

Result: 1) 组的聚合梯度与Hessian主特征向量对齐是受益的必要条件；2) 组需维持非零梯度幅度（输出异常值因梯度不饱和而获益）；3) 方向随机化的扰动会消除这种优势，证实对齐机制的关键作用。

Conclusion: EoS不仅是稳定性边界，更是调控学习在数据分布中分配的核心机制，揭示了优化稳定性与学习公平性之间的内在权衡。

Abstract: Existing analyses of the edge of stability (EoS) treat it as a global property of optimization. We show that it is also selective: the stability constraint redistributes learning across subsets of the training distribution, amplifying progress on some groups while suppressing progress on others. Using a branching intervention that enters or exits the EoS regime from the same training state, we causally demonstrate this trade-off and identify two necessary conditions for a group to benefit. First, its aggregate gradient must align with the top Hessian eigenvector. We isolate this mechanism with a controlled perturbation that preserves distance but randomizes direction, destroying alignment and eliminating the advantage. Second, the group must sustain non-vanishing gradient magnitude over time. Under cross-entropy loss, gradient saturation decouples confidently classified groups, shifting the advantage to output-outliers, whose gradients persist. Together, these results show that EoS functions not only as a stability boundary, but as a mechanism governing the allocation of learning across the data distribution.

</details>


### [490] [AsyncWebRL: Efficient Multi-Step RL for Visual Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05597)
*Hao Bai,Rui Yang,Chenlu Ye,Spencer Whitehead,Aviral Kumar,Tong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AsyncWebRL通过异步系统设计（最高2.9倍训练吞吐量提升）和用常数1/k替换1/|τ_i|的算法改进（解决失败轨迹更长导致负梯度被削弱的问题），在WebGym OOD测试集上达到新SOTA（+5.8%相对提升），中等和困难子集分别提升42%和48%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言网络智能体多步强化学习存在两类效率问题：(1) 同步RL中GPU空闲导致计算资源浪费；(2) 轨迹使用的步骤和token数超出必要，造成计算冗余。

Method: 系统方面：提出异步设计，解耦 rollout、梯度更新和策略刷新三个迭代阶段；引入永续rollout池和轻量级截图处理两项适配。算法方面：将多步GRPO中的每条轨迹归一化器从1/|τ_i|替换为常数1/k，打破失败轨迹更长与负梯度权重降低之间的耦合。

Result: 端到端训练吞吐量相比之前最快的开源同步管线WebGym最高提升2.9倍；在WebGym OOD测试集上达到新SOTA（相对提升+5.8%），中等和困难子集分别相对提升42%和48%。

Conclusion: 异步系统设计与算法改进（归一化器替换）共同实现了训练效率与性能的双重提升，确立了新的开源SOTA。

Abstract: Training vision-language web agents with multi-step RL is compute-intensive, with two dominant forms of inefficiency: idle GPUs in synchronous RL, and trajectories that use more steps and tokens than necessary. We present AsyncWebRL, which addresses both. On the system side, an asynchronous design overlaps rollout, gradient update, and policy refresh across iterations, paired with two web-agent-specific adaptations, namely an everlasting rollout pool and lightweight screenshot handling, that together deliver up to a $2.9\times$ end-to-end training-throughput speedup over the previously fastest open synchronous pipeline (WebGym). On the algorithmic side, we identify the per-trajectory normalizer $1/|τ_i|$ in multi-step GRPO as the root cause of trajectory-level and token-level inefficiency: because failures are systematically longer than successes, it down-weights the negative gradient on failed tokens, so the policy keeps producing verbose memory schemas. Replacing $1/|τ_i|$ with a constant $1/k$ breaks this coupling, contracting trajectories while preserving aggregate success. Together, these contributions set a new open-source state of the art on the WebGym out-of-distribution test split (+5.8% relative over the 42.9% prior best), with the largest gains on the harder slices (+42% relative on Medium, +48% relative on Hard).

</details>


### [491] [OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06021)
*Shenzhi Yang,Guangcheng Zhu,Bowen Song,Haobo Wang,Mingxuan Xia,Xing Zheng,Yingfan Ma,Zhongqi Chen,Weiqiang Wang,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，通过将知识蒸馏从输出空间提升到隐状态空间，让学生模型在相同rollout上对齐教师模型的逐层表示，从而消除蒙特卡洛KL估计的采样方差，提供更丰富的逐层结构信息。实验表明OPRD在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上缩小了师生差距，比on-policy distillation (OPD)快1.44倍，内存减少54%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD)仅在输出空间监督学生模型（匹配下一个token概率），存在两个局限：(1) 在大词表上（如Qwen约15万tokens）蒙特卡洛KL估计的采样方差在训练过程中持续存在；(2) 将教师模型视为黑盒，丢弃了LM head之前的所有中间隐状态。

Method: 提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，在相同rollout上对齐学生和教师模型在选定层的表示，完全绕过LM head进行蒸馏。

Result: OPRD在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上缩小了师生差距，而输出空间的OPD基线在低于教师的水平上停滞不前。OPRD训练速度比top-k OPD快1.44倍，内存使用减少54%。

Conclusion: OPRD通过隐状态空间蒸馏消除了采样方差问题，提供了更丰富的逐层结构信息，在性能、训练速度和内存效率上均优于传统输出空间的on-policy distillation方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student only in output space by matching next-token probabilities. This output-only paradigm has two limits: (1) sampling variance from Monte Carlo KL estimates over large vocabularies (e.g., Qwen's ~150k tokens) persists throughout training, and (2) it treats the teacher as a black-box, discarding all intermediate hidden states after the LM head. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), which lifts distillation into hidden-state space by aligning student and teacher representations across selected layers on the same rollouts, bypassing the LM head entirely. Theoretically, OPRD eliminates sampling variance and provides richer per-layer structural information. Empirically, OPRD closes the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. OPRD also trains 1.44x faster and uses 54% less memory than top-k OPD. Code: https://github.com/ShenzhiYang2000/OPRD.

</details>


### [492] [Principles and Practice of Deep Representation Learning: or a Mathematical Theory of Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06624)
*Sam Buchanan,Druv Pai,Peng Wang,Yi Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本书旨在通过表征学习的视角打开深度学习"黑箱"，从优化和信息论角度阐释现代神经网络架构的设计原理，并提出高效、可解释、可控的新型建模方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型深度神经网络存在内部机制不透明、难以理解的问题，导致可解释性、可靠性和可控性方面的困难，急需打开"黑箱"以揭示其工作机制。

Method: 以表征学习为核心视角，运用优化理论和信息论将神经网络架构设计过程简化为本科水平的线性代数和微积分练习，并在此基础上提出全新方法和模型。

Result: 获得设计上高效、可解释、可控的新型方法和模型，其性能不逊于甚至超越传统黑箱模型。

Conclusion: 表征学习是深度学习的核心因素，通过理论化架构设计可以开发既强大又可解释的模型，并为未来深度学习和表征学习的发展方向提供展望。

Abstract: In the current era of deep learning and especially generative models, there is significant investment in training very large deep neural networks. Thus far, such models have been "black boxes" that are difficult to understand in the sense that they have opaque internal mechanisms, leading to difficulties in interpretability, reliability, and control. Naturally, this lack of understanding has led to both hype and fear.
  This book is an attempt to "open the black box" and understand the mechanisms of large deep networks, through the perspective of representation learning, which is a major factor - arguably the single most important one - in the empirical power of deep learning models. A brief outline of this book is as follows. Chapter 1 will summarize the threads that underlie the whole text. Chapters 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 will explain the design principles of modern neural network architectures through optimization and information theory, reducing the process of architecture development (long having been described as a sort of "alchemy") to undergraduate-level linear algebra and calculus exercises once the underlying principles are introduced. Chapters 7 and 8 will discuss applications of these principles to solve problems in more paradigmatic ways, obtaining new methods and models which are efficient, interpretable, and controllable by design, and yet no less - sometimes even more - powerful than the black-box models they resemble. Chapter 9 will discuss potential future directions for deep learning, the role of representation learning, as well as some open problems.

</details>


### [493] [RECAP: Regression Evaluation for Continual Adaptation of Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06698)
*Harsh Deshpande,Kushal Chawla,Sangwoo Cho,William Campbell,Sambit Sahu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RECAP是一个衡量在严格主动适应-测试协议下，LLM面对动态约束时持续学习能力的基准。实验表明现有提示优化方法在面对主动适应场景时表现不足，即使付出更高延迟成本也未能显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中的智能体系统经常面临动态变化的约束（如策略更新、合规阈值变更），且必须在下一次交互中立即遵守，几乎没有容错空间。然而现有基准仅考虑静态约束或带评估反馈的被动适应协议，缺乏对主动适应场景的评估。

Method: 提出RECAP基准，采用严格的主动适应-测试协议：提示优化方法仅接收约束规格说明，必须在未见任何测试数据的情况下泛化。在四种LLM、三种调度策略和动态约束条件下评估六种方法，从约束层面衡量持续学习现象（遗忘、回归、前向迁移）。

Result: 六种方法在四种LLM和三种调度策略下均未表现出显著性能提升，即使增加了延迟成本也无改善。这些为离线或被动场景设计的方法在主动适应范式中效果不佳。

Conclusion: 现有提示优化方法不足以应对主动适应范式，亟需设计新的主动提示适应方法，使模型在部署中面对不断变化的需求时保持鲁棒性。

Abstract: Production agentic systems routinely face evolving constraints and must comply from the very next interaction. Scenarios like a tool-call notification changing a compliance threshold or a policy update adding disclosure requirements fit this criteria, having close to no room for errors in production. This proactive adaptation setting is common in deployment, but absent from current benchmarks, which assume either static constraint sets or reactive protocols with evaluation feedback. We introduce RECAP, a benchmark that measures continual-learning phenomena (forgetting, regression, forward transfer) at the constraint level under a strictly proactive adapt-then-test protocol: prompt optimization methods receive only the constraint specification and must generalize before seeing any test data. Evaluating six methods across four LLMs and three schedules with evolving constraints, we find that these methods show no significant improvement in performance, even after incurring a higher latency. These methods, designed for offline or reactive settings, are inadequate for the proactive paradigm. Our work emphasizes the growing need for designing proactive prompt adaptation methods, where the models must remain robust to evolving needs in deployment.

</details>


### [494] [TorchKM: A GPU-Oriented Library for Kernel Learning and Model Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06742)
*Yikai Zhang,Gaoxiang Jia,Jie Ding,Boxiang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TorchKM是一个基于PyTorch的开源核方法库，支持SVM、核逻辑回归和核分位数回归，通过GPU加速和矩阵操作复用实现高效训练与模型选择，提供scikit-learn风格API，并可通过PyPI安装。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有核方法实现缺乏GPU加速且难以集成到现代AI工作流中，作者旨在提供一个高效、可编程的核方法库，利用GPU线性代数加速核机器全流程。

Method: 基于PyTorch构建，采用scikit-learn风格API，通过GPU友好的线性代数运算和智能复用矩阵操作来加速训练与模型选择全过程。

Result: 基准测试显示与标准基线相比具有竞争力的预测性能，同时实现了显著的加速效果。

Conclusion: TorchKM作为一个高效、可编程的核学习组件，适用于AI驱动的工作流，并已开源发布。

Abstract: TorchKM is an open-source library for kernel machines, including support vector machines, kernel logistic regression, and kernel quantile regression, with GPU acceleration. The library features a scikit-learn-style API and is designed to exploit GPU-friendly linear algebra, accelerating the full training and model-selection pipeline through intelligent reuse of matrix operations. Benchmarks show competitive predictive performance with substantial speedups over standard baselines. The efficiency and programmable design also make TorchKM a kernel-learning component for AI-driven workflows. Code and documentation are available at https://github.com/YikaiZhang95/torchkm, and the package can be easily installed via PyPI.

</details>


### [495] [Learn to Match: Two-Sided Matching with Temporally Extended Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06744)
*Haijing Zong,Yancheng Liang,Boyang Zhou,Natasha Jaques*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Learn2Match，一个基于多智能体强化学习的动态双边匹配市场基准框架。该框架将匹配建模为部分可观测马尔可夫博弈，支持面试、匹配、解约等时序决策，并通过信息摩擦损失衡量潜在偏好未完全揭示带来的福利损失。实验表明独立PPO在累积社会福利和遗憾方面优于bandit基线，但信息摩擦损失更高，说明端到端MARL尚缺乏匹配bandit方法的协调探索结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双边匹配模型通常将信息交互简化为关于固定偏好的即时亚高斯反馈，忽略了匹配过程中通过面试、重复互动、学习、分离等方式逐步揭示的动态信息，以及这些信息如何影响后续匹配决策。缺乏能够刻画时序扩展反馈的匹配市场框架。

Method: 将动态匹配市场建模为部分可观测马尔可夫博弈，包含昂贵的面试筛选、含噪的匹配后观测、演化的潜在特征、内生维持或解约等机制。构建Learn2Match多智能体强化学习基准，支持分散决策（面试/匹配/解约），并引入信息摩擦损失指标。
